import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/svelte';
import PlayingCard from '../PlayingCard.svelte';

describe('PlayingCard', () => {
  it('renders rank and suit', () => {
    render(PlayingCard, { rank: 'A', suit: '♠' });
    expect(screen.getByText('A')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('♠')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('renders different sizes', () => {
    const { container } = render(PlayingCard, { rank: 'A', suit: '♠', size: 'lg' });
    const card = container.firstChild as HTMLElement;
    expect(card).toBeTruthy();
  });
});

  import Avatar from '../Avatar.svelte';

  export let player: any = {};
  export let isHero: boolean = false;
  export let isDealer: boolean = false;
  export let isTurn: boolean = false;
  export let isWinner: boolean = false;
  export let isShowdown: boolean = false;

  export let isShowdownLose: boolean = false;
  export let handName: string = '';

  export let holeCards: any[] = [];
  export let heroAvatarId: string = 'king';
  export let turnStartedAt: number = 0;
  export let turnBaseLimit: number = 30;
  export let serverTime: number = Date.now();
  export let size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' = 'md';
  export let cardsAbove: boolean = true;
  export let panelSide: 'left' | 'right' = 'right';
  export let onClick: () => void = () => {};

  const SIZES = {
    sm: { avatar: 26, panelW: 54, nameFont: 8, stackFont: 8, cardW: 16, timerExtra: 6 },
    md: { avatar: 32, panelW: 64, nameFont: 9, stackFont: 9, cardW: 18, timerExtra: 8 },
    lg: { avatar: 40, panelW: 78, nameFont: 10, stackFont: 10, cardW: 22, timerExtra: 10 },
    xl: { avatar: 52, panelW: 96, nameFont: 11, stackFont: 11, cardW: 26, timerExtra: 12 },
  };
  $: Z = SIZES[size];

  function fmt(n: any): string {
    return Number(Number(n || 0).toFixed(2)).toFixed(2);
  }
  function suitChar(s: string): '♠' | '♥' | '♦' | '♣' {
    if (s === 's') return '♠';
    if (s === 'h') return '♥';
    if (s === 'd') return '♦';
    return '♣';
  }

  $: showFace = isShowdown || isHero;
  $: hasCards = holeCards.length > 0;
  $: faceDown = hasCards && !showFace;
  $: displayCards = hasCards ? holeCards : [];
</script>

  {#if !cardsAbove && displayCards.length > 0}

  {:else if player.folded}

    <div class="pill pill-allin">ALL-IN</div>

========== FILE: apps\mini-app\src\components\poker\PokerTableMobile.svelte ==========
<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount } from 'svelte';
  import PlayingCard from '../PlayingCard.svelte';
  import PokerChip from '../PokerChip.svelte';
  import PlayerSeat from './PlayerSeat.svelte';

  export let gameState: any = null;
  export let myUserId: number | null = null;
  export let myAvatarId: string = 'king';
  export let theme: 'cash' | 'tournament' = 'cash';
  export let tournamentTitle: string = '';
  export let isEliminated: boolean = false;
  export let handResult: any = null;
  export let isFinalTable: boolean = false;
  export let onPlayerClick: (userId: number) => void = () => {};

  // ============================================================
  // SEAT LAYOUTS — percentages of TABLE container
  // index 0 = hero (always bottom), indices 1..N-1 = opponents CCW
  // ============================================================
  const SEAT_LAYOUTS: Record<number, { x: number; y: number }[]> = {
    2: [
      { x: 50, y: 91 },
      { x: 50, y: 9 },
    ],
    3: [
      { x: 50, y: 91 },
      { x: 16, y: 25 },
      { x: 84, y: 25 },
    ],
    4: [
      { x: 50, y: 91 },
      { x: 12, y: 55 },
      { x: 50, y: 8 },
      { x: 88, y: 55 },
    ],
    5: [
      { x: 50, y: 91 },
      { x: 12, y: 67 },
      { x: 20, y: 20 },
      { x: 80, y: 20 },
      { x: 88, y: 67 },
    ],
    6: [
      { x: 50, y: 91 },
      { x: 13, y: 68 },
      { x: 14, y: 30 },
      { x: 50, y: 8 },
      { x: 86, y: 30 },
      { x: 87, y: 68 },
    ],
    7: [
      { x: 50, y: 91 },
      { x: 12, y: 73 },
      { x: 13, y: 42 },
      { x: 25, y: 13 },
      { x: 75, y: 13 },
      { x: 87, y: 42 },
      { x: 88, y: 73 },
    ],
    8: [
      { x: 50, y: 91 },
      { x: 11, y: 76 },
      { x: 12, y: 52 },
      { x: 15, y: 25 },
      { x: 50, y: 8 },
      { x: 85, y: 25 },
      { x: 88, y: 52 },
      { x: 89, y: 76 },
    ],
    9: [
      { x: 50, y: 91 },
      { x: 11, y: 78 },
      { x: 12, y: 59 },
      { x: 13, y: 38 },
      { x: 22, y: 16 },
      { x: 50, y: 7 },
      { x: 78, y: 16 },
      { x: 87, y: 38 },
      { x: 88, y: 59 },
    ],
  };

  function getLayout(total: number): { x: number; y: number }[] {
    return SEAT_LAYOUTS[total] || SEAT_LAYOUTS[6];
  }

  // ============================================================
  // FELT SIZE — JS-computed, portrait 9:16
  // ============================================================
  let wrapperEl: HTMLDivElement;
  let feltW = 0;
  let feltH = 0;

  function computeFelt() {
    if (!wrapperEl) return;
    const availW = wrapperEl.clientWidth;
    const availH = wrapperEl.clientHeight;
    if (availW <= 0 || availH <= 0) return;
    const ratio = 9 / 16;
    if (availW / ratio <= availH) {
      feltW = availW;
      feltH = Math.round(availW / ratio);
    } else {
      feltH = availH;
      feltW = Math.round(availH * ratio);
    }
  }

  onMount(() => {
    computeFelt();
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(computeFelt);
    if (wrapperEl) ro.observe(wrapperEl);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  });

  function fmt(n: any): string {
    const num = Number(n || 0);
    if (num === Math.floor(num)) return String(Math.floor(num));
    return num.toFixed(2);
  }

  function suitChar(s: string): '♠' | '♥' | '♦' | '♣' {
    if (s === 's') return '♠';
    if (s === 'h') return '♥';
    if (s === 'd') return '♦';
    return '♣';
  }

  type Sizes = {
    avatar: number;
    nameW: number;
    nameFont: number;
    stackFont: number;
    betChip: number;
    betFont: number;
    cardSize: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md';
    potTop: number;
    potFont: number;
    timerExtra: number;
  };

  function getSizes(total: number): Sizes {
    if (total <= 2)
      return { avatar: 60, nameW: 84, nameFont: 11, stackFont: 11, betChip: 14, betFont: 10, cardSize: 'sm', potTop: 41, potFont: 15, timerExtra: 14 };
    if (total === 3)
      return { avatar: 52, nameW: 78, nameFont: 10, stackFont: 10, betChip: 12, betFont: 9,  cardSize: 'sm', potTop: 41, potFont: 13, timerExtra: 12 };
    if (total === 4)
      return { avatar: 46, nameW: 70, nameFont: 10, stackFont: 10, betChip: 11, betFont: 9,  cardSize: 'sm', potTop: 41, potFont: 12, timerExtra: 10 };
    if (total === 5)
      return { avatar: 40, nameW: 64, nameFont: 9,  stackFont: 9,  betChip: 10, betFont: 8,  cardSize: 'xs', potTop: 41, potFont: 11, timerExtra: 8  };
    if (total === 6)
      return { avatar: 36, nameW: 60, nameFont: 9,  stackFont: 9,  betChip: 10, betFont: 8,  cardSize: 'xs', potTop: 41, potFont: 11, timerExtra: 8  };
    if (total === 7)
      return { avatar: 34, nameW: 56, nameFont: 8,  stackFont: 8,  betChip: 9,  betFont: 7,  cardSize: 'xs', potTop: 41, potFont: 10, timerExtra: 6  };
    return { avatar: 32, nameW: 52, nameFont: 8,  stackFont: 8,  betChip: 9,  betFont: 7,  cardSize: 'xs', potTop: 41, potFont: 10, timerExtra: 6  };
  }

  // ============================================================
  // BET POSITION — 42% along player→center vector
  // ============================================================
  function betPos(pos: { x: number; y: number }): { x: string; y: string } {
    const dx = 50 - pos.x;
    const dy = 50 - pos.y;
    return { x: `${pos.x + dx * 0.28}%`, y: `${pos.y + dy * 0.28}%` };
  }

  $: allSeats = gameState?.seats ?? [];
  $: totalSeats = allSeats.length;
  $: S = getSizes(totalSeats);
  $: pSize = ((totalSeats <= 2 ? 'lg' : totalSeats <= 4 ? 'md' : 'sm') as 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl');
  $: layout = getLayout(totalSeats);

  // Static positions
  $: heroPos    = { x: 50, y: 91 };
  $: heroCardsY = 82;
  $: potY       = 41;
  $: boardY     = 49;
  $: logoY      = 62;

  $: heroIdx = allSeats.findIndex((s: any) => Number(s.userId) === Number(myUserId));
  $: heroArrayIdx = heroIdx >= 0 ? heroIdx : 0;
  $: mySeat = allSeats[heroArrayIdx] ?? null;
  $: opponents = allSeats
    .map((s: any, i: number) => ({ ...s, _arrayIdx: i }))
    .filter((_: any, i: number) => i !== heroArrayIdx);

  // Rotate layout so hero's physical seat maps to layout[0]
  function seatPositionAt(arrayIdx: number): { x: number; y: number } {
    if (totalSeats === 0) return { x: 50, y: 50 };
    const rotated = ((arrayIdx - heroArrayIdx) % totalSeats + totalSeats) % totalSeats;
    return layout[rotated] || { x: 50, y: 50 };
  }

  $: winners = (gameState?.winners && gameState.winners.length > 0)
    ? gameState.winners
    : (handResult?.winners ?? []);

  $: sidePots = gameState?.sidePots ?? [];

  $: isMyTurn = !!(
    gameState &&
    mySeat &&
    gameState.currentSeat === mySeat.seat &&
    !mySeat.folded &&
    !mySeat.allIn &&
    winners.length === 0
  );

  $: totalPot = gameState?.pot ?? 0;

  $: community = (gameState?.community && gameState.community.length > 0)
    ? gameState.community
    : (handResult?.communityCards ?? []);

  $: heroShowdownPlayer = handResult?.showdownPlayers?.find(
    (p: any) => p.seat === mySeat?.seat
  );
  $: heroHole = (mySeat?.hole && mySeat.hole.length > 0)
    ? mySeat.hole
    : (heroShowdownPlayer?.hole ?? []);

  $: serverTime = gameState?.serverTime ?? Date.now();
  $: turnStartedAt = gameState?.turnStartedAt ?? 0;
  $: turnBaseLimit = gameState?.turnBaseLimit ?? 30;

  $: showdownData = (() => {
    if (!winners || winners.length === 0) return null;
    if (!handResult?.showdownPlayers) return null;
    const map: Record<number, { isWinner: boolean; handName: string; payout: number }> = {};
    for (const p of handResult.showdownPlayers) {
      map[p.seat] = { isWinner: !!p.isWinner, handName: p.handName || '', payout: p.payout || 0 };
    }
    return map;
  })();

  function isWinnerSeat(seat: number): boolean { return winners.includes(seat); }
  function inShowdown(seat: number): boolean { return !!(showdownData && showdownData[seat]); }
  function showdownWin(seat: number): boolean { return !!(showdownData && showdownData[seat]?.isWinner); }
  function showdownLose(seat: number): boolean { return !!(showdownData && showdownData[seat] && !showdownData[seat].isWinner); }
  function payoutForSeat(seat: number): number { return showdownData?.[seat]?.payout ?? 0; }

  $: winnerPlayer = handResult?.showdownPlayers?.find((p: any) => p.isWinner);
  $: winnerIsMe = winnerPlayer?.userId === myUserId;
  $: winnerDisplayName = winnerIsMe ? 'You' : (() => {
    const s = allSeats.find((x: any) => x.seat === winnerPlayer?.seat);
    return s?.displayName || 'Winner';
  })();

  $: winningCardKeys = new Set(
    (winnerPlayer?.bestCards ?? []).map((c: any) => `${c.r}${c.s}`)
  );
  function isWinningCard(c: any): boolean {
    return winningCardKeys.has(`${c.r}${c.s}`);
  }

  let chipFlies: { id: number; fromX: number; fromY: number; toX: number; toY: number; delay: number }[] = [];
  let chipFlyIdCounter = 0;

  $: if (winners.length > 0 && totalPot > 0) {
    const flies: typeof chipFlies = [];
    for (const winnerSeat of winners) {
      const winnerSeatInfo = allSeats.find((s: any) => s.seat === winnerSeat);
      if (!winnerSeatInfo) continue;
      const winnerArrayIdx = allSeats.findIndex((s: any) => s.seat === winnerSeat);
      let toX = 50, toY = 91;
      if (winnerSeat === mySeat?.seat) {
        toX = 50; toY = 91;
      } else {
        const p = seatPositionAt(winnerArrayIdx);
        toX = p.x; toY = p.y;
      }
      const payout = showdownData?.[winnerSeat]?.payout ?? 0;
      if (payout > 0) {
        flies.push({ id: ++chipFlyIdCounter, fromX: 50, fromY: potY, toX, toY, delay: 0.3 });
      }
    }
    chipFlies = flies;
  } else {
    chipFlies = [];
  }

  function shortName(name: string): string {
    if (!name) return '?';
    return name;
  }

  $: isFinal = isFinalTable;
</script>

  >
    <!-- Table image -->
    <img

========== FILE: apps\mini-app\src\components\AdminPrompt.svelte ==========
<script lang="ts">
  import { adminPromptOpen, confirmAdmin, cancelAdmin } from '../stores/admin';

  let secret = '';
  let busy = false;
  let error = '';
  let shake = false;

  $: if ($adminPromptOpen) {
    secret = '';
    error = '';
    busy = false;
    shake = false;
  }

  async function tryLogin() {
    if (!secret || busy) return;
    busy = true;
    error = '';
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/admin/stats', {
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          Authorization: `Bearer ${secret}`,
        },
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        localStorage.setItem('admin_secret', secret);
        confirmAdmin();
      } else {
        error = 'رمز اشتباه است';
        shake = true;
        setTimeout(() => (shake = false), 500);
        secret = '';
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message || 'network error';
    } finally {
      busy = false;
    }
  }

  function close() {
    if (busy) return;
    cancelAdmin();
  }
</script>

{#if $adminPromptOpen}
  <div
    class="fixed inset-0 z-[9999] flex items-center justify-center px-4"
    style="background: rgba(5,8,15,0.92); backdrop-filter: blur(8px);"
    on:click={close}
    role="presentation"
  >
    <div
      class="w-full max-w-sm rounded-3xl p-6 relative"
      class:shake
      style="..."
      on:click={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      on:keydown={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label="Admin access"
      tabindex="-1"
    >
      <div class="flex justify-center mb-4">
        <div
          class="w-16 h-16 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-center"
          style="
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(212,175,55,0.15), rgba(168,122,21,0.08));

      </h2>
      <p class="text-center text-[11px] text-white/50 mb-5">
        Enter your admin secret key
      </p>

      <input
        type="password"
        bind:value={secret}
        on:keydown={(e) => e.key === 'Enter' && tryLogin()}
        placeholder="Admin secret"
        autocomplete="off"
        disabled={busy}
        class="w-full rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-sm text-white outline-none font-mono tracking-wider mb-3 disabled:opacity-50"
        style="
          background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);

        <button

          disabled={busy}
          class="flex-1 rounded-xl py-2.5 text-[12px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider disabled:opacity-40"
          style="
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);

          on:click={tryLogin}

          "
        >
          {busy ? 'Checking…' : 'Unlock'}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
{/if}

<script lang="ts">
  import { onDestroy } from 'svelte';
  import Avatar from './Avatar.svelte';
  import type { TableSocketIO, ChatMessage } from '../lib/socket';

  export let open: boolean = false;
  export let myUserId: number | null = null;
  export let myAvatarId: string = 'spade';
  export let socket: TableSocketIO | null = null;
  export let onClose: () => void = () => {};

  let messages: ChatMessage[] = [];
  let inputText = '';
  let messagesEl: HTMLDivElement | null = null;
  let sending = false;
  let errorMsg = '';
  let lastSendAt = 0;

  const QUICK_EMOJIS = ['👋', '😎', '🔥', '👍', '😂', '😱', '👏', '🤑', '🤝', '🍀'];

  const QUICK_CHAT = [
    'Nice hand!',
    'gg',
    'well played',
    'nice river',
    'ouch',
    'all in?',
    'call',
    'fold',
  ];

  function scrollToBottom() {
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (messagesEl) messagesEl.scrollTop = messagesEl.scrollHeight;
    }, 30);
  }

  async function sendMessage(text: string, isEmoji = false) {
    const trimmed = text.trim();
    if (!trimmed || sending || !socket) return;

    // client-side cooldown feedback
    const now = Date.now();
    if (now - lastSendAt < 1200) {
      errorMsg = 'Slow down…';
      setTimeout(() => (errorMsg = ''), 1500);
      return;
    }
    lastSendAt = now;

    sending = true;
    errorMsg = '';
    try {
      const res = await socket.sendChat(trimmed, isEmoji);
      if (!res.ok) {
        if (res.code === 'RATE_LIMIT') errorMsg = 'Slow down…';
        else if (res.code === 'TOO_LONG') errorMsg = 'Message too long';
        else if (res.code === 'NOT_IN_TABLE') errorMsg = 'Not seated at table';
        else errorMsg = 'Failed to send';
        setTimeout(() => (errorMsg = ''), 2000);
      } else {
        inputText = '';
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      errorMsg = e.message;
      setTimeout(() => (errorMsg = ''), 2000);
    } finally {
      sending = false;
    }
  }

  function sendEmoji(emoji: string) {
    sendMessage(emoji, true);
  }

  function handleKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey) {
      e.preventDefault();
      sendMessage(inputText);
    }
  }

  // ===== Subscribe to socket events =====
  let unsub: (() => void) | null = null;

  $: if (socket && open && !unsub) {
    unsub = socket.on((evt) => {
      if (evt.type === 'chat') {
        messages = [...messages, evt.message];
        scrollToBottom();
      }
    });

    // Load history
    socket.requestChatHistory().then((hist) => {
      if (hist.length > 0) {
        messages = hist;
        scrollToBottom();
      }
    });
  }

  $: if (!open && unsub) {
    unsub();
    unsub = null;
    // clear on close
    setTimeout(() => { messages = []; }, 200);
  }

  $: if (open) {
    setTimeout(scrollToBottom, 100);
  }

  onDestroy(() => {
    if (unsub) unsub();
  });
</script>

        </div>
      {:else}
        {#each messages as m (m.id)}
          {@const isMine = m.userId === myUserId}

            <div class="max-w-[75%] {isMine ? 'items-end' : 'items-start'} flex flex-col">

                 style="color: {isMine ? '#f4e5a8' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)'};">
                {isMine ? 'You' : m.displayName}
              </p>
              <div

                  background: {isMine

                  color: {isMine ? '#0a0800' : '#ffffff'};
                  border: 1px solid {isMine ? 'rgba(255,235,170,0.4)' : 'rgba(212,175,55,0.2)'};
                  box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
                  {m.isEmoji ? 'font-size: 28px; line-height: 1; padding: 6px 10px;' : 'font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600;'}

========== FILE: apps\mini-app\src\components\DailyRefillButton.svelte ==========
<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount } from 'svelte';
  import { api } from '../lib/api';
  import { auth } from '../stores/auth';

  let status: any = null;
  let busy = false;
  let toast = '';

  async function load() {
    try {
      const res = await api.request('/api/daily-refill/status');
      if (res.ok) status = res.data;
    } catch {}
  }

  async function claim() {
    if (busy) return;
    busy = true;
    try {
      const res = await api.request<{ ok: boolean; amount: number }>(
        '/api/daily-refill/claim',
        { method: 'POST', body: '{}' },
      );
      if (res.ok && res.data) {
        toast = `+${(res.data as any).amount.toLocaleString()} chips!`;
        await auth.refresh();
        await load();
        setTimeout(() => (toast = ''), 2500);
      }
    } finally { busy = false; }
  }

  onMount(load);
</script>

{#if status}
  <button
    on:click={claim}
    disabled={!status.canClaim || busy}
    class="w-full rounded-2xl p-3 active:scale-[0.98] transition disabled:opacity-60"
    style="background: {status.canClaim ? 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(34,197,94,0.25), rgba(5,150,105,0.1))' : 'rgba(15,31,58,0.6)'}; border: 1.5px solid {status.canClaim ? 'rgba(34,197,94,0.5)' : 'rgba(212,175,55,0.15)'};"
  >
    <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5">
      <span class="text-2xl">{status.tierIcon}</span>
      <div class="flex-1 text-left">
        <p class="text-[10px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider" style="color: {status.canClaim ? '#6ee7b7' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.5)'};">
          {status.canClaim ? 'Daily Refill · Ready!' : 'Daily Refill · Claimed'}
        </p>
        <p class="text-[14px] font-extrabold text-white tabular-nums">

<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount, onDestroy } from 'svelte';
  import { api } from '../lib/api';
  import { serverOffset } from '../lib/serverTime';

  export let onOpen: (id: number) => void = () => {};

  let freeroll: any = null;
  let eligibility: any = null;
  let loading = true;
  let nowMs = Date.now();
  let timer: any = null;

  async function load() {
    loading = true;
    try {
      const [fr, el] = await Promise.all([
        api.request<{ freeroll: any }>('/api/freeroll/next'),
        api.request<{ eligible: boolean; lifetimeDepositUsd: number; minRequired: number }>(
          '/api/freeroll/eligibility',
        ),
      ]);
      freeroll = fr.ok ? (fr.data as any)?.freeroll : null;
      eligibility = el.ok ? el.data : null;
    } finally {
      loading = false;
    }
  }

  onMount(() => {
    load();
    timer = setInterval(() => {
      nowMs = Date.now();
    }, 1000);
    const reload = setInterval(load, 30_000);
    return () => {
      if (timer) clearInterval(timer);
      clearInterval(reload);
    };
  });

  onDestroy(() => {
    if (timer) clearInterval(timer);
  });

  $: now = nowMs + $serverOffset;
  $: startAt = freeroll ? new Date(freeroll.scheduled_start).getTime() : 0;
  $: remainingMs = Math.max(0, startAt - now);
  $: isLive = freeroll?.status === 'running';
  $: isPast = freeroll && remainingMs === 0 && !isLive;

  $: countdown = (() => {
    if (remainingMs <= 0) return 'Starting now';
    const s = Math.floor(remainingMs / 1000);
    const h = Math.floor(s / 3600);
    const m = Math.floor((s % 3600) / 60);
    const sec = s % 60;
    if (h > 0) return `${h}h ${m}m ${sec}s`;
    if (m > 0) return `${m}m ${sec}s`;
    return `${sec}s`;
  })();

  function fmt(n: any): string {
    return `$${Number(n || 0).toFixed(2)}`;
  }
</script>

{#if !loading && freeroll && !isPast}
  <button
    on:click={() => onOpen(freeroll.id)}
    class="mx-4 mb-4 w-[calc(100%-2rem)] rounded-3xl p-4 text-left active:scale-[0.98] transition relative overflow-hidden"
    style="
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse at 100% 0%, rgba(244,201,93,0.35) 0%, transparent 55%),

    ></div>

    <div class="relative flex items-center gap-3">

<script lang="ts">
  import { api } from '../lib/api';
  import PlayingCard from './PlayingCard.svelte';

  export let open: boolean = false;
  export let onClose: () => void = () => {};
  export let onReplay: (handId: number) => void = () => {};

  let view: 'list' | 'detail' = 'list';
  let hands: any[] = [];
  let selectedHand: any = null;
  let selectedDetail: any = null;
  let loading = false;
  let error = '';
  let activeTab: 'summary' | 'actions' | 'results' = 'summary';

  let searchQuery = '';
  let filter: 'all' | 'won' | 'lost' | 'real' | 'free' = 'all';

  function fmt(n: any): string {
    return Number(Number(n || 0).toFixed(2)).toFixed(2);
  }

  function suitChar(s: string): '♠' | '♥' | '♦' | '♣' {
    if (s === 's') return '♠';
    if (s === 'h') return '♥';
    if (s === 'd') return '♦';
    return '♣';
  }

  function fmtDate(iso: string): string {
    try {
      const d = new Date(iso);
      return d.toLocaleString('en-US', {
        month: 'short',
        day: 'numeric',
        hour: '2-digit',
        minute: '2-digit',
      });
    } catch {
      return iso;
    }
  }

  // Winners from hand
  $: myUserId = null; // will be filled from localStorage token or prop

  async function loadHands() {
    loading = true;
    error = '';
    try {
      const res = await api.getRecentHands(50);
      if (res.ok && res.data) hands = res.data.hands || [];
      else error = res.error || 'failed';
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    } finally {
      loading = false;
    }
  }

  async function openHand(h: any) {
    selectedHand = h;
    loading = true;
    error = '';
    try {
      const res = await api.getHandDetail(h.id);
      if (res.ok && res.data) {
        selectedDetail = res.data;
        view = 'detail';
        activeTab = 'summary';
      } else error = res.error || 'failed';
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    } finally {
      loading = false;
    }
  }

  function goBack() {
    view = 'list';
    selectedHand = null;
    selectedDetail = null;
  }

  $: if (open && hands.length === 0 && !loading) loadHands();

  $: filteredHands = hands.filter((h) => {
    if (searchQuery) {
      const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      const hay = `${h.handNo} ${h.tableName} ${h.variant}`.toLowerCase();
      if (!hay.includes(q)) return false;
    }
    if (filter === 'won') return h.isWin === true;
    if (filter === 'lost') return h.isWin === false;
    if (filter === 'real') return h.mode === 'real';
    if (filter === 'free') return h.mode === 'free';
    return true;
  });

  $: actionsByStreet = (() => {
    const result: Record<string, any[]> = {
      preflop: [],
      flop: [],
      turn: [],
      river: [],
    };
    if (!selectedDetail?.events) return result;

    let street = 'preflop';
    for (const evt of selectedDetail.events) {
      const phase = evt.payload?.phase;
      if (phase === 'flop') street = 'flop';
      else if (phase === 'turn') street = 'turn';
      else if (phase === 'river') street = 'river';
      if (evt.type === 'ACTION_TAKEN') result[street].push(evt.payload);
    }
    return result;
  })();
</script>

========== FILE: apps\mini-app\src\components\HandReplayModal.svelte ==========
<script lang="ts">
  import { onDestroy } from 'svelte';
  import { api } from '../lib/api';
  import PlayingCard from './PlayingCard.svelte';
  import Avatar from './Avatar.svelte';

  export let open: boolean = false;
  export let handId: number | null = null;
  export let onClose: () => void = () => {};

  let loading = false;
  let error = '';
  let replay: any = null;
  let states: any[] = [];
  let step = 0;
  let playing = false;
  let speed = 1;
  let playInterval: any = null;

  function fmt(n: any): string {
    return Number(Number(n || 0).toFixed(2)).toFixed(2);
  }

  function suitChar(s: string): '♠' | '♥' | '♦' | '♣' {
    if (s === 's') return '♠';
    if (s === 'h') return '♥';
    if (s === 'd') return '♦';
    return '♣';
  }

  const ANGLE_MAP: Record<number, number[]> = {
    2: [90, 270],
    3: [90, 210, 330],
    4: [90, 180, 270, 0],
    5: [90, 162, 234, 306, 18],
    6: [90, 150, 210, 270, 330, 30],
    7: [90, 141, 193, 244, 296, 347, 38],
    8: [90, 135, 180, 225, 270, 315, 0, 45],
    9: [90, 130, 170, 210, 250, 290, 330, 10, 50],
  };

  function seatPos(idx: number, total: number): { x: number; y: number } {
    const angles = ANGLE_MAP[total] || ANGLE_MAP[6];
    const deg = angles[idx] ?? 90;
    const rad = (deg * Math.PI) / 180;
    const rx = total === 2 ? 36 : 42;
    const ry = total === 2 ? 32 : 34;
    return { x: 50 + Math.cos(rad) * rx, y: 50 + Math.sin(rad) * ry };
  }

  async function load() {
    if (!handId) return;
    loading = true;
    error = '';
    try {
      const res = await api.getHandReplay(handId);
      if (res.ok && res.data) {
        replay = res.data;
        states = buildStates(res.data);
        step = 0;
      } else {
        error = res.error || 'failed';
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    } finally {
      loading = false;
    }
  }

  function buildStates(data: any): any[] {
    const { hand, initialSnapshot, events } = data;
    const initialPlayers = (initialSnapshot?.players || []).map((p: any) => ({
      seat: p.seat,
      userId: p.userId,
      displayName: p.displayName,
      stack: Number(p.stack || 0),
      betThisStreet: 0,
      folded: false,
      allIn: false,
    }));

    const blinds = initialSnapshot?.blinds || { sb: 0, bb: 0, ante: 0 };
    const initialPot =
      (blinds.sb || 0) + (blinds.bb || 0) + (blinds.ante || 0) * initialPlayers.length;

    const result: any[] = [];
    const currentState: any = {
  phase: 'preflop',
  pot: initialPot,
  community: [] as any[],
  players: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(initialPlayers)),
  lastAction: null,
};
    result.push(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(currentState)));

    let prevPhase = 'preflop';
    const allCommunity = hand?.community_cards || [];

    for (const evt of events) {
      const payload = evt.payload || {};
      const phase = payload.phase;

      if (phase && phase !== prevPhase) {
        for (const p of currentState.players) p.betThisStreet = 0;
        prevPhase = phase;
        currentState.phase = phase;
      }

      if (payload.pot !== undefined) currentState.pot = Number(payload.pot);

      const seat = Number(payload.seat);
      const player = currentState.players.find((p: any) => p.seat === seat);
      if (player) {
        const action = String(payload.action || '').toUpperCase();
        const amount = Number(payload.amount || 0);

        if (action === 'FOLD') {
          player.folded = true;
        } else if (action === 'CALL') {
          const cost = Math.min(amount || player.betThisStreet, player.stack);
          player.stack = Math.max(0, player.stack - cost);
          player.betThisStreet += cost;
          if (player.stack === 0) player.allIn = true;
        } else if (action === 'RAISE' || action === 'BET') {
          const prev = player.betThisStreet;
          const increment = Math.max(0, amount - prev);
          player.stack = Math.max(0, player.stack - increment);
          player.betThisStreet = amount;
          if (player.stack === 0) player.allIn = true;
        }
      }

      if (currentState.phase === 'flop') {
        currentState.community = allCommunity.slice(0, 3);
      } else if (currentState.phase === 'turn') {
        currentState.community = allCommunity.slice(0, 4);
      } else if (currentState.phase === 'river' || currentState.phase === 'showdown') {
        currentState.community = allCommunity.slice(0, 5);
      }

      currentState.lastAction = {
        seat,
        action: payload.action,
        amount: payload.amount || 0,
        displayName: player?.displayName || `Seat ${seat}`,
      };

      result.push(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(currentState)));
    }

    const winners = hand?.winner_seats || [];
    const lastState = result[result.length - 1];
    for (const p of lastState.players) {
      if (winners.includes(p.seat)) (p as any).isWinner = true;
    }

    return result;
  }

  function togglePlay() {
    if (playing) {
      stopPlay();
      playing = false;
    } else {
      if (step >= states.length - 1) step = 0;
      playing = true;
      startPlay();
    }
  }

  function startPlay() {
    stopPlay();
    const interval = 1500 / speed;
    playInterval = setInterval(() => {
      if (step < states.length - 1) {
        step++;
      } else {
        stopPlay();
        playing = false;
      }
    }, interval);
  }

  function stopPlay() {
    if (playInterval) {
      clearInterval(playInterval);
      playInterval = null;
    }
  }

  function skip(delta: number) {
    step = Math.max(0, Math.min(states.length - 1, step + delta));
  }

  function setSpeed(s: number) {
    speed = s;
    if (playing) startPlay();
  }

  function goToStreet(street: string) {
    const idx = states.findIndex((s: any) => s.phase === street);
    if (idx >= 0) step = idx;
  }

  $: if (open && handId && !loading && (!replay || replay.hand?.id !== handId)) {
    load();
  }

  $: if (!open) {
    stopPlay();
    playing = false;
  }

  $: currentState = states[step] || null;
  $: currentStreet = currentState?.phase || 'preflop';
  $: progressPct = states.length > 1 ? (step / (states.length - 1)) * 100 : 0;

  onDestroy(() => stopPlay());
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount } from 'svelte';
  import { cardTheme, CARD_THEMES } from '../stores/cardTheme';
import { preferences } from '../lib/preferences';

  export let rank: string = 'A';
  export let suit: '♠' | '♥' | '♦' | '♣' = '♠';
  export let size: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' = 'md';
  export let rotation: number = 0;
  export let faceDown: boolean = false;
  export let selected: boolean = false;
  export let dim: boolean = false;
  export let themeOverride: string | null = null;

  // Animation props
  export let dealFrom: 'none' | 'top-left' | 'top-right' | 'top' = 'none';
  export let dealDelay: number = 0;
  export let folding: boolean = false;

  const sizes = {
    xs: { w: 26, h: 36 },
    sm: { w: 34, h: 48 },
    md: { w: 50, h: 70 },
    lg: { w: 64, h: 90 },
    xl: { w: 82, h: 115 },
  };
  $: s = sizes[size];
  $: radius = Math.max(3, s.w * 0.09);

  const RANK_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
    A: '1', K: 'king', Q: 'queen', J: 'jack',
    T: '10', '10': '10',
    '9': '9', '8': '8', '7': '7', '6': '6',
    '5': '5', '4': '4', '3': '3', '2': '2',
  };
  const SUIT_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
    '♠': 'spade', '♥': 'heart', '♦': 'diamond', '♣': 'club',
  };

  $: rankFile = RANK_MAP[rank.toUpperCase()] ?? '1';
  $: suitFile = SUIT_MAP[suit] ?? 'spade';
  $: activeThemeId = themeOverride ?? $cardTheme;
  $: theme = CARD_THEMES.find((t) => t.id === activeThemeId) ?? CARD_THEMES[0];
  $: cardSrc = theme.path.replace('{suit}', suitFile).replace('{rank}', rankFile);

  $: backSrc =
    activeThemeId === 'luxury' ? '/card-back-classic.png' :
    activeThemeId === 'neon' ? '/card-back-dark.png' :
    '/card-back-royal.png';

  $: cssFilter = theme.filter && theme.filter !== 'none' ? theme.filter : 'none';
  $: frontFilter = dim ? 'brightness(0.55) saturate(0.5)' : cssFilter;

  // ---- Deal animation (once on mount) ----
  let playDeal = false;
  onMount(() => {
    if (dealFrom !== 'none') {
      playDeal = true;
      const totalMs = (dealDelay + 0.7) * 1000;
      const t = setTimeout(() => { playDeal = false; }, totalMs);
      return () => clearTimeout(t);
    }
  });

  $: dealClass = playDeal ? 'deal-in' : '';
  $: foldClass = folding ? 'fold-out' : '';
  $: dealVars =
    dealFrom === 'top-left' ? '--dx: -50vw; --dy: -40vh;' :
    dealFrom === 'top-right' ? '--dx: 50vw; --dy: -40vh;' :
    dealFrom === 'top' ? '--dx: 0vw; --dy: -40vh;' :
    '';
</script>

<div
  class="card-outer"
  style="
    width: {s.w}px;
    height: {s.h}px;
    transform: rotate({rotation}deg);
    {dealVars}
  "
>
  <div
    class="card-anim {dealClass} {foldClass}"
    style="
      animation-delay: {dealDelay}s;
      {$preferences.animations ? '' : 'animation: none !important;'}
    "
  >
    <div
      class="card-inner"
      style="
        transform: {selected ? 'translateY(-6px) scale(1.05)' : ''} rotateY({faceDown ? 180 : 0}deg);
      "
    >
      <!-- FRONT (actual card face) — flipped 180 so it appears when faceDown=true turns to 180 -->
      <img
        src={cardSrc}
        alt="{rank}{suit}"
        class="card-face card-front"
        style="
          border-radius: {radius}px;
          filter: {frontFilter} {$preferences.fourColor && suit === '♦' ? 'hue-rotate(160deg) saturate(2.5)' : ''} {$preferences.fourColor && suit === '♣' ? 'hue-rotate(80deg) saturate(2)' : ''};
        "
        draggable="false"
        on:error={() => console.warn('[PlayingCard] 404:', cardSrc)}
      />
      <!-- BACK (card back) -->
      <img
        src={backSrc}
        alt=""
        class="card-face card-back"
        style="border-radius: {radius}px;"
        draggable="false"
      />
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

  export let amount: number = 0;
  export let size: number = 28;
  export let maxStack: number = 5;

  // Animation props
  export let animate: boolean = true;   // pop-in on mount
  export let pulse: boolean = false;    // winner highlight
  export let collecting: boolean = false; // fly-away when pot collected

  const DENOMS = [
    { value: 1,       row: 0, col: 0 },
    { value: 5,       row: 0, col: 1 },
    { value: 25,      row: 0, col: 2 },
    { value: 100,     row: 0, col: 3 },
    { value: 500,     row: 1, col: 0 },
    { value: 1000,    row: 1, col: 1 },
    { value: 5000,    row: 1, col: 2 },
    { value: 10000,   row: 1, col: 3 },
    { value: 50000,   row: 2, col: 0 },
    { value: 100000,  row: 2, col: 1 },
    { value: 500000,  row: 2, col: 2 },
    { value: 1000000, row: 2, col: 3 },
  ];

  function breakdown(amt: number) {
    const result: { value: number; row: number; col: number; count: number }[] = [];
    let remaining = Math.round(amt * 100) / 100;
    for (let i = DENOMS.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const d = DENOMS[i];
      if (remaining >= d.value) {
        const count = Math.floor(remaining / d.value);
        result.push({ ...d, count });
        remaining -= count * d.value;
      }
    }
    if (result.length === 0 && amt > 0) result.push({ ...DENOMS[0], count: 1 });
    return result;
  }

  $: stacks = breakdown(amount);

  let mounted = false;
  onMount(() => {
    const t = setTimeout(() => (mounted = true), 15);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  });

  $: disabled = !$preferences.animations || $preferences.graphics === 'performance';
  $: popClass = animate && !mounted && !disabled ? 'chip-pop-in' : '';
  $: pulseClass = pulse && !disabled ? 'chip-pulse' : '';
  $: collectClass = collecting && !disabled ? 'chip-collect' : '';
</script>

{#if amount > 0}
  <div
    class="chip-root {popClass} {pulseClass} {collectClass}"
    style="gap: {size * 0.1}px;"
  >
    {#each stacks as s}
      <div
        class="relative"
        style="
          width: {size}px;
          height: {size + (Math.min(s.count, maxStack) - 1) * (size * 0.16)}px;
        "
      >
        {#each Array(Math.min(s.count, maxStack)) as _, i}
          <div
            class="absolute"
            style="
              width: {size}px;
              height: {size}px;
              bottom: {i * (size * 0.16)}px;
              left: 0;
              background-image: url('/chips-set-hq.png');
              background-size: 400% 300%;
              background-position: {(s.col * 100) / 3}% {(s.row * 100) / 2}%;
              background-repeat: no-repeat;
              filter: drop-shadow(0 {size * 0.06}px {size * 0.1}px rgba(0,0,0,0.7));
              animation-delay: {i * 0.03}s;
            "
          ></div>
        {/each}

        {#if s.count > maxStack}
          <div
            class="absolute -top-2 -right-2 rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-extrabold z-10"
            style="
              background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f4e5a8, #d4af37 45%, #a87a15);
              color: #0a0800;
              box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,235,170,0.5);
              line-height: 1;
            "
          >
            ×{s.count}
          </div>
        {/if}
      </div>
    {/each}
  </div>
{/if}

<script lang="ts">
  import PlayingCard from './PlayingCard.svelte';
  import PokerChip from './PokerChip.svelte';
  import Avatar from './Avatar.svelte';
  import TimerRing from './TimerRing.svelte';

  export let gameState: any = null;
  export let myUserId: number | null = null;
  export let myAvatarId: string = 'spade';
  export let theme: 'cash' | 'tournament' = 'cash';
  export let tournamentTitle: string = '';
  export let isEliminated: boolean = false;
  export let handResult: any = null;
  export let isFinalTable: boolean = false;
  export let onPlayerClick: (userId: number) => void = () => {};
  export let compact: boolean = false;

  function fmt(n: any): string {
    return Number(Number(n || 0).toFixed(2)).toFixed(2);
  }

  function suitChar(s: string): '♠' | '♥' | '♦' | '♣' {
    if (s === 's') return '♠';
    if (s === 'h') return '♥';
    if (s === 'd') return '♦';
    return '♣';
  }

  type Sizes = {
    avatarPx: number;
    avatarBorder: number;
    panelMinW: number;
    panelPad: string;
    nameFont: number;
    stackFont: number;
    holeCardSize: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';
    boardCardSize: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md';
    holeGap: number;
    holeTop: number;
    heroTop: number;
    heroAvatarPx: number;
    timerSize: number;
    timerHeroSize: number;
    potFont: number;
    potChipSize: number;
    seatMT: number;
    betFont: number;
    betChipSize: number;
  };

  function getSizes(isCompact: boolean): Sizes {
    if (isCompact) {
      return {
        avatarPx: 38, avatarBorder: 2, panelMinW: 54, panelPad: '1px 6px',
        nameFont: 9, stackFont: 9, holeCardSize: 'sm', boardCardSize: 'sm',
        holeGap: 1, holeTop: 74, heroTop: 92, heroAvatarPx: 46,
        timerSize: 52, timerHeroSize: 58, potFont: 11, potChipSize: 13,
        seatMT: 4, betFont: 9, betChipSize: 10,
      };
    }
    return {
      avatarPx: 52, avatarBorder: 3, panelMinW: 72, panelPad: '2px 10px',
      nameFont: 10, stackFont: 10, holeCardSize: 'lg', boardCardSize: 'md',
      holeGap: 2, holeTop: 68, heroTop: 92, heroAvatarPx: 64,
      timerSize: 70, timerHeroSize: 78, potFont: 14, potChipSize: 16,
      seatMT: 8, betFont: 11, betChipSize: 12,
    };
  }

  $: SZ = getSizes(compact);

  const BASE_ANGLES: Record<number, number[]> = {
    2: [90, 270],
    3: [90, 210, 330],
    4: [90, 180, 270, 0],
    5: [90, 162, 234, 306, 18],
    6: [90, 150, 210, 270, 330, 30],
  };

  function seatPos(rotatedIdx: number, total: number): { x: number; y: number } {
    const angles = BASE_ANGLES[total] || BASE_ANGLES[6];
    const deg = angles[rotatedIdx] ?? 90;
    const rad = (deg * Math.PI) / 180;
    const rx = total === 2 ? 38 : 44;
    const ry = total === 2 ? 34 : 34;
    return {
      x: 50 + Math.cos(rad) * rx,
      y: 50 + Math.sin(rad) * ry,
    };
  }

  function towardCenter(px: number, py: number, dist: number): { x: number; y: number } {
    const dx = 50 - px;
    const dy = 50 - py;
    const len = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
    if (len === 0) return { x: 0, y: 0 };
    return { x: (dx / len) * dist, y: (dy / len) * dist };
  }

  $: allSeats = gameState?.seats ?? [];
  $: totalSeats = allSeats.length;
  $: heroIdx = allSeats.findIndex((s: any) => s.userId === myUserId);
  $: mySeat = heroIdx >= 0 ? allSeats[heroIdx] : null;
  $: opponents = allSeats.filter((s: any) => s.userId !== myUserId);

  $: isMyTurn = !!(
    gameState &&
    mySeat &&
    gameState.currentSeat === mySeat.seat &&
    !mySeat.folded &&
    !mySeat.allIn &&
    winners.length === 0
  );

  $: totalPot = gameState?.pot ?? 0;
  $: community = gameState?.community ?? [];
  $: serverTime = gameState?.serverTime ?? Date.now();
  $: turnStartedAt = gameState?.turnStartedAt ?? 0;
  $: turnBaseLimit = gameState?.turnBaseLimit ?? 30;

  $: winners = gameState?.winners ?? [];
  $: sidePots = gameState?.sidePots ?? [];

  function oppPos(opponentSeatIdx: number): { x: number; y: number } {
    if (heroIdx < 0) return { x: 50, y: 10 };
    const rotated = (opponentSeatIdx - heroIdx + totalSeats) % totalSeats;
    return seatPos(rotated, totalSeats);
  }

  $: showdownData = (() => {
    if (!winners || winners.length === 0) return null;
    if (!handResult?.showdownPlayers) return null;
    const map: Record<number, { isWinner: boolean; handName: string; payout: number }> = {};
    for (const p of handResult.showdownPlayers) {
      map[p.seat] = {
        isWinner: !!p.isWinner,
        handName: p.handName || '',
        payout: p.payout || 0,
      };
    }
    return map;
  })();

  function isWinnerSeat(seat: number): boolean {
    return winners.includes(seat);
  }

  function inShowdown(seat: number): boolean {
    return !!(showdownData && showdownData[seat]);
  }

  function showdownWin(seat: number): boolean {
    return !!(showdownData && showdownData[seat]?.isWinner);
  }

  function showdownLose(seat: number): boolean {
    return !!(showdownData && showdownData[seat] && !showdownData[seat].isWinner);
  }

  function handName(seat: number): string {
    return showdownData?.[seat]?.handName || '';
  }

  function payoutForSeat(seat: number): number {
    return showdownData?.[seat]?.payout ?? 0;
  }

  let chipVisible = false;
  let chipLeft = 50;
  let chipTop = 40;
  let lastAnimatedHandNo = -1;

  $: if (winners.length > 0 && gameState?.handNo !== lastAnimatedHandNo) {
    lastAnimatedHandNo = gameState.handNo;
    const winnerSeat = winners[0];
    const winnerData = allSeats.find((s: any) => s.seat === winnerSeat);

    if (winnerData && winnerData.userId !== myUserId) {
      const pos = oppPos(winnerData.seat);
      chipVisible = true;
      chipLeft = 50;
      chipTop = 30;
      setTimeout(() => {
        chipLeft = pos.x;
        chipTop = pos.y + 6;
      }, 80);
      setTimeout(() => {
        chipVisible = false;
      }, 2000);
    } else {
      chipVisible = true;
      chipLeft = 50;
      chipTop = 30;
      setTimeout(() => {
        chipLeft = 50;
        chipTop = 88;
      }, 80);
      setTimeout(() => {
        chipVisible = false;
      }, 2000);
    }
  }
</script>

========== FILE: apps\mini-app\src\components\SeedClaimModal.svelte ==========
<script lang="ts">
  import { api } from '../lib/api';
  import { auth } from '../stores/auth';

  export let open = false;
  export let seed: any = null;
  export let onClose: () => void = () => {};

  let busy = false;
  let error = '';
  let success = false;

  $: if (open && seed) { busy = false; error = ''; success = false; }

  async function claim() {
    if (!seed || busy) return;
    busy = true; error = '';
    try {
      const res = await api.request<{ ok: boolean; amount: number }>('/api/seeds/claim', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ type: seed.type }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        success = true;
        await auth.refresh();
        setTimeout(() => onClose(), 1800);
      } else {
        error = res.error || 'claim_failed';
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    } finally {
      busy = false;
    }
  }
</script>

{#if open && seed}
  <button aria-label="Close" class="fixed inset-0 z-[95] cursor-default" style="background: rgba(0,0,0,0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(4px);" on:click={onClose}></button>
  <div class="fixed top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-[100] rounded-3xl p-5 w-[90%] max-w-[360px]" style="background: linear-gradient(180deg, #101a3a, #080d24); border: 1.5px solid rgba(34,197,94,0.5); box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.9);">
    <div class="text-center mb-4">
      <div class="text-5xl mb-2">{seed.icon}</div>
      <h2 class="text-lg font-extrabold text-white">{seed.label}</h2>
      <p class="text-[11px] text-white/50 mt-1">{seed.progress.freeHands.toLocaleString()} hands · {seed.progress.freeWins.toLocaleString()} wins</p>
    </div>
    <div class="rounded-2xl p-4 mb-4 text-center" style="background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(34,197,94,0.15), rgba(5,150,105,0.05)); border: 1px solid rgba(34,197,94,0.4);">
      <p class="text-[10px] text-emerald-300/80 uppercase tracking-wider font-bold mb-1">Reward</p>
      <p class="text-3xl font-extrabold text-emerald-400 tabular-nums">${seed.amount.toFixed(2)}</p>
      <p class="text-[10px] text-white/50 mt-2 leading-relaxed">10x playthrough · $15 rake · 150 real hands · 14 days</p>
    </div>
    {#if success}
      <div class="rounded-xl p-3 text-center mb-4" style="background: rgba(16,185,129,0.2); border: 1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.5);">
        <p class="text-[12px] font-extrabold text-emerald-300">✅ Claimed! ${seed.amount.toFixed(2)} added</p>
      </div>
    {:else}
      <div class="flex gap-2">
        <button on:click={onClose} disabled={busy} class="flex-1 rounded-xl py-3 text-[12px] font-extrabold active:scale-95" style="background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);">Cancel</button>
        <button on:click={claim} disabled={busy} class="flex-1 rounded-xl py-3 text-[12px] font-extrabold active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-40" style="background: linear-gradient(180deg, #22c55e, #15803d); color: white; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #14532d;">{busy ? '…' : 'Claim'}</button>
      </div>
      {#if error}<p class="text-[11px] text-red-300 text-center mt-3">{error}</p>{/if}
    {/if}
  </div>
{/if}

========== FILE: apps\mini-app\src\components\TimerRing.svelte ==========
<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount } from 'svelte';

  export let size: number = 80;
  export let strokeWidth: number = 4;
  export let startedAt: number = 0;
  export let limitSec: number = 30;
  export let serverTime: number = Date.now();
  export let active: boolean = true;
  export let color: string = '#3b82f6';
  export let paused: boolean = false;
  export let dangerThreshold: number = 5;
  export let warningThreshold: number = 10;

  let now = Date.now();
  let timer: any = null;

  // Sync offset with server time (client clock may drift)
  let serverOffset = 0;
  $: if (serverTime > 0) {
    const clientAtReceive = Date.now();
    // We assume serverTime was captured ~now
    serverOffset = serverTime - clientAtReceive;
  }

  onMount(() => {
    timer = setInterval(() => (now = Date.now()), 100);
    return () => {
      if (timer) clearInterval(timer);
    };
  });

  // Paused = freeze elapsed at the moment pause started
  let pausedAt: number | null = null;
  $: if (paused && pausedAt === null) {
    pausedAt = now;
  } else if (!paused && pausedAt !== null) {
    pausedAt = null;
  }

  $: effectiveNow = paused && pausedAt !== null ? pausedAt : now + serverOffset;
  $: elapsed = Math.max(0, (effectiveNow - startedAt) / 1000);
  $: remaining = Math.max(0, limitSec - elapsed);
  $: pct = limitSec > 0 ? remaining / limitSec : 0;

  // If a custom color is provided, use it; otherwise use tiered color
  $: useCustomColor = color && color !== '#3b82f6';
  $: tieredColor =
    remaining <= dangerThreshold
      ? '#ef4444'
      : remaining <= warningThreshold
        ? '#f59e0b'
        : '#10b981';
  $: timerColor = useCustomColor ? color : tieredColor;

  $: radius = (size - strokeWidth) / 2;
  $: circumference = 2 * Math.PI * radius;
  $: dashOffset = circumference * (1 - pct);

  $: displaySec = Math.ceil(remaining);
  $: isPulsing = remaining <= dangerThreshold && active && remaining > 0 && !paused;
</script>

{#if active && (remaining > 0 || paused)}
  <div
    class="timer-ring"
    class:pulsing={isPulsing}
    style="width: {size}px; height: {size}px;"
  >
    <svg
      width={size}
      height={size}
      viewBox="0 0 {size} {size}"
      style="transform: rotate(-90deg);"
    >
      <circle
        cx={size / 2}
        cy={size / 2}
        r={radius}
        fill="none"
        stroke="rgba(0,0,0,0.35)"
        stroke-width={strokeWidth}
      />

      <circle
        cx={size / 2}
        cy={size / 2}
        r={radius}
        fill="none"
        stroke={timerColor}
        stroke-width={strokeWidth}
        stroke-linecap="round"
        stroke-dasharray={circumference}
        stroke-dashoffset={dashOffset}
        style="
          transition: stroke-dashoffset 0.15s linear, stroke 0.3s ease;
          filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px {timerColor}80);
        "
      />
    </svg>

    <div
      class="timer-text"
      style="
        color: {timerColor};
        font-size: {size * 0.32}px;
        text-shadow: 0 0 8px {timerColor}80, 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.9);
      "
    >
      {displaySec}
    </div>
  </div>
{/if}

<style>
  .timer-ring {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .timer-text {
    position: absolute;
    font-family: 'Sora', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 800;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    line-height: 1;
  }

  .timer-ring.pulsing {
    animation: timer-pulse 0.8s ease-in-out infinite;
  }

  @keyframes timer-pulse {
    0%, 100% {
      transform: scale(1);
      filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px rgba(239,68,68,0.4));
    }
    50% {
      transform: scale(1.06);

  async function load() {
    loading = true;
    error = '';
    data = null;
    try {
      const res = await api.getTournament(tournamentId);
      if (res.ok && res.data) data = res.data;

      error = e.message;

      loading = false;

  // Reload every time the panel is opened
  $: if (open) load();

  function val(key: string): string {
    if (!data) return '—';
    if (data[key] === undefined) return '—';
    const v = data[key];
    if (v === null) return 'null';
    if (typeof v === 'boolean') return v ? 'true' : 'false';
    if (typeof v === 'number') return String(v);
    if (Array.isArray(v)) {
      if (v.length === 0) return '[] (empty)';
      return `Array(${v.length}) — preview: ${JSON.stringify(v[0]).slice(0, 80)}${JSON.stringify(v[0]).length > 80 ? '…' : ''}`;
    }
    if (typeof v === 'object') {
      return `Object — preview: ${JSON.stringify(v).slice(0, 100)}${JSON.stringify(v).length > 100 ? '…' : ''}`;
    }
    return String(v);
  }

  function typeColor(type: string): string {
    return ({
      string: '#60a5fa',
      number: '#34d399',
      boolean: '#fbbf24',
      date: '#a78bfa',
      array: '#f472b6',
      object: '#22d3ee',
    } as Record<string, string>)[type] || '#9ca3af';
  }
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { activeTables, myTurnTables } from '../lib/activeTables';
  export let currentTableId: number | null = null;
  export let onGo: (id: number) => void = () => {};

  let dismissed = new Set<number>();
  $: relevant = $myTurnTables.filter((id) => id !== currentTableId && !dismissed.has(id));
  $: first = relevant[0] ?? null;

  function go(id: number) {
    dismissed.delete(id);
    onGo(id);
  }
  function dismiss(id: number) {
    dismissed.add(id);
    dismissed = new Set(dismissed);
  }
  function handleKey(e: KeyboardEvent, id: number) {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
      e.preventDefault();
      go(id);
    }
  }
</script>

========== FILE: apps\mini-app\src\components\WorldClock.svelte ==========
<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount, onDestroy } from 'svelte';
  import { serverOffset } from '../lib/serverTime';

  let nowClient = Date.now();
  let timer: any = null;
  let tz = 'UTC';

  onMount(() => {
    try {
      tz = Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone || 'UTC';
    } catch {}

    timer = setInterval(() => {
      nowClient = Date.now();
    }, 1000);

    return () => {
      if (timer) clearInterval(timer);
    };
  });

  onDestroy(() => {
    if (timer) clearInterval(timer);
  });

  $: nowServer = nowClient + $serverOffset;

  function fmt(ms: number, timeZone: string): { time: string; date: string } {
    const d = new Date(ms);
    const time = d.toLocaleTimeString('en-GB', {
      timeZone,
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
      second: '2-digit',
      hour12: false,
    });
    const date = d.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', {
      timeZone,
      day: '2-digit',
      month: 'short',
      year: 'numeric',
    });
    return { time, date };
  }

  $: utc = fmt(nowServer, 'UTC');
  $: local = fmt(nowServer, tz);
  $: offsetLabel = (() => {
    try {
      const d = new Date(nowServer);
      // Get offset in minutes by comparing UTC and local parts
      const utcMs = Date.UTC(
        d.getUTCFullYear(), d.getUTCMonth(), d.getUTCDate(),
        d.getUTCHours(), d.getUTCMinutes(),
      );
      const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-GB', {
        timeZone: tz, year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit',
        hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit', hour12: false,
      }).formatToParts(d);
      const get = (t: string) => Number(parts.find(p => p.type === t)?.value || 0);
      const locMs = Date.UTC(get('year'), get('month') - 1, get('day'), get('hour'), get('minute'));
      const diffMin = Math.round((locMs - utcMs) / 60000);
      const sign = diffMin >= 0 ? '+' : '-';
      const abs = Math.abs(diffMin);
      const h = Math.floor(abs / 60);
      const m = abs % 60;
      return m === 0 ? `UTC${sign}${h}` : `UTC${sign}${h}:${m.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
    } catch {
      return 'UTC';
    }
  })();
</script>

========== FILE: apps\mini-app\src\components\XPConvertModal.svelte ==========
<script lang="ts">
  import { api } from '../lib/api';
  import { auth } from '../stores/auth';

  export let open = false;
  export let availableXp = 0;
  export let level = 1;
  export let onClose: () => void = () => {};

  let amount = 5000;
  let busy = false;
  let error = '';
  let success = false;

  const MIN_XP = 5000;
  const STEP = 1000;

  $: maxXp = Math.floor((availableXp ?? 0) / STEP) * STEP;
  $: canSubmit = !busy && level >= 5 && amount >= MIN_XP && amount <= maxXp && amount % STEP === 0;
  $: usdValue = (amount / 1000).toFixed(2);

  $: if (open) { busy = false; error = ''; success = false; amount = Math.min(MIN_XP, maxXp) || MIN_XP; }

  async function convert() {
    if (!canSubmit) return;
    busy = true; error = '';
    try {
      const res = await api.request<{ ok: boolean; usd: number }>('/api/xp/convert', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ xp: amount }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        success = true;
        await auth.refresh();
        setTimeout(() => onClose(), 1800);
      } else {
        error = res.error || 'convert_failed';
      }
    } catch (e: any) { error = e.message; } finally { busy = false; }
  }

  function setPreset(p: number) {
    amount = Math.max(MIN_XP, Math.min(maxXp, Math.floor((maxXp * p) / STEP) * STEP));
  }
</script>

{#if open}

    <div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-4">
      <span class="text-2xl">💎</span>
      <h2 class="text-base font-extrabold text-white flex-1">Cash Out XP</h2>
      <button on:click={onClose} class="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center text-white/60" style="background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);">✕</button>

    {#if level < 5}

        <p class="text-[11px] text-amber-300 font-bold">⚠️ Level 5 مورد نیازه (الان Level {level})</p>

        <p class="text-[11px] text-amber-300 font-bold">⚠️ حداقل ۵۰۰۰ XP برای برداشت لازمه (الان {availableXp.toLocaleString()} XP)</p>
      </div>
    {/if}

    <div class="rounded-2xl p-4 mb-4" style="background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4); border: 1px solid rgba(139,92,246,0.3);">
      <p class="text-[10px] text-white/40 uppercase tracking-wider font-bold mb-2">Amount (XP)</p>
      <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
        <input type="number" bind:value={amount} min={MIN_XP} step={STEP} max={maxXp} class="flex-1 bg-transparent text-2xl font-extrabold text-white tabular-nums outline-none" />
        <span class="text-[11px] text-white/40">XP</span>
      </div>
      <p class="text-[11px] text-white/50 mt-2">= <span class="font-extrabold text-emerald-400">${usdValue}</span></p>
    </div>

    <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 mb-4">
      {#each [{p: 0.25, l: '25%'}, {p: 0.5, l: '50%'}, {p: 1, l: 'MAX'}] as o}
        <button on:click={() => setPreset(o.p)} class="rounded-xl py-2 text-[11px] font-extrabold active:scale-95" style="background: rgba(139,92,246,0.15); border: 1px solid rgba(139,92,246,0.4); color: #c4b5fd;">{o.l}</button>
      {/each}
    </div>

    <p class="text-[10px] text-white/40 mb-3 text-center leading-relaxed">
      Min 5,000 XP · Max 50,000 XP/month · Once per 24h<br/>
      ⚠️ Level change نمی‌کنه (XP از lifetime حساب می‌شه)
    </p>

    {#if success}
      <div class="rounded-xl p-3 text-center" style="background: rgba(16,185,129,0.2); border: 1px solid rgba(16,185,129,0.5);">
        <p class="text-[12px] font-extrabold text-emerald-300">✅ ${usdValue} added to wallet</p>
      </div>
    {:else}
      <button on:click={convert} disabled={!canSubmit} class="w-full rounded-xl py-3 text-[13px] font-extrabold active:scale-[0.98] disabled:opacity-40" style="background: linear-gradient(180deg, #a78bfa, #6d28d9); color: white; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #4c1d95;">{busy ? 'Processing…' : `Convert ${amount.toLocaleString()} XP`}</button>
      {#if error}<p class="text-[11px] text-red-300 text-center mt-3">{error}</p>{/if}
    {/if}
  </div>
{/if}

========== FILE: apps\mini-app\src\i18n\index.ts ==========
import { derived, writable } from 'svelte/store';
import en from './en';
import fa from './fa';
import ar from './ar';
import tr from './tr';
import ru from './ru';
import zh from './zh';

export type Lang = 'en' | 'fa' | 'ar' | 'tr' | 'ru' | 'zh';

export const LANGUAGES: { code: Lang; label: string; flag: string; rtl?: boolean }[] = [
  { code: 'en', label: 'English', flag: '🇬🇧' },
  { code: 'fa', label: 'فارسی', flag: '🇮🇷', rtl: true },
  { code: 'ar', label: 'العربية', flag: '🇸🇦', rtl: true },
  { code: 'tr', label: 'Türkçe', flag: '🇹🇷' },
  { code: 'ru', label: 'Русский', flag: '🇷🇺' },
  { code: 'zh', label: '中文', flag: '🇨🇳' },
];

const dict: Record<Lang, any> = { en, fa, ar, tr, ru, zh };

const stored =
  typeof localStorage !== 'undefined' ? (localStorage.getItem('lang') as Lang | null) : null;

export const lang = writable<Lang>(stored || 'en');

lang.subscribe((l) => {
  if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') localStorage.setItem('lang', l);
  if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
    document.documentElement.lang = l;
    document.documentElement.dir = l === 'fa' || l === 'ar' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr';
  }
});

export const t = derived(lang, ($lang) => {
  const d = dict[$lang] || dict.en;
  return (key: string): string => {
    const parts = key.split('.');
    let cur: any = d;
    for (const p of parts) {
      if (cur == null) return key;
      cur = cur[p];
    }
    return cur ?? key;
  };
});

export function setLang(l: Lang) {
  lang.set(l);
}

========== FILE: apps\mini-app\src\lib\activeTables.ts ==========
import { writable, derived, get } from 'svelte/store';
import { TableSocketIO, type TableState } from './socket';
import { preferences } from './preferences';

export interface ActiveTableMeta {
  tableId: number;
  name?: string;
  mode?: 'free' | 'real';
  variant?: string;
}

export interface ActiveTable {
  meta: ActiveTableMeta;
  socket: TableSocketIO;
  state: TableState | null;
  handResult: any;
  connected: boolean;
  reconnecting: boolean;
  myUserId: number | null;
  joinedAt: number;
  lastError?: { message: string; at: number };
}

type MapT = globalThis.Map<number, ActiveTable>;
const store = writable<MapT>(new globalThis.Map());

function teardownSocket(socket: TableSocketIO): void {
  try {
    socket.leaveTable();
  } catch {}
  // Give the leave packet a moment, then close
  setTimeout(() => {
    try {
      socket.close();
    } catch {}
  }, 250);
}

function join(
  meta: ActiveTableMeta,
  token: string,
  myUserId: number | null,
): ActiveTable {
  const cur = get(store);
  const existing = cur.get(meta.tableId);

  // 🔴 If the same table exists but belongs to a different user, reset it
  if (existing) {
    if (existing.myUserId !== null && existing.myUserId !== myUserId) {
      console.log(
        `[activeTables] userId changed for table ${meta.tableId} (${existing.myUserId} → ${myUserId}), resetting`,
      );
      teardownSocket(existing.socket);
      cur.delete(meta.tableId);
      store.set(new globalThis.Map(cur));
    } else if (existing.socket.isClosed?.()) {
      // 🔴 Socket was killed (e.g. STALE_TOURNAMENT). Reset entry.
      console.log(`[activeTables] table ${meta.tableId} has closed socket, resetting`);
      cur.delete(meta.tableId);
      store.set(new globalThis.Map(cur));
    } else {
      // Same user, live socket — reuse
      return existing;
    }
  }

  const autoMuck = get(preferences).autoMuck;
  const socket = new TableSocketIO(meta.tableId, token, autoMuck);

  const entry: ActiveTable = {
    meta,
    socket,
    state: null,
    handResult: null,
    connected: false,
    reconnecting: false,
    myUserId,
    joinedAt: Date.now(),
  };

  socket.on((evt: any) => {
    store.update((m) => {
      const e = m.get(meta.tableId);
      if (!e) return m;
      if (evt.type === 'state') {
        e.state = evt.state;
      } else if (evt.type === 'hand_result') {
        e.handResult = evt.result;
        e.state = evt.state;
        const hr = evt.result;
        setTimeout(() => {
          store.update((mm) => {
            const ee = mm.get(meta.tableId);
            if (ee && ee.handResult === hr) ee.handResult = null;
            return new globalThis.Map(mm);
          });
        }, 7000);
      } else if (evt.type === 'connected') {
        e.connected = true;
        e.reconnecting = false;
      } else if (evt.type === 'disconnected') {
        e.connected = false;
        // Only mark reconnecting if the socket wants to keep trying
        e.reconnecting = evt.reason !== 'stale_room';
      } else if (evt.type === 'reconnecting') {
        e.reconnecting = true;
      } else if (evt.type === 'error') {
        e.lastError = { message: evt.message, at: Date.now() };
      }
      return new globalThis.Map(m);
    });
  });

  socket.connect();
  cur.set(meta.tableId, entry);
  store.set(new globalThis.Map(cur));
  return entry;
}

function leave(tableId: number): void {
  const cur = get(store);
  const e = cur.get(tableId);
  if (!e) return;
  teardownSocket(e.socket);
  cur.delete(tableId);
  store.set(new globalThis.Map(cur));
}

function leaveAll(): void {
  const cur = get(store);
  for (const e of cur.values()) {
    teardownSocket(e.socket);
  }
  store.set(new globalThis.Map());
}

function updateAutoMuck(v: boolean): void {
  for (const e of get(store).values()) {
    try {
      e.socket.updateAutoMuck(v);
    } catch {}
  }
}

export const activeTables = {
  subscribe: store.subscribe,
  join,
  leave,
  leaveAll,
  updateAutoMuck,
};

export const myTurnTables = derived(activeTables, ($t) => {
  const out: number[] = [];
  for (const [id, t] of $t) {
    if (!t.state || !t.myUserId) continue;
    const seat = t.state.seats.find(
      (s: any) => Number(s.userId) === Number(t.myUserId),
    );
    if (!seat) continue;
    const winners = t.state.winners ?? [];
    if (
      t.state.currentSeat === seat.seat &&
      !seat.folded &&
      !seat.allIn &&
      winners.length === 0
    ) {
      out.push(id);
    }
  }
  return out;
});

export const API_URL = '';

export interface ApiResponse<T = any> {
  ok: boolean;
  data?: T;
  error?: string;
  status?: number;
}

class ApiClient {
  private baseUrl: string;

  constructor(baseUrl: string) {
    this.baseUrl = baseUrl;
  }

  private getToken(): string | null {
    return localStorage.getItem('token');
  }

  async request<T = any>(path: string, options: RequestInit = {}): Promise<ApiResponse<T>> {
    const url = `${this.baseUrl}${path}`;
    const token = this.getToken();

    const headers: Record<string, string> = {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      ...((options.headers as Record<string, string>) || {}),
    };

    if (token) {
      headers['Authorization'] = `Bearer ${token}`;
    }

    try {
      const res = await fetch(url, { ...options, headers });

      let data: any = null;
      const contentType = res.headers.get('content-type');
      if (contentType?.includes('application/json')) {
        data = await res.json();
      }

      if (!res.ok) {
        return {
          ok: false,
          error: data?.error || `HTTP ${res.status}`,
          status: res.status,
        };
      }

      return { ok: true, data, status: res.status };
    } catch (e: any) {
      return { ok: false, error: e.message || 'network_error' };
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // Auth
  // ============================================================
  async authTelegram(initData: string): Promise<ApiResponse<{ token: string; user: any }>> {

========== FILE: apps\mini-app\src\lib\broadcasts.ts ==========
import { writable, get } from 'svelte/store';
import { api } from './api';

export interface BroadcastItem {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  message: string;
  target: string;
  severity: 'info' | 'warning' | 'success' | 'danger';
  createdAt: string;
}

export const broadcasts = writable<BroadcastItem[]>([]);
export const unreadCount = writable<number>(0);
export const broadcastsLoading = writable<boolean>(false);

export async function loadBroadcasts(): Promise<void> {
  broadcastsLoading.set(true);
  try {
    const res = await api.getBroadcasts();
    if (res.ok && res.data) {
      broadcasts.set(res.data.broadcasts);
      unreadCount.set(res.data.broadcasts.length);
    } else {
      broadcasts.set([]);
      unreadCount.set(0);
    }
  } catch {
    broadcasts.set([]);
    unreadCount.set(0);
  } finally {
    broadcastsLoading.set(false);
  }
}

export async function markRead(id: number): Promise<void> {
  const before = get(broadcasts);
  const target = before.find((b) => b.id === id);
  if (!target) return;

  // optimistic: remove from list
  broadcasts.update((arr) => arr.filter((b) => b.id !== id));
  unreadCount.update((n) => Math.max(0, n - 1));

  try {
    await api.markBroadcastRead(id);
  } catch {
    // rollback on failure
    broadcasts.set(before);
    unreadCount.update((n) => n + 1);
  }
}

export async function markAllRead(): Promise<void> {
  const before = get(broadcasts);
  if (before.length === 0) return;
  broadcasts.set([]);
  unreadCount.set(0);
  try {
    await Promise.all(before.map((b) => api.markBroadcastRead(b.id)));
  } catch {
    broadcasts.set(before);
    unreadCount.set(before.length);
  }
}

// Poll every 30s
let pollTimer: any = null;
export function startBroadcastPolling(): void {
  if (pollTimer) return;
  loadBroadcasts();
  pollTimer = setInterval(loadBroadcasts, 30_000);
}

export function stopBroadcastPolling(): void {
  if (pollTimer) {
    clearInterval(pollTimer);
    pollTimer = null;
  }
}

// ============================================================
// Haptics Manager (Telegram WebApp + navigator.vibrate fallback)
// ============================================================

type HapticStyle = 'light' | 'medium' | 'heavy' | 'rigid' | 'soft';
type HapticNotif = 'success' | 'warning' | 'error';

import { preferences } from './preferences';

let enabled = true;

preferences.subscribe((p) => {
  enabled = p.haptics;
});

export function setHapticsEnabled(v: boolean) {
  enabled = v;
}

export function isHapticsEnabled() {
  return enabled;
}

function tg() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  const w = window as any;
  return w.Telegram?.WebApp?.HapticFeedback ?? null;
}

export const haptic = {
  light() {
    if (!enabled) return;
    const h = tg();
    if (h) {
      try { h.impactOccurred('light'); return; } catch {}
    }
    try { navigator.vibrate?.(8); } catch {}
  },

  medium() {
    if (!enabled) return;
    const h = tg();
    if (h) {
      try { h.impactOccurred('medium'); return; } catch {}
    }
    try { navigator.vibrate?.(18); } catch {}
  },

  heavy() {
    if (!enabled) return;
    const h = tg();
    if (h) {
      try { h.impactOccurred('heavy'); return; } catch {}
    }
    try { navigator.vibrate?.(35); } catch {}
  },

  success() {
    if (!enabled) return;
    const h = tg();
    if (h) {
      try { h.notificationOccurred('success'); return; } catch {}
    }
    try { navigator.vibrate?.([15, 40, 15]); } catch {}
  },

  warning() {
    if (!enabled) return;
    const h = tg();
    if (h) {
      try { h.notificationOccurred('warning'); return; } catch {}
    }
    try { navigator.vibrate?.([25, 50, 25]); } catch {}
  },

  error() {
    if (!enabled) return;
    const h = tg();
    if (h) {
      try { h.notificationOccurred('error'); return; } catch {}
    }
    try { navigator.vibrate?.([60, 40, 60, 40, 60]); } catch {}
  },
};

========== FILE: apps\mini-app\src\lib\music.ts ==========
import { preferences } from './preferences';

let ctx: AudioContext | null = null;
let masterGain: GainNode | null = null;
let oscillators: OscillatorNode[] = [];
let playing = false;

function ensureContext() {
  if (ctx) return;
  const AC = (window as any).AudioContext || (window as any).webkitAudioContext;
  if (!AC) return;
  const newCtx: AudioContext = new AC();
  const newGain = newCtx.createGain();
  newGain.gain.value = 0;
  newGain.connect(newCtx.destination);
  ctx = newCtx;
  masterGain = newGain;
}

// Ambient pad: 3 sine waves in minor chord
const FREQS = [110, 164.81, 220]; // A2, E3, A3

function start() {
  ensureContext();
  if (!ctx || !masterGain) return;

  // Resume if suspended
  if (ctx.state === 'suspended') ctx.resume();

  // Cleanup
  stopOscillators();

  oscillators = FREQS.map((f, i) => {
    const osc = ctx!.createOscillator();
    const gain = ctx!.createGain();
    osc.type = 'sine';
    osc.frequency.value = f;
    // Slow detune LFO for warmth
    osc.detune.value = (i - 1) * 4;
    gain.gain.value = 0.08 / FREQS.length;
    osc.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(masterGain!);
    osc.start();
    return osc;
  });

  // Fade in
  masterGain.gain.cancelScheduledValues(ctx.currentTime);
  masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(masterGain.gain.value, ctx.currentTime);
  masterGain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.25, ctx.currentTime + 2);

  playing = true;
}

function stopOscillators() {
  for (const osc of oscillators) {
    try { osc.stop(); osc.disconnect(); } catch {}
  }
  oscillators = [];
}

function stop() {
  if (!ctx || !masterGain) return;
  masterGain.gain.cancelScheduledValues(ctx.currentTime);
  masterGain.gain.setValueAtTime(masterGain.gain.value, ctx.currentTime);
  masterGain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0, ctx.currentTime + 1);
  setTimeout(() => {
    stopOscillators();
    playing = false;
  }, 1200);
}

// Sync with preferences
preferences.subscribe((p) => {
  if (p.music && !playing) {
    // Only start after user interaction (browser autoplay policy)
    const resume = () => {
      if (!playing) start();
      window.removeEventListener('click', resume);
      window.removeEventListener('touchstart', resume);
    };
    window.addEventListener('click', resume, { once: true });
    window.addEventListener('touchstart', resume, { once: true });
  } else if (!p.music && playing) {
    stop();
  }
});

export function initMusic() {
  // No-op — trigger via preferences
}

export function isMusicPlaying() {
  return playing;
}

import { writable } from 'svelte/store';

export interface Notif {
  id: string;
  icon: string;
  title: string;
  message?: string;
  color: string;
  ts: number;
}

export const notifications = writable<Notif[]>([]);

export function pushNotif(n: Omit<Notif, 'id' | 'ts'>): void {
  const id = Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
  const item: Notif = { ...n, id, ts: Date.now() };
  notifications.update((arr) => {
    // Cap at 4 toasts
    const next = [...arr, item];
    return next.length > 4 ? next.slice(next.length - 4) : next;
  });
  setTimeout(() => {
    notifications.update((arr) => arr.filter((x) => x.id !== id));
  }, 5000);
}

export function dismissNotif(id: string): void {
  notifications.update((arr) => arr.filter((x) => x.id !== id));
}

========== FILE: apps\mini-app\src\lib\preferences.ts ==========
import { writable, derived } from 'svelte/store';

export interface Preferences {
  sound: boolean;
  music: boolean;
  haptics: boolean;
  animations: boolean;
  graphics: 'ultra' | 'high' | 'medium' | 'performance';
  autoMuck: boolean;
  fourColor: boolean;
  betSlider: boolean;
  autoPostBlinds: boolean;
}

const DEFAULTS: Preferences = {
  sound: true,
  music: false,
  haptics: true,
  animations: true,
  graphics: 'high',
  autoMuck: true,
  fourColor: false,
  betSlider: true,
  autoPostBlinds: true,
};

function load(): Preferences {
  if (typeof localStorage === 'undefined') return DEFAULTS;
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem('preferences');
    if (!raw) return DEFAULTS;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
    return { ...DEFAULTS, ...parsed };
  } catch {
    return DEFAULTS;
  }
}

const { subscribe, set, update } = writable<Preferences>(load());

// Persist to localStorage on every change
if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') {
  subscribe((p) => {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('preferences', JSON.stringify(p));
    } catch {}
  });
}

export const preferences = {
  subscribe,
  set,
  update,
  setKey<K extends keyof Preferences>(key: K, value: Preferences[K]) {
    update((p) => ({ ...p, [key]: value }));
  },
  reset() {
    set(DEFAULTS);
  },
};

import { io, type Socket } from 'socket.io-client';
import { writable } from 'svelte/store';

const API_URL = '';

let socket: Socket | null = null;

export const realtimeConnected = writable(false);

export function initRealtime(token: string): Socket {
  if (socket) {
    // If already connected, ensure auth is up to date
    (socket.auth as any) = { token };
    if (!socket.connected) socket.connect();
    return socket;
  }

  socket = io(API_URL, {
    auth: { token },
    transports: ['websocket'],
    reconnection: true,
    reconnectionDelay: 1000,
    reconnectionDelayMax: 5000,
  });

  socket.on('connect', () => {
    realtimeConnected.set(true);
    console.log('[realtime] connected', socket?.id);
  });

  socket.on('disconnect', (reason) => {
    realtimeConnected.set(false);
    console.log('[realtime] disconnected:', reason);
  });

  socket.on('connect_error', (err) => {
    console.warn('[realtime] connect_error:', err.message);
  });

  return socket;
}

export function getRealtime(): Socket | null {
  return socket;
}

export function closeRealtime(): void {
  if (socket) {
    socket.disconnect();
    socket = null;
    realtimeConnected.set(false);
  }
}

========== FILE: apps\mini-app\src\lib\serverTime.ts ==========
import { writable } from 'svelte/store';

/**
 * Server-time offset in ms (serverNow - clientNow).
 * Synced once on app start, then we tick locally.
 */
export const serverOffset = writable<number>(0);

let lastSyncAt = 0;
const SYNC_INTERVAL_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000; // re-sync every 5 min

export async function syncServerTime(force = false): Promise<void> {
  const now = Date.now();
  if (!force && now - lastSyncAt < SYNC_INTERVAL_MS) return;

  try {
    const t0 = Date.now();
    const res = await fetch('/api/time');
    const t1 = Date.now();
    if (!res.ok) return;
    const data = (await res.json()) as { utc: number };
    // Assume symmetric latency: server time when request hit was around midpoint
    const rtt = t1 - t0;
    const clientMid = t0 + rtt / 2;
    const offset = data.utc - clientMid;
    serverOffset.set(offset);
    lastSyncAt = Date.now();
  } catch {
    // network error — keep previous offset
  }
}

export function startServerTimeSync(): void {
  syncServerTime(true);
  setInterval(() => syncServerTime(), SYNC_INTERVAL_MS);
}
