import { io, Socket } from 'socket.io-client';

const API_URL = '';

export interface TableState {
  seats: any[];
  community: any[];
  phase: string;
  currentSeat: number;
  pot: number;
  minRaise: number;
  smallBlind: number;
  bigBlind: number;
  dealerSeat: number;
  winners: number[] | null;
  handNo: number;
  sequence: number;
  serverSeedHash: string;
  serverSeed?: string;
  serverTime: number;
  turnStartedAt: number;
  autoActionAt: number;
  turnBaseLimit: number;
  timeBankLimit: number;
  turnBankActive?: boolean;
  variant?: string;
  mode?: 'free' | 'real';
  totalRake?: number;
  totalRebuy?: number;
 tournamentId?: number;
  tournamentTableNumber?: number;
  clientSeed?: string;
  revealSeed?: string;
}

export interface ChatMessage {
  id: string;
  userId: number;
  displayName: string;
  avatarId: string;
  text: string;
  isEmoji: boolean;
  timestamp: number;
}

export type SocketEvent =
  | { type: 'state'; state: TableState }
  | { type: 'hand_result'; result: any; state: any }
  | { type: 'connected' }
  | { type: 'disconnected'; reason: string }
  | { type: 'reconnecting'; attempt: number }
  | { type: 'reconnected'; syncType: string }
  | { type: 'player_joined'; userId: number; displayName: string; total: number }
  | { type: 'player_left'; userId: number; total: number }
  | { type: 'chat'; message: ChatMessage }
  | { type: 'error'; message: string; code?: string };

type Listener = (e: SocketEvent) => void;

export class TableSocketIO {
  private socket: Socket | null = null;
  private listeners: Set<Listener> = new Set();
  private token: string;
  private tableId: number;
  private autoMuck: boolean;
  private closedByUser = false;

  private lastHandNo: number = 0;
  private lastSequence: number = 0;
  private reconnectAttempt = 0;

  constructor(tableId: number, token: string, autoMuck: boolean = true) {
    this.tableId = tableId;
    this.token = token;
    this.autoMuck = autoMuck;
  }
  isClosed(): boolean {
    return this.closedByUser || this.socket === null;
  }
  connect(): void {
    this.closedByUser = false;

    this.socket = io(API_URL, {
      auth: {
        token: this.token,
        device: this.getDeviceHash(),
      },
      transports: ['websocket', 'polling'],
      reconnection: true,
      reconnectionDelay: 1000,
      reconnectionDelayMax: 5000,
      reconnectionAttempts: Infinity,
      timeout: 20000,
      autoConnect: true,
    });

    this.socket.on('connect', () => {
      // ...existing code...
      const isReconnect = this.reconnectAttempt > 0;
      this.emit({ type: 'connected' });
      this.reconnectAttempt = 0;

      this.socket?.emit(
        'table:join',
        {
          tableId: this.tableId,
          lastHandNo: this.lastHandNo,
          lastSequence: this.lastSequence,
          autoMuck: this.autoMuck,
        },
        (res: any) => {
          if (!res?.ok) {
            const code = res?.code;
            const message = res?.error ?? 'join_failed';
            this.emit({ type: 'error', message, code });

            // 🔴 STALE_TOURNAMENT: kill this socket permanently
            if (code === 'STALE_TOURNAMENT') {
              console.warn(
                `[TableSocketIO] STALE_TOURNAMENT for table ${this.tableId} — closing socket permanently`,
              );
              this.closedByUser = true;
              try {
                this.socket?.removeAllListeners();
                this.socket?.disconnect();
                this.socket = null;
              } catch {}
              this.emit({
                type: 'disconnected',
                reason: 'stale_room',
              });
            }
            return;
          }
          if (isReconnect) {
            this.emit({ type: 'reconnected', syncType: res.syncType || 'full' });
          }
        },
      );
    });

    this.socket.on('table:state', (state: TableState) => {
      if (typeof state.handNo === 'number') this.lastHandNo = state.handNo;
      if (typeof state.sequence === 'number') this.lastSequence = state.sequence;
      this.emit({ type: 'state', state });
    });

    this.socket.on('table:hand_result', (data: any) => {
      if (data?.state?.handNo) this.lastHandNo = data.state.handNo;
      this.emit({
        type: 'hand_result',
        result: data?.result,
        state: data?.state,
      });
    });

    this.socket.on('table:player_joined', (data: any) => {
      this.emit({
        type: 'player_joined',
        userId: data.userId,
        displayName: data.displayName,
        total: data.total,
      });
    });

    this.socket.on('table:player_left', (data: any) => {
      this.emit({
        type: 'player_left',
        userId: data.userId,
        total: data.total,
      });
    });

    this.socket.on('table:chat_message', (msg: ChatMessage) => {
      this.emit({ type: 'chat', message: msg });
    });

    this.socket.on('connect_error', (err: any) => {
      this.emit({ type: 'error', message: err.message });
    });

    this.socket.io.on('reconnect_attempt', (attempt: number) => {
      this.reconnectAttempt = attempt;
      this.emit({ type: 'reconnecting', attempt });
    });

    this.socket.on('disconnect', (reason: string) => {
      if (!this.closedByUser) {
        this.emit({ type: 'disconnected', reason });
      }
    });
  }

  private getDeviceHash(): string {
    let device = localStorage.getItem('device_hash');
    if (!device) {
      device = 'dev_' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 15);
      localStorage.setItem('device_hash', device);
    }
    return device;
  }

  private emit(event: SocketEvent): void {
    for (const l of this.listeners) {
      try {
        l(event);
      } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
      }
    }
  }

  action(action: 'FOLD' | 'CHECK' | 'CALL' | 'RAISE', amount = 0): void {
    if (!this.socket?.connected) return;

    const commandId = this.generateCommandId();

    this.socket.emit('table:action', { action, amount, commandId }, (res: any) => {
      if (!res?.ok) {
        this.emit({ type: 'error', message: res?.error ?? 'action_failed', code: res?.code });
      }
    });
  }

  private generateCommandId(): string {
    return `${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 12)}`;
  }

  useTimeBank(): void {
    if (!this.socket?.connected) return;
    this.socket.emit('table:time_bank', {}, () => {});
  }
  updateAutoMuck(autoMuck: boolean): void {
    this.autoMuck = autoMuck;
    if (!this.socket?.connected) return;
    this.socket.emit('table:update_prefs', { autoMuck }, () => {});
  }
  requestResync(): void {
    if (!this.socket?.connected) return;
    this.socket.emit(
      'table:resync',
      {
        tableId: this.tableId,
        lastHandNo: this.lastHandNo,
        lastSequence: this.lastSequence,
      },
      (res: any) => {
        if (res?.ok) {
          this.emit({ type: 'reconnected', syncType: res.syncType || 'full' });
        }
      },
    );
  }

  leaveTable(): void {
    if (!this.socket?.connected) return;
    this.socket.emit('table:leave', {}, () => {});
  }

  // ============================================================
  // CHAT
  // ============================================================
  sendChat(text: string, isEmoji = false): Promise<{ ok: boolean; code?: string }> {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      if (!this.socket?.connected) {
        resolve({ ok: false, code: 'NOT_CONNECTED' });
        return;
      }
      this.socket.emit('table:chat', { text, isEmoji }, (res: any) => {
        resolve(res ?? { ok: false, code: 'NO_ACK' });
      });
    });
  }

  requestChatHistory(): Promise<ChatMessage[]> {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      if (!this.socket?.connected) {
        resolve([]);
        return;
      }
      this.socket.emit('table:chat_history', {}, (res: any) => {
        resolve(res?.messages ?? []);
      });
    });
  }

  on(listener: Listener): () => void {
    this.listeners.add(listener);
    return () => this.listeners.delete(listener);
  }

  close(): void {
    
    this.closedByUser = true;
    this.listeners.clear();
    if (this.socket) {
      this.socket.disconnect();
      this.socket = null;
      
    }
  }
}

// ============================================================
// Sound Effects Manager
// ============================================================

type SoundName = 'chip' | 'deal' | 'card-flip' | 'win' | 'lose' | 'button' | 'check';

const SOUND_FILES: Record<SoundName, string> = {
  chip: '/sounds/chip.wav',
  deal: '/sounds/deal.wav',
  'card-flip': '/sounds/card-flip.wav',
  win: '/sounds/win.wav',
  lose: '/sounds/lose.wav',
  button: '/sounds/button.wav',
  check: '/sounds/check.wav',
};

const cache: Partial<Record<SoundName, HTMLAudioElement>> = {};

import { preferences } from './preferences';

let enabled = true;
let masterVolume = 0.6;

// Sync with preferences store
preferences.subscribe((p) => {
  enabled = p.sound;
});

export function setSoundEnabled(v: boolean) {
  enabled = v;
}

export function isSoundEnabled() {
  return enabled;
}

export function setMasterVolume(v: number) {
  masterVolume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v));
}

export function playSound(name: SoundName, volume?: number) {
  if (!enabled) return;
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;

  try {
    let audio = cache[name];
    if (!audio) {
      audio = new Audio(SOUND_FILES[name]);
      audio.preload = 'auto';
      cache[name] = audio;
    }

    // Clone for overlapping plays
    const instance = audio.cloneNode() as HTMLAudioElement;
    instance.volume = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, volume ?? masterVolume));
    instance.play().catch(() => {
      // Browser autoplay blocked — ignore
    });
  } catch {}
}

export function preloadAllSounds() {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  (Object.keys(SOUND_FILES) as SoundName[]).forEach((name) => {
    try {
      const audio = new Audio(SOUND_FILES[name]);
      audio.preload = 'auto';
      cache[name] = audio;
    } catch {}
  });
}

<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount } from 'svelte';
  import TopBar from '../components/TopBar.svelte';
  import { auth } from '../stores/auth';

  export let onBack: () => void = () => {};

  type Achievement = {
    id: number;
    code: string;
    name: string;
    description: string;
    icon: string;
    category: string;
    threshold: number;
    progress: number;
    unlocked: boolean;
    unlockedAt: string | null;
    claimed: boolean;
    claimedAt: string | null;
    rewardChips: number;
    rewardUsd: number;
  };

  let achievements: Achievement[] = [];
  let loading = true;
  let error = '';
  let toast = '';
  type CategoryKey = 'all' | 'hand' | 'tournament' | 'wallet' | 'special';
let activeFilter: CategoryKey = 'all';
  let claiming: string | null = null;

  function token(): string | null {
    return localStorage.getItem('token');
  }

  async function load() {
    loading = true;
    error = '';
    try {
      const t = token();
      const res = await fetch('/api/me/achievements', {
        headers: t ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${t}` } : {},
      });
      if (!res.ok) {
        error = `HTTP ${res.status}`;
        return;
      }
      const data = await res.json();
      achievements = data.achievements || [];
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    } finally {
      loading = false;
    }
  }

  async function claim(code: string) {
    claiming = code;
    try {
      const t = token();
      const res = await fetch(`/api/me/achievements/${code}/claim`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          ...(t ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${t}` } : {}),
        },
        body: '{}',
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (res.ok) {
        toast = `✅ Reward claimed!`;
        setTimeout(() => (toast = ''), 3000);
        await load();
        await auth.refresh();
      } else {
        toast = `❌ ${data.error || 'claim failed'}`;
        setTimeout(() => (toast = ''), 3000);
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      toast = `❌ ${e.message}`;
      setTimeout(() => (toast = ''), 3000);
    } finally {
      claiming = null;
    }
  }

  onMount(load);

  $: filtered = activeFilter === 'all'
    ? achievements
    : achievements.filter((a) => a.category === activeFilter);

  $: unlockedCount = achievements.filter((a) => a.unlocked).length;
  $: totalCount = achievements.length;
  $: claimableCount = achievements.filter((a) => a.unlocked && !a.claimed).length;
  $: completionPct = totalCount > 0 ? Math.round((unlockedCount / totalCount) * 100) : 0;

  const CATEGORIES: { key: CategoryKey; label: string }[] = [
    { key: 'all', label: 'All' },
    { key: 'hand', label: 'Hands' },
    { key: 'tournament', label: 'Tournaments' },
    { key: 'wallet', label: 'Wallet' },
    { key: 'special', label: 'Special' },
  ];
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount } from 'svelte';

  export let onBack: () => void = () => {};

  const API = '';
  const STORAGE_KEY = 'admin_secret';

  let adminSecret = '';
  let authed = false;
  let loading = false;
  let error = '';
  let toast = '';

  type Tab =
    | 'overview' | 'tournaments' | 'tables' | 'players'
    | 'anticheat' | 'wallet' | 'broadcast' | 'settings';
  let activeTab: Tab = 'overview';

  // ============ OVERVIEW ============
  let overview: any = null;
  let liveRooms: any[] = [];
  let overviewLoading = false;

  // ============ TOURNAMENTS ============
  let tournaments: any[] = [];
  let blindStructures: any[] = [];
  let templates: any[] = [];
  let tourneyFilter = 'all';
  let showCreate = false;
  let creating = false;
  let showTemplateForm = false;
  let creatingTemplate = false;

  let form = {
    name: '', variant: 'holdem', mode: 'free', format: 'sng', speed: 'regular',
    buyIn: 0, fee: 0, startingStack: 1500, minPlayers: 2, maxPlayers: 9,
    guaranteed: 0, lateRegLevel: 0, allowReEntry: false, maxReEntries: 1,
    isBounty: false, bountyAmount: 0, satelliteTargetId: null as number | null,
    seatsAwarded: 0, blindStructureId: 0, scheduledStart: '',
  };
  let tform = {
    name: '', variant: 'holdem', mode: 'free', format: 'sng', speed: 'regular',
    buyIn: 0, fee: 0, startingStack: 5000, minPlayers: 2, maxPlayers: 100,
    guaranteed: 0, lateRegLevel: 0, allowReEntry: false, maxReEntries: 1,
    isBounty: false, bountyAmount: 0, blindStructureId: 0,
    scheduleType: 'daily' as 'hourly' | 'daily' | 'weekly',
    scheduleTime: '14:00', scheduleDay: 0,
  };

  // ============ TABLES ============
  let tables: any[] = [];
  let tablesLoading = false;
  let showTableForm = false;
  let creatingTable = false;
  let tableFilter: 'all' | 'holdem' | 'omaha4' | 'omaha5' = 'all';
  let tableForm = {
    name: '', variant: 'holdem', mode: 'free', speed: 'regular',
    small_blind: 1, big_blind: 2, ante: 0,
    min_buyin: 100, max_buyin: 1000, rake_pct: 0.03, seats: 6,
  };

  // ============ PLAYERS ============
  let players: any[] = [];
  let playersTotal = 0;
  let playersLoading = false;
  let playersSearch = '';
  let playersFilter: 'all' | 'active' | 'banned' | 'high_risk' = 'all';
  let selectedPlayer: any = null;
  let playerDetail: any = null;
  let playerHistory: any = null;
  let playerDetailLoading = false;
  let walletAdjustAmount = 0;
  let walletAdjustReason = '';
  let walletAdjusting = false;

  // ============ ANTI-CHEAT ============
  let anticheat: any = null;
  let riskyUsers: any[] = [];
  let anticheatEvents: any[] = [];
  let anticheatFilter: 'all' | 'unresolved' | 'resolved' = 'unresolved';
  let anticheatLoading = false;

  let broadcasts: any[] = [];
  let bcastForm = { title: '', message: '', target: 'all', severity: 'info' };
  let broadcasting = false;

  function headers() {
    return {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      Authorization: `Bearer ${adminSecret}`,
    };
  }

  function flash(msg: string) {
    toast = msg;
    setTimeout(() => (toast = ''), 3500);
  }

  async function login() {
    if (!adminSecret) return;
    loading = true;
    error = '';
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/stats`, { headers: headers() });
      if (res.ok) {
        authed = true;
        localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, adminSecret);
        await loadTab('overview');
      } else {
        error = 'Invalid admin secret';
        adminSecret = '';
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    } finally {
      loading = false;
    }
  }

  async function loadTab(tab: Tab) {
    activeTab = tab;
    error = '';
    if (tab === 'overview') await loadOverview();
    else if (tab === 'tournaments') await loadTournaments();
    else if (tab === 'tables') await loadTables();
    else if (tab === 'players') await loadPlayers();
    else if (tab === 'anticheat') await loadAnticheat();
    else if (tab === 'wallet') await loadWallet();
    else if (tab === 'broadcast') await loadBroadcasts();
    else if (tab === 'settings') await loadSettings();
  }

  // ============ LOADERS ============
  async function loadOverview() {
    overviewLoading = true;
    try {
      const [o, l] = await Promise.all([
        fetch(`${API}/api/admin/overview`, { headers: headers() }).then((r) => r.json()),
        fetch(`${API}/api/admin/live`, { headers: headers() }).then((r) => r.json()),
      ]);
      overview = o;
      liveRooms = l.rooms || [];
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    } finally {
      overviewLoading = false;
    }
  }

  async function loadTournaments() {
    try {
      const [t, b, tpl] = await Promise.all([
        fetch(`${API}/api/admin/tournaments`, { headers: headers() }).then((r) => r.json()),
        fetch(`${API}/api/blind-structures`).then((r) => r.json()),
        fetch(`${API}/api/admin/tournament-templates`, { headers: headers() }).then((r) => r.json()),
      ]);
      tournaments = t.tournaments || [];
      blindStructures = b.structures || [];
      templates = tpl.templates || [];
      if (blindStructures.length > 0 && !form.blindStructureId) {
        form.blindStructureId = blindStructures[0].id;
      }
      if (blindStructures.length > 0 && !tform.blindStructureId) {
        tform.blindStructureId = blindStructures[0].id;
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    }
  }

  async function loadTables() {
    tablesLoading = true;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/tables`, { headers: headers() });
      const data = await res.json();
      tables = data.tables || [];
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    } finally {
      tablesLoading = false;
    }
  }

  async function loadPlayers() {
    playersLoading = true;
    try {
      const qs = new URLSearchParams();
      if (playersSearch) qs.set('search', playersSearch);
      if (playersFilter !== 'all') qs.set('filter', playersFilter);
      qs.set('limit', '50');
      const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/users?${qs}`, { headers: headers() });
      const data = await res.json();
      players = data.users || [];
      playersTotal = data.total || 0;
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    } finally {
      playersLoading = false;
    }
  }

  async function loadPlayerDetail(id: number) {
    playerDetailLoading = true;
    try {
      const [d, h] = await Promise.all([
        fetch(`${API}/api/admin/users/${id}`, { headers: headers() }).then((r) => r.json()),
        fetch(`${API}/api/admin/users/${id}/history?limit=20`, { headers: headers() }).then((r) => r.json()),
      ]);
      playerDetail = d.user;
      playerHistory = h;
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    } finally {
      playerDetailLoading = false;
    }
  }

  async function loadAnticheat() {
    anticheatLoading = true;
    try {
      const resolvedParam =
        anticheatFilter === 'resolved' ? '?resolved=true' :
        anticheatFilter === 'unresolved' ? '?resolved=false' : '';
      const [s, r, e] = await Promise.all([
        fetch(`${API}/api/admin/anticheat/stats`, { headers: headers() }).then((r) => r.json()),
        fetch(`${API}/api/admin/anticheat/risky-users`, { headers: headers() }).then((r) => r.json()),
        fetch(`${API}/api/admin/anticheat/events${resolvedParam}`, { headers: headers() }).then((r) => r.json()),
      ]);
      anticheat = s;
      riskyUsers = r.users || [];
      anticheatEvents = e.events || [];
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    } finally {
      anticheatLoading = false;
    }
  }

  async function loadWallet() {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/actions?limit=50`, { headers: headers() });
      const data = await res.json();
      walletActions = (data.actions || []).filter((a: any) =>
        a.action === 'adjust_wallet' || a.action === 'ban_user' || a.action === 'unban_user'
      );
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    }
  }

  async function loadBroadcasts() {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/broadcasts`, { headers: headers() });
      const data = await res.json();
      broadcasts = data.broadcasts || [];
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    }
  }

  async function loadSettings() {
    settingsLoading = true;
    try {
      const [s, a] = await Promise.all([
        fetch(`${API}/api/admin/settings`, { headers: headers() }).then((r) => r.json()),
        fetch(`${API}/api/admin/actions?limit=30`, { headers: headers() }).then((r) => r.json()),
      ]);
      settings = s.settings || {};
      actionsLog = a.actions || [];
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    } finally {
      settingsLoading = false;
    }
  }

  // ============ ACTIONS — TOURNAMENTS ============
  async function createTournament() {
    if (!form.name.trim()) { error = 'Name required'; return; }
    creating = true; error = '';
    try {
      const payload = {
        ...form,
        startingStack: Number(form.startingStack) || 1500,
        buyIn: Number(form.buyIn) || 0,
        fee: Number(form.fee) || 0,
        minPlayers: Number(form.minPlayers) || 2,
        maxPlayers: Number(form.maxPlayers) || 9,
        guaranteed: Number(form.guaranteed) || 0,
        lateRegLevel: Number(form.lateRegLevel) || 0,
        maxReEntries: Number(form.maxReEntries) || 1,
        bountyAmount: Number(form.bountyAmount) || 0,
        seatsAwarded: Number(form.seatsAwarded) || 0,
        blindStructureId: Number(form.blindStructureId),
        scheduledStart: form.scheduledStart ? new Date(form.scheduledStart).toISOString() : null,
      };
      const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/tournaments`, {
        method: 'POST', headers: headers(), body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (res.ok) {
        flash(`✅ Tournament #${data.tournamentId} created`);
        showCreate = false; form.name = ''; form.scheduledStart = '';
        await loadTournaments();
      } else error = data.error || 'create_failed';
    } catch (e: any) { error = e.message; }
    finally { creating = false; }
  }

  async function startTournament(id: number) {
    if (!confirm(`Start tournament #${id}?`)) return;
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/tournaments/${id}/start`, {
      method: 'POST', headers: headers(), body: '{}',
    });
    if (res.ok) { flash(`🚀 Started #${id}`); await loadTournaments(); }
    else error = 'start_failed';
  }

  async function pauseTournament(id: number) {
    if (!confirm(`Pause #${id}?`)) return;
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/tournaments/${id}/pause`, {
      method: 'POST', headers: headers(), body: '{}',
    });
    if (res.ok) { flash(`⏸️ Paused #${id}`); await loadTournaments(); }
    else error = 'pause_failed';
  }

  async function resumeTournament(id: number) {
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/tournaments/${id}/resume`, {
      method: 'POST', headers: headers(), body: '{}',

    if (res.ok) { flash(`▶️ Resumed #${id}`); await loadTournaments(); }
    else error = 'resume_failed';
  }

  async function cancelTournament(id: number) {
    if (!confirm(`Cancel #${id} + refund?`)) return;
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/tournaments/${id}/cancel`, {
      method: 'POST', headers: headers(), body: '{}',
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (res.ok) { flash(`❌ Cancelled (${data.refunded} refunded)`); await loadTournaments(); }
    else error = data.error || 'cancel_failed';

  async function createTemplate() {

    creatingTemplate = true; error = '';

  async function toggleTemplate(id: number, active: boolean) {

      method: 'POST', headers: headers(), body: JSON.stringify({ active }),
    });
    if (res.ok) { flash(active ? '▶️ Activated' : '⏸️ Paused'); await loadTournaments(); }

  async function deleteTemplate(id: number) {
    if (!confirm(`Delete template #${id}?`)) return;
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/tournament-templates/${id}`, {

    if (res.ok) { flash('🗑️ Deleted'); await loadTournaments(); }
  }

  // ============ ACTIONS — TABLES ============
  function resetTableForm() {
    tableForm = {
      name: '', variant: 'holdem', mode: 'free', speed: 'regular',
      small_blind: 1, big_blind: 2, ante: 0,
      min_buyin: 100, max_buyin: 1000, rake_pct: 0.03, seats: 6,
    };

  async function createTable() {
    if (!tableForm.name.trim()) { error = 'Name required'; return; }
    creatingTable = true; error = '';
    try {
      const payload = {
        name: tableForm.name, variant: tableForm.variant, mode: tableForm.mode,
        speed: tableForm.speed,
        small_blind: Number(tableForm.small_blind) || 1,
        big_blind: Number(tableForm.big_blind) || 2,
        ante: Number(tableForm.ante) || 0,
        min_buyin: Number(tableForm.min_buyin) || 0,
        max_buyin: Number(tableForm.max_buyin) || 0,
        rake_pct: Number(tableForm.rake_pct) || 0,
        seats: Number(tableForm.seats) || 6,
      };
      const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/tables`, {
        method: 'POST', headers: headers(), body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (res.ok) {
        flash(`✅ Table "${payload.name}" created`);
        showTableForm = false; resetTableForm();
        await loadTables();
      } else error = data.error || 'create_failed';
    } catch (e: any) { error = e.message; }
    finally { creatingTable = false; }
  }

  async function deleteTable(id: number, name: string) {
    if (!confirm(`Delete table "${name}"?`)) return;
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/tables/${id}`, {
      method: 'DELETE', headers: headers(),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (res.ok) { flash(`🗑️ Deleted`); await loadTables(); }
    else error = data.error === 'table_has_players' ? 'Table has live players' : data.error;
  }

  async function toggleTable(id: number, active: boolean) {
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/tables/${id}/toggle`, {
      method: 'POST', headers: headers(), body: JSON.stringify({ active }),
    });
    if (res.ok) { flash(active ? '▶️ Activated' : '⏸️ Paused'); await loadTables(); }

  // ============ ACTIONS — PLAYERS ============
  async function openPlayer(p: any) {
    selectedPlayer = p;
    playerDetail = null;
    playerHistory = null;
    walletAdjustAmount = 0;
    walletAdjustReason = '';
    await loadPlayerDetail(p.id);
  }

  function closePlayer() {
    selectedPlayer = null;
    playerDetail = null;
    playerHistory = null;
  }

  async function banPlayer(id: number, ban: boolean) {
    const reason = prompt(ban ? 'Ban reason:' : 'Unban reason:') ?? 'admin action';
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/users/${id}/ban`, {
      method: 'POST', headers: headers(),
      body: JSON.stringify({ ban, reason }),
    });
    if (res.ok) {
      flash(ban ? '🚫 Banned' : '✅ Unbanned');
      await loadPlayerDetail(id);
      await loadPlayers();
    } else error = 'ban_failed';
  }

  async function adjustWallet(id: number) {
    if (!walletAdjustAmount) return;
    walletAdjusting = true;
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/users/${id}/wallet`, {
        method: 'POST', headers: headers(),
        body: JSON.stringify({
          amount: walletAdjustAmount,
          reason: walletAdjustReason || 'admin adjustment',
        }),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (res.ok) {
        flash(`💰 Balance: $${data.newBalance.toFixed(2)}`);
        walletAdjustAmount = 0;
        walletAdjustReason = '';
        await loadPlayerDetail(id);
        await loadPlayers();
      } else error = data.error || 'adjust_failed';
    } finally { walletAdjusting = false; }
  }

  // ============ ACTIONS — ANTI-CHEAT ============
  async function resolveEvent(id: number) {
    const note = prompt('Resolution note (optional):') ?? '';
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/anticheat/events/${id}/resolve`, {
      method: 'POST', headers: headers(), body: JSON.stringify({ note }),
    });
    if (res.ok) { flash('✅ Resolved'); await loadAnticheat(); }
  }

  async function banRiskyUser(userId: number) {
    if (!confirm(`Ban user #${userId}?`)) return;
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/anticheat/user/${userId}/ban`, {
      method: 'POST', headers: headers(),
      body: JSON.stringify({ ban: true, reason: 'anticheat' }),
    });
    if (res.ok) { flash('🚫 Banned'); await loadAnticheat(); }
  }

  // ============ ACTIONS — BROADCAST ============
  async function createBroadcast() {
    if (!bcastForm.title.trim() || !bcastForm.message.trim()) {
      error = 'Title and message required'; return;
    }
    broadcasting = true; error = '';
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/broadcasts`, {
        method: 'POST', headers: headers(), body: JSON.stringify(bcastForm),
      });
      const data = await res.json();
      if (res.ok) {
        flash(`📢 Broadcast #${data.broadcastId} sent`);
        showBroadcastForm = false;
        bcastForm = { title: '', message: '', target: 'all', severity: 'info' };
        await loadBroadcasts();
      } else error = data.error || 'broadcast_failed';
    } finally { broadcasting = false; }
  }

  async function deleteBroadcast(id: number) {
    if (!confirm(`Delete broadcast #${id}?`)) return;
    const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/broadcasts/${id}`, {
      method: 'DELETE', headers: headers(),
    });
    if (res.ok) { flash('🗑️ Deleted'); await loadBroadcasts(); }
  }

  // ============ ACTIONS — SETTINGS ============
  async function saveSettings() {
    settingsSaving = true;
    try {
      const payload: Record<string, any> = {};
      for (const k of Object.keys(settings)) {
        payload[k] = settings[k].value;
      }
      const res = await fetch(`${API}/api/admin/settings`, {
        method: 'POST', headers: headers(), body: JSON.stringify(payload),
      });
      if (res.ok) { flash('💾 Settings saved'); await loadSettings(); }
      else error = 'save_failed';
    } finally { settingsSaving = false; }
  }

  async function toggleSetting(key: string) {
    settings[key] = { ...settings[key], value: !settings[key].value };
  }

  // ============ HELPERS ============
  function fmtDate(iso: string | null): string {
    if (!iso) return '—';
    try {
      return new Date(iso).toLocaleString('en-US', {
        month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit',
      });
    } catch { return '—'; }
  }

  function fmtMoney(n: any): string {
    return `$${Number(n || 0).toFixed(2)}`;
  }

  function logout() {
    localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    adminSecret = ''; authed = false;
  }

  function statusColor(s: string): string {
    if (s === 'running') return '#10b981';
    if (s === 'final_table') return '#d4af37';
    if (s === 'registering') return '#22d3ee';
    if (s === 'scheduled') return '#8b5cf6';
    if (s === 'finished') return '#6b7280';
    if (s === 'paused') return '#f59e0b';
    if (s === 'cancelled') return '#ef4444';
    return '#6b7280';
  }

  function variantColor(v: string): string {
    if (v === 'holdem') return '#3b82f6';
    if (v === 'omaha4') return '#ef4444';
    if (v === 'omaha5') return '#10b981';
    return '#d4af37';
  }

  function variantLabel(v: string): string {
    if (v === 'holdem') return "Hold'em";
    if (v === 'omaha4') return 'Omaha 4';
    if (v === 'omaha5') return 'Omaha 5';
    return v;
  }

  $: filteredTables =
    tableFilter === 'all' ? tables : tables.filter((t) => t.variant === tableFilter);

  $: filteredTournaments =
    tourneyFilter === 'all' ? tournaments : tournaments.filter((t) => t.status === tourneyFilter);

  $: tablesByVariant = {

    omaha5: tables.filter((t) => t.variant === 'omaha5').length,
  };

    { key: 'anticheat', label: 'Anti-Cheat', paths: ['M12 22s8-4 8-10V5l-8-3-8 3v7c0 6 8 10 8 10z','M12 8v4','M12 16h.01'] },

    { key: 'settings', label: 'Settings', paths: ['M12 15a3 3 0 1 0 0-6 3 3 0 0 0 0 6z','M19.4 15a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 .33 1.82l.06.06a2 2 0 1 1-2.83 2.83l-.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.82-.33 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1 1.51V21a2 2 0 1 1-4 0v-.09A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 9 19.4a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.82.33l-.06.06a2 2 0 1 1-2.83-2.83l.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 .33-1.82 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.51-1H3a2 2 0 1 1 0-4h.09A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 4.6 9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-.33-1.82l-.06-.06a2 2 0 1 1 2.83-2.83l.06.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.82.33H9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1-1.51V3a2 2 0 1 1 4 0v.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1 1.51 1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.82-.33l.06-.06a2 2 0 1 1 2.83 2.83l-.06.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-.33 1.82V9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.51 1H21a2 2 0 1 1 0 4h-.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.51 1z'] },
  ];

  onMount(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (saved) {
      adminSecret = saved;
      login();
    }
  });
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount } from 'svelte';
  import { api } from '../lib/api';
  import { t, lang } from '../i18n';

  type EventItem = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    description: string;
    startsAt: string;
    prize: number;
    image?: string;
  };

  let events: EventItem[] = [];
  let loading = true;
  let selected: EventItem | null = null;

  onMount(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await api.request('/api/events');
      if (res.ok && res.data) events = (res.data as any).events || [];
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[Events] load failed', e);
      events = [];
    } finally {
      loading = false;
    }
  });

  function openDetail(ev: EventItem) {
    selected = ev;
  }

  function closeDetail() {
    selected = null;
  }

  function formatDate(iso: string) {
    const locale =
      $lang === 'fa'
        ? 'fa-IR'
        : $lang === 'ar'
          ? 'ar-SA'
          : $lang === 'tr'
            ? 'tr-TR'
            : $lang === 'ru'
              ? 'ru-RU'
              : $lang === 'zh'
                ? 'zh-CN'
                : 'en-US';
    return new Date(iso).toLocaleString(locale, {
      dateStyle: 'medium',
      timeStyle: 'short',
    });
  }
</script>

<div class="events-page">
  <header class="page-header">
    <h1>{$t('events.title')}</h1>
  </header>

  {#if loading}
    <div class="state">{$t('events.loading')}</div>
  {:else if events.length === 0}
    <div class="state">{$t('events.noEvents')}</div>
  {:else}
    <ul class="event-list">
      {#each events as ev (ev.id)}
        <li>
          <button type="button" class="event-card w-full text-left" onclick={() => openDetail(ev)}>
            {#if ev.image}
              <img class="thumb" src={ev.image} alt={ev.title} />
            {/if}
            <div class="body">
              <span class="title">{ev.title}</span>
              <span class="date">{formatDate(ev.startsAt)}</span>
            </div>
            <div class="prize">{ev.prize.toLocaleString()} TON</div>
          </button>
        </li>
      {/each}
    </ul>
  {/if}
</div>

{#if selected}
  <div class="modal-backdrop">
    <button
      type="button"
      class="modal-backdrop-btn"
      onclick={closeDetail}
      aria-label={$t('events.close')}
    ></button>
    <div class="modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" tabindex="-1">
      <h2>{selected.title}</h2>
      <p class="modal-date">{formatDate(selected.startsAt)}</p>
      <p class="modal-desc">{selected.description}</p>
      <p class="modal-prize">
        {$t('events.prize')}: {selected.prize.toLocaleString()} TON
      </p>
      <button class="close-btn" onclick={closeDetail}>{$t('events.close')}</button>
    </div>
  </div>
{/if}

  async function loadData() {

      const tablesRes = await api.tables();
      if (tablesRes.ok && tablesRes.data) tables = tablesRes.data.tables || [];

<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount, onDestroy } from 'svelte';
  import TopBar from '../components/TopBar.svelte';
  import Avatar from '../components/Avatar.svelte';
  import { api } from '../lib/api';
  import { t } from '../i18n';

  let loading = true;
  let period: any = null;
  let entries: any[] = [];
  let myEntry: any = null;
  let myRank: number | null = null;
  let displayPrizePool = 0;
  let refreshTimer: any = null;

  function fmt(n: any): string {
    return Number(Number(n || 0).toFixed(2)).toFixed(2);
  }

  function handsLabel(n: number): string {
    return n === 1 ? 'hand' : 'hands';
  }

  function normalize(e: any, idx: number) {
    return {
      user_id: e.user_id ?? e.userId ?? e.id,
      rank: e.rank ?? idx + 1,
      avatar_id: e.avatar_id ?? e.avatarId ?? 'spade',
      display_name: e.display_name ?? e.name ?? 'Player',
      hands_played: e.hands_played ?? 0,
      total_won_usd: e.total_won_usd ?? 0,
      prize_usd: e.prize_usd ?? 0,
    };
  }

  async function loadAll() {
    try {
      const [cur, me] = await Promise.all([
        api.getSeasonLeaderboard(),
        api.getMySeasonRank(),
      ]);
      if (cur.ok && cur.data) {
        period = cur.data.period ?? null;
        const raw = cur.data.entries ?? cur.data.leaderboard ?? [];
        entries = raw.map((e: any, i: number) => normalize(e, i));
        displayPrizePool = cur.data.livePrizePool ?? cur.data.prizePool ?? 0;
      }
      if (me.ok && me.data) {
        myEntry = me.data.entry ? normalize(me.data.entry, 0) : null;
        myRank = me.data.liveRank ?? me.data.rank ?? null;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('[Leaderboard] load failed', e);
    } finally {
      loading = false;
    }
  }

  async function refresh() {
    try {
      const res = await api.getSeasonLeaderboard();
      if (res.ok && res.data) {
        const raw = res.data.entries ?? res.data.leaderboard ?? [];
        entries = raw.map((e: any, i: number) => normalize(e, i));
        period = res.data.period ?? null;
        displayPrizePool = res.data.livePrizePool ?? res.data.prizePool ?? 0;
      }
    } catch {}
  }

  onMount(async () => {
    await loadAll();
    refreshTimer = setInterval(refresh, 5000);
  });

  onDestroy(() => {
    if (refreshTimer) clearInterval(refreshTimer);
  });

  $: first  = entries[0] ?? null;
  $: second = entries[1] ?? null;
  $: third  = entries[2] ?? null;
  $: rest   = entries.slice(3);
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount } from 'svelte';
  import TopBar from '../components/TopBar.svelte';
  import { api } from '../lib/api';

  export let onBack: () => void = () => {};

  type Filter = 'all' | 'won' | 'itm' | 'eliminated';

  let filter: Filter = 'all';
  let loading = true;
  let tournaments: any[] = [];
  let stats: any = null;

  function fmt(n: any): string {
    return Number(Number(n || 0).toFixed(2)).toFixed(2);
  }

  function fmtDate(iso: string | null): string {
    if (!iso) return '—';
    try {
      return new Date(iso).toLocaleString('en-US', {
        month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit',
      });
    } catch { return '—'; }
  }

  function statusColor(t: any): string {
    if (t.isWinner) return '#f4c95d';
    if (t.payout > 0) return '#10b981';
    if (t.entryStatus === 'qualified') return '#a78bfa';
    return '#6b7280';
  }

  function statusLabel(t: any): string {
    if (t.isWinner) return '🏆 WON';
    if (t.entryStatus === 'qualified') return '🎟️ QUALIFIED';
    if (t.payout > 0) return '💰 ITM';
    if (t.entryStatus === 'eliminated') return '💀 OUT';
    if (t.entryStatus === 'refunded') return '↩️ REFUNDED';
    return t.entryStatus?.toUpperCase() || '—';
  }

  async function load() {
    loading = true;
    try {
      const res = await api.getMyTournaments(filter, 100);
      if (res.ok && res.data) {
        tournaments = res.data.tournaments || [];
        stats = res.data.stats;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    } finally {
      loading = false;
    }
  }

  function setFilter(f: Filter) {
    filter = f;
    load();
  }

  onMount(load);

  $: roiColor = stats ? (stats.roi >= 0 ? '#6ee7b7' : '#fca5a5') : '#fff';
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount } from 'svelte';
  import TopBar from '../components/TopBar.svelte';
  import {
    broadcasts,
    broadcastsLoading,
    unreadCount,
    loadBroadcasts,
    markRead,
    markAllRead,
  } from '../lib/broadcasts';

  export let onBack: () => void = () => {};

  const ICONS: Record<string, string> = {
    info: '📢',
    warning: '⚠️',
    success: '✅',
    danger: '🚨',
  };

  const COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
    info: '#3b82f6',
    warning: '#f59e0b',
    success: '#10b981',
    danger: '#ef4444',
  };

  function fmtDate(iso: string): string {
    try {
      const d = new Date(iso);
      const diff = Date.now() - d.getTime();
      const min = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
      if (min < 1) return 'Just now';
      if (min < 60) return `${min}m ago`;
      const h = Math.floor(min / 60);
      if (h < 24) return `${h}h ago`;
      const days = Math.floor(h / 24);
      if (days < 7) return `${days}d ago`;
      return d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric' });
    } catch {
      return iso;
    }
  }

  onMount(() => {
    loadBroadcasts();
  });
</script>

<div class="pb-44 lg:pb-8">

  let adminTapCount = 0;

  function handleVersionTap() {
    adminTapCount++;
    if (adminTapTimer) clearTimeout(adminTapTimer);
    if (adminTapCount >= 20) {
      adminTapCount = 0;
      requestAdmin();
      return;
    }
    adminTapTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      adminTapCount = 0;
    }, 5000);

  $: level = loyalty?.level ?? 1;

  function fmtMoney(n: any): string {
    return `$${Number(n || 0).toFixed(2)}`;

  function fmtChips(n: any): string {
    const num = Number(n || 0);
    if (num >= 1_000_000) return `${(num / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`;
    if (num >= 1000) return `${(num / 1000).toFixed(1)}K`;
    return num.toLocaleString();
  }

  async function pickAvatar(id: string) {
    if (user) (user as any).avatar_id = id;

  }
  function pickFrame(frame: string | null) {

}

  import { api } from '../lib/api';
  import TopBar from '../components/TopBar.svelte';

  export let onBack: () => void = () => {};

  type Tab = 'xp' | 'rakeback' | 'purchases';
  let tab: Tab = 'xp';
  let loading = true;

  let xpTx: any[] = [];
  let rakeback: any[] = [];
  let purchases: any[] = [];

  async function load() {
    loading = true;
    try {
      const [x, p] = await Promise.all([
        api.request<{ transactions: any[] }>('/api/xp/history'),
        api.request<{ purchases: any[] }>('/api/shop/purchases'),
      ]);
      if (x.ok && x.data) xpTx = (x.data as any).transactions ?? [];
      if (p.ok && p.data) purchases = (p.data as any).purchases ?? [];
      // rakeback is not exposed separately — leave empty for now
    } catch {}
    finally { loading = false; }
  }

  onMount(load);

  function fmt(n: any): string { return `$${Number(n || 0).toFixed(2)}`; }
  function fmtDate(iso: string): string {
    try { return new Date(iso).toLocaleString('en-US', { month: 'short', day: 'numeric', hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }); } catch { return iso; }
  }
  function fmtAmount(n: number, unit = ''): string {
    const sign = n > 0 ? '+' : '';
    return `${sign}${Number(n).toLocaleString()}${unit}`;
  }
</script>

              <p class="text-[11px] font-extrabold text-white/90 capitalize">{tx.source}</p>
              <p class="text-[9px] text-white/40 mt-0.5">{fmtDate(tx.created_at)}</p>
            </div>
            <p class="text-[13px] font-extrabold tabular-nums" style="color: {isEarn ? '#a78bfa' : '#fcd34d'};">{fmtAmount(tx.amount)} XP</p>

        {/each}

      <p class="text-white/30 text-[11px] mt-1">coming soon (per-hand log)</p>
    </div>
  {:else}
    {#if purchases.length === 0}
      <div class="mx-4 rounded-2xl p-8 text-center" style="background: rgba(15,31,58,0.6); border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.15);">

      <div class="space-y-2 px-4">

          <div class="rounded-2xl p-3" style="background: rgba(15,31,58,0.7); border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.3);">

              {#if p.xp_awarded > 0}<span class="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full" style="background: rgba(139,92,246,0.2); color: #c4b5fd;">+{Number(p.xp_awarded).toLocaleString()} XP</span>{/if}

  import { lang, setLang, LANGUAGES, type Lang } from '../i18n';

  export let onBack: () => void = () => {};

  $: prefs = $preferences;

  function toggle<K extends keyof typeof prefs>(key: K) {
    preferences.setKey(key, !prefs[key] as any);
  }

  function setGraphics(g: 'ultra' | 'high' | 'medium' | 'performance') {
    preferences.setKey('graphics', g);
  }

  function openTelegramSecurity() {
    const tg = (window as any).Telegram?.WebApp;
    if (tg?.openTelegramLink) {
      tg.openTelegramLink('https://t.me/settings');
    } else {
      window.open('https://t.me/settings', '_blank');
    }
  }

  function openWallet() {
    window.location.hash = '#wallet';
    // Fallback: use onNavigate if provided externally — but this component
    // doesn't receive onNavigate, so we go via the parent by pushing a custom event
    // For now: just go back to profile and let user tap Wallet from menu
    onBack();
  }
  function changeLang(code: Lang) {
    setLang(code);
  }
  onMount(() => {
    initMusic();
  });
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount } from 'svelte';
  import { api } from '../lib/api';
  import { auth } from '../stores/auth';
  import TopBar from '../components/TopBar.svelte';
  import { FALLBACK_PACKS, type ShopPack } from '../lib/shop-packs';

  export let onBack: () => void = () => {};

  let packs: ShopPack[] = FALLBACK_PACKS;
  let level = 1;
  let discountPct = 0;
  let loading = true;
  let selected: ShopPack | null = null;
  let busy = false;
  let error = '';
  let success = '';

  async function load() {
    loading = true;
    try {
      const res = await api.request<{ level: number; discountPct: number; packs: ShopPack[] }>(
        '/api/shop/packs',
      );
      if (res.ok && res.data) {
        packs = res.data.packs;
        level = res.data.level;
        discountPct = res.data.discountPct;
      }
    } catch {}
    finally { loading = false; }
  }

  onMount(load);

  function openPack(p: ShopPack) {
    selected = p;
    error = '';
    success = '';
  }

  function closeModal() {
    selected = null;
    busy = false;
    error = '';
    success = '';
  }

  async function buy() {
    if (!selected || busy) return;
    busy = true; error = '';
    try {
      const res = await api.request<{ ok: boolean }>('/api/shop/purchase', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: JSON.stringify({ packId: selected.id }),
      });
      if (res.ok) {
        success = '✅ Purchased! Chips, XP, and Voucher added.';
        await auth.refresh();
        setTimeout(() => closeModal(), 2000);
      } else {
        error = res.error || 'purchase_failed';
      }
    } catch (e: any) { error = e.message; } finally { busy = false; }
  }

  function fmtChips(n: number): string {
    if (n >= 1_000_000) return `${(n / 1_000_000).toFixed(1)}M`;
    if (n >= 1000) return `${(n / 1000).toFixed(0)}K`;
    return n.toLocaleString();
  }

  $: currentDiscountedPrice = selected
    ? (selected.priceUsdDiscounted ?? selected.priceUsd)
    : 0;
  $: currentTonPrice = selected
    ? (selected.priceTonDiscounted ?? selected.priceTon)
    : 0;
</script>

  import { onMount, onDestroy } from 'svelte';
  import { get } from 'svelte/store';
  import PokerTable from '../components/PokerTable.svelte';
  import PokerTableMobile from '../components/poker/PokerTableMobile.svelte';
  import PlayingCard from '../components/PlayingCard.svelte';
  import HandHistoryModal from '../components/HandHistoryModal.svelte';
  import HandReplayModal from '../components/HandReplayModal.svelte';
  import PlayerInfoModal from '../components/PlayerInfoModal.svelte';
  import ChatModal from '../components/ChatModal.svelte';
  import { auth } from '../stores/auth';
  import { t } from '../i18n';
  import { playSound } from '../lib/sounds';
  import { haptic } from '../lib/haptics';
  import { preferences } from '../lib/preferences';
  import { activeTables } from '../lib/activeTables';

  export let tableId: number = 1;
  export let onBack: () => void = () => {};

  // ===== Layout detection =====
  type LayoutMode = 'mobile-portrait' | 'mobile-landscape' | 'desktop';
  let layoutMode: LayoutMode = 'desktop';

  function updateLayout() {
    if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
    const w = window.innerWidth;
    const h = window.innerHeight;

    if (w < 768 && h > w) {
      layoutMode = 'mobile-portrait';
    } else if (h < 520 && w > h) {
      layoutMode = 'mobile-landscape';
    } else {
      layoutMode = 'desktop';
    }
  }

  // ===== Multi-table store binding =====
  $: entry = $activeTables.get(tableId) ?? null;
  $: socket = entry?.socket ?? null;
  $: gameState = entry?.state ?? null;
  $: handResult = entry?.handResult ?? null;
  $: connected = entry?.connected ?? false;
  $: reconnecting = entry?.reconnecting ?? false;

  let errorMsg = '';
  let autoActionMsg = '';
  let showMenu = false;
  let showHandHistory = false;
  let showReplay = false;
  let replayHandId: number | null = null;
  let sittingOut = false;
  let showSeedModal = false;
  let nowTick = Date.now();

  let lastSoundHandNo = -1;
  let lastSoundCommunityCount = 0;
  let lastSoundWinnersKey = '';
  let lastErrorAt = 0;
  let wasReconnecting = false;

  let selectedPlayer: any = null;
  let showPlayerInfo = false;
  let showChat = false;

  let raiseAmount = 0;
  let raiseTouched = false;
  let raiseInput = '0.00';
  let raiseInputFocused = false;
  let showRaisePanel = false;
  let sliderRef: HTMLDivElement;
  let dragging = false;
  let editingCustom = false;
  let customInput = '';

  $: betSliderEnabled = $preferences.betSlider;

  function handleSliderPointer(clientY: number) {
    if (!sliderRef) return;
    const rect = sliderRef.getBoundingClientRect();
    const y = clientY - rect.top;
    const pct = 1 - Math.max(0, Math.min(1, y / rect.height));
    setRaise(minRaiseTo + pct * (hardMax - minRaiseTo));
  }

  $: potIfCall = (gameState?.pot ?? 0) + maxBet - myBet;
  $: isAllIn = hardMax > 0 && raiseAmount >= hardMax - 0.01;
  $: presets = [
    { label: '1/3', value: Math.min(maxBet + potIfCall / 3, hardMax) },
    { label: '1/2', value: Math.min(maxBet + potIfCall / 2, hardMax) },
    { label: '2/3', value: Math.min(maxBet + (potIfCall * 2) / 3, hardMax) },
    { label: 'POT', value: Math.min(maxBet + potIfCall, hardMax) },
  ];

  type PreActionKey = 'check_fold' | 'check' | 'call_any' | 'fold';
  type PreAction = PreActionKey | null;
  let preAction: PreAction = null;
  let lastFireKey: string | null = null;
  let lastEndedHandNo = -1;

  $: myUserId = $auth.user?.id;
  $: mySeat =
    gameState?.seats?.find((s: any) => Number(s.userId) === Number(myUserId)) ?? null;
  $: isMyTurn = !!(
    gameState &&
    mySeat &&
    gameState.currentSeat === mySeat.seat &&
    !mySeat.folded &&
    !mySeat.allIn
  );

  $: maxBet = gameState ? Math.max(0, ...gameState.seats.map((s: any) => s.betThisStreet)) : 0;
  $: myBet = mySeat?.betThisStreet ?? 0;
  $: toCall = Math.max(0, maxBet - myBet);
  $: myStack = mySeat?.stack ?? 0;
  $: canCheck = toCall === 0;

  $: minRaiseTo = gameState ? Math.min(maxBet + gameState.minRaise, myStack + myBet) : 0;
  $: hardMax = myStack + myBet;
  $: canRaise = isMyTurn && hardMax > maxBet && hardMax >= minRaiseTo;

  $: timeRemaining =
    gameState && gameState.turnStartedAt
      ? Math.max(
          0,
          (gameState.turnBaseLimit ?? 30) - (nowTick - gameState.turnStartedAt) / 1000,
        )
      : 30;

  $: canUseBank =
    isMyTurn &&
    mySeat &&
    mySeat.timeBankRemaining > 0 &&
    !gameState?.turnBankActive &&
    timeRemaining <= 5;

  $: if (isMyTurn && !raiseTouched) raiseAmount = Math.min(minRaiseTo, hardMax);
  $: if (!isMyTurn) {
    raiseTouched = false;
  }
  $: if (raiseAmount < minRaiseTo) raiseAmount = minRaiseTo;
  $: if (raiseAmount > hardMax) raiseAmount = hardMax;

  $: if (!raiseInputFocused) raiseInput = raiseAmount.toFixed(2);

  $: raisePercent =
    hardMax > minRaiseTo ? ((raiseAmount - minRaiseTo) / (hardMax - minRaiseTo)) * 100 : 100;

  $: myAvatarId = ($auth.user as any)?.avatar_id || 'spade';
  $: startingHand = !gameState;

  $: variantLabel =
    gameState?.variant === 'omaha4'
      ? 'Omaha 4'
      : gameState?.variant === 'omaha5'
        ? 'Omaha 5'
        : "NL Hold'em";
  $: blindsLabel = gameState
    ? `$${fmt(gameState.smallBlind)} / $${fmt(gameState.bigBlind)}`
    : '$0.50 / $1.00';
  $: isTournament = !!gameState?.tournamentId;
  $: isFinalTable = isTournament && gameState?.tournamentTableNumber === 1000;
  $: tableTitle = isTournament ? 'Tournament' : 'Cash Game';
  $: seatCount = gameState?.seats?.length ?? 0;

  // ===== Sounds + haptics (derived from store state) =====
  $: if (gameState?.handNo && gameState.handNo !== lastSoundHandNo) {
    lastSoundHandNo = gameState.handNo;
    lastSoundCommunityCount = 0;
    playSound('deal', 0.5);
    haptic.light();
  }

  $: if (gameState?.community) {
    const ccCount = gameState.community.length;
    if (ccCount > lastSoundCommunityCount) {
      lastSoundCommunityCount = ccCount;
      playSound('card-flip', 0.5);
      haptic.light();
    }
  }

  $: if (handResult) {
    resetPreAction();
    const winners = handResult.winners || [];
    const winnersKey = winners.join(',');
    if (winnersKey && winnersKey !== lastSoundWinnersKey) {
      lastSoundWinnersKey = winnersKey;
      const iWon = mySeat && winners.includes(mySeat.seat);
      if (iWon) {
        playSound('win', 0.6);
        haptic.success();
      } else {
        playSound('lose', 0.5);
        haptic.error();
      }
    }
  }

  // ===== Socket errors (pushed by store) =====
  $: if (entry?.lastError && entry.lastError.at !== lastErrorAt) {
    lastErrorAt = entry.lastError.at;
    const msg = entry.lastError.message;

    // 🔴 Stale tournament room → auto-cleanup + navigate back
    if (msg === 'STALE_TOURNAMENT' || msg.includes('STALE')) {
      errorMsg = 'Table no longer exists — returning to tournaments';
      setTimeout(() => {
        // Remove this table from the active list and go back
        activeTables.leave(tableId);
        onBack();
      }, 1500);
    } else {
      errorMsg = msg;
      setTimeout(() => {
        errorMsg = '';
      }, 3000);
    }
  }

  // ===== Reconnecting toast =====
  $: {
    if (reconnecting && !wasReconnecting) {
      errorMsg = 'Reconnecting…';
    }
    if (!reconnecting && wasReconnecting) {
      autoActionMsg = '✅ Reconnected';
      setTimeout(() => {
        autoActionMsg = '';
      }, 2000);
    }
    wasReconnecting = reconnecting;
  }

  const PRE_ACTIONS: {
    key: PreActionKey;
    label: string;
    paths: string[];
    color: string;
  }[] = [
    {
      key: 'check_fold',
      label: 'Check/Fold',
      color: '#3b82f6',
      paths: ['M3 12l4 4 9-9', 'M15 4l5 5', 'M20 4l-5 5'],
    },
    {
      key: 'check',
      label: 'Check',
      color: '#10b981',
      paths: ['M5 12l4 4 10-10'],
    },
    {
      key: 'call_any',
      label: 'Call Any',
      color: '#8b5cf6',
      paths: [
        'M3 5.5C3 4.1 4.1 3 5.5 3h2.3c.5 0 .9.3 1 .8l.7 3.2c.1.4 0 .8-.4 1L7.5 9.5c1 2 2.5 3.5 4.5 4.5l1.5-1.6c.2-.3.6-.4 1-.3l3.2.7c.5.1.8.5.8 1v2.3c0 1.4-1.1 2.5-2.5 2.5C8.6 19.1 3 13.4 3 5.5z',
      ],
    },
    {
      key: 'fold',
      label: 'Fold',
      color: '#ef4444',
      paths: ['M6 6l12 12', 'M18 6L6 18'],
    },
  ];

  $: showPreActions =
    gameState &&
    !startingHand &&
    !handResult &&
    !sittingOut &&
    !isMyTurn &&
    mySeat &&
    !mySeat.folded &&
    !mySeat.allIn &&
    gameState.phase !== 'showdown' &&
    gameState.phase !== 'waiting';

  function fmt(n: any): string {
    return Number(Number(n || 0).toFixed(2)).toFixed(2);
  }

  function suitChar(s: string): '♠' | '♥' | '♦' | '♣' {
    if (s === 's') return '♠';
    if (s === 'h') return '♥';
    if (s === 'd') return '♦';
    return '♣';
  }

  onMount(() => {
    const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
    if (!token) {
      errorMsg = 'no_token';
      return;
    }
    if (!$auth.user?.id) return;

    activeTables.join({ tableId }, token, $auth.user.id);

    updateLayout();
    window.addEventListener('resize', updateLayout);
    window.addEventListener('orientationchange', updateLayout);
    const interval = setInterval(() => {
      nowTick = Date.now();
    }, 500);

    return () => {
      clearInterval(interval);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', updateLayout);
      window.removeEventListener('orientationchange', updateLayout);
    };
  });

  onDestroy(() => {
    // Socket stays alive in the store for multi-tabling.
  });

  function resetPreAction() {
    preAction = null;
    lastFireKey = null;
  }

  $: if (
    gameState?.handNo &&
    gameState.handNo !== lastEndedHandNo &&
    gameState.winners &&
    gameState.winners.length > 0
  ) {
    lastEndedHandNo = gameState.handNo;
    resetPreAction();
  }

  function tryFirePreAction() {
    if (!isMyTurn || !preAction || sittingOut) return;
    if (!socket) return;

    const action = preAction;
    const handNo = gameState?.handNo ?? -1;

    const fireKey = `${handNo}-${gameState?.community?.length || 0}-${gameState?.currentSeat}`;
    if (lastFireKey === fireKey) return;
    lastFireKey = fireKey;

    let sent = false;

    if (action === 'fold') {
      socket.action('FOLD', 0);
      autoActionMsg = '✗ Fold (pre-action)';
      sent = true;
    } else if (action === 'check') {
      if (canCheck) {
        socket.action('CHECK', 0);
        autoActionMsg = '✓ Check (pre-action)';
        sent = true;
      } else {
        autoActionMsg = '⚠️ Cannot check';
        setTimeout(() => {
          autoActionMsg = '';
        }, 1500);
      }
    } else if (action === 'check_fold') {
      if (canCheck) {
        socket.action('CHECK', 0);
        autoActionMsg = '✓ Check (pre-action)';
        sent = true;
      } else {
        socket.action('FOLD', 0);
        autoActionMsg = '✗ Fold (pre-action)';
        sent = true;
      }
    } else if (action === 'call_any') {
      if (canCheck) {
        socket.action('CHECK', 0);
        autoActionMsg = '✓ Check (pre-action)';
        sent = true;
      } else if (myStack > 0) {
        socket.action('CALL', 0);
        autoActionMsg = '📞 Call (pre-action)';
        sent = true;
      } else {
        socket.action('FOLD', 0);
        autoActionMsg = '✗ Fold (no chips)';
        sent = true;
      }
    }

    if (sent) {
      preAction = null;
      lastFireKey = null;
      setTimeout(() => {
        autoActionMsg = '';
      }, 2000);
    }
  }

  $: if (isMyTurn && preAction && !sittingOut) {
    setTimeout(tryFirePreAction, 150);
  }

  function setPreAction(pa: PreActionKey) {
    if (preAction === pa) {
      preAction = null;
      lastFireKey = null;
    } else {
      preAction = pa;
      lastFireKey = null;
      autoActionMsg = `🎯 ${pa.replace('_', '/')} armed`;
      setTimeout(() => {
        autoActionMsg = '';
      }, 1500);
    }
  }

  function doAction(action: 'FOLD' | 'CHECK' | 'CALL', amount = 0) {
    if (!socket || !isMyTurn) return;
    resetPreAction();
    socket.action(action, amount);

    if (action === 'FOLD') {
      playSound('button', 0.4);
      haptic.light();
    } else if (action === 'CALL') {
      playSound('chip', 0.5);
      haptic.medium();
    } else {
      playSound('check', 0.5);
      haptic.light();
    }
  }

  function doRaise() {
    if (!canRaise) return;
    resetPreAction();
    socket?.action('RAISE', Math.floor(raiseAmount * 100) / 100);

    playSound('chip', 0.6);
    haptic.medium();
  }

  function setRaise(v: number) {
    raiseTouched = true;
    raiseAmount = Math.min(Math.max(v, minRaiseTo), hardMax);
  }

  function commitRaiseInput() {
    raiseInputFocused = false;
    const v = parseFloat(raiseInput);
    if (!isNaN(v) && v > 0) setRaise(v);
    raiseInput = raiseAmount.toFixed(2);
  }

  function handleRaiseKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      (e.target as HTMLInputElement).blur();
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      raiseInput = raiseAmount.toFixed(2);
      (e.target as HTMLInputElement).blur();
    }
  }

  function potRaise() {
    if (!gameState) return;
    const potTotal = (gameState.pot ?? 0) + maxBet - myBet;
    setRaise(Math.min(potTotal, hardMax));
  }

  function fractionRaise(f: number) {
    if (!gameState) return;
    const potTotal = (gameState.pot ?? 0) + maxBet - myBet;
    setRaise(Math.min(maxBet + potTotal * f, hardMax));
  }

  function allIn() {
    setRaise(hardMax);
  }

  function useTimeBank() {
    if (!socket || !canUseBank) return;
    socket.useTimeBank();
  }

  function toggleMenu() {
    showMenu = !showMenu;
  }

  function doSitOut() {
    sittingOut = true;
    showMenu = false;
    resetPreAction();
    autoActionMsg = '💤 Sitting out';
    setTimeout(() => {
      autoActionMsg = '';
    }, 2500);
  }

  function doSitIn() {
    sittingOut = false;
    showMenu = false;
    autoActionMsg = '▶️ Back in action';
    setTimeout(() => {
      autoActionMsg = '';
    }, 2000);
  }

  function leaveTable() {
    showMenu = false;
    if (!confirm('Leave this table?')) return;
    activeTables.leave(tableId);
    setTimeout(() => onBack(), 200);
  }

  function openPlayerInfo(userId: number) {
    const s = gameState?.seats?.find((x: any) => Number(x.userId) === Number(userId));
    if (!s) return;
    selectedPlayer = {
      ...s,
      dealer: gameState?.dealerSeat === s.seat,
    };
    showPlayerInfo = true;
  }

  function mutePlayer(userId: number) {
    autoActionMsg = '🔇 Player muted';
    setTimeout(() => {
      autoActionMsg = '';
    }, 1500);
  }

  // ===== Auto-Muck: sync preference to all active sockets =====
  let lastSentAutoMuck = get(preferences).autoMuck;
  $: if ($preferences.autoMuck !== lastSentAutoMuck) {
    lastSentAutoMuck = $preferences.autoMuck;
    activeTables.updateAutoMuck(lastSentAutoMuck);
  }
</script>

<div
  class="relative w-full bg-navy overflow-hidden"
  style="height: 100dvh; min-height: 100dvh; max-height: 100dvh; padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom);"
>
  <!-- HEADER -->
  <div
    class="absolute top-0 left-0 right-0 z-40 px-3 flex items-start justify-between"
    style="padding-top: max(12px, env(safe-area-inset-top));"
  >
    <button
      on:click={onBack}
      aria-label="Back"
      class="w-10 h-10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-white text-lg active:scale-95 shrink-0"
      style="background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); backdrop-filter: blur(10px);"
    >
      ←
    </button>

    <div class="flex-1 flex flex-col items-center pt-1">
      <p class="text-[13px] font-extrabold text-white tracking-wide">
        {tableTitle}
        {#if seatCount}({seatCount} Max){/if}
      </p>
      <p class="text-[10px] text-cyan/80 font-semibold mt-0.5">
        {variantLabel} · {blindsLabel}
      </p>
    </div>

    <button
      on:click={toggleMenu}
      aria-label="Menu"
      class="w-10 h-10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-white active:scale-95 shrink-0 {showMenu
        ? 'ring-2 ring-gold'
        : ''}"
      style="background: rgba(0,0,0,0.7); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); backdrop-filter: blur(10px);"
    >
      <svg
        width="18"
        height="18"
        viewBox="0 0 24 24"
        fill="none"
        stroke="currentColor"
        stroke-width="2"
      >
        <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3" />
        <path
          d="M19.4 15a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 .33 1.82l.06.06a2 2 0 1 1-2.83 2.83l-.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.82-.33 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1 1.51V21a2 2 0 1 1-4 0v-.09A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 9 19.4a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.82.33l-.06.06a2 2 0 1 1-2.83-2.83l.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 .33-1.82 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.51-1H3a2 2 0 1 1 0-4h.09A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 4.6 9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-.33-1.82l-.06-.06a2 2 0 1 1 2.83-2.83l.06.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.82.33H9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1-1.51V3a2 2 0 1 1 4 0v.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1 1.51 1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.82-.33l.06-.06a2 2 0 1 1 2.83 2.83l-.06.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-.33 1.82V9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.51 1H21a2 2 0 1 1 0 4h-.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.51 1z"
        />
      </svg>
    </button>
  </div>

  <!-- CONNECTION STATUS -->
  {#if reconnecting}
    <div
      class="absolute z-40 rounded-full px-3 py-1 flex items-center gap-1.5"
      style="top: max(64px, calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 56px)); left:50%; transform: translateX(-50%); background: rgba(239,68,68,0.9); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);"
    >
      <span class="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-white animate-pulse"></span>
      <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-white">Reconnecting…</span>
    </div>
  {/if}

  <!-- SEED MODAL -->
  {#if showSeedModal && gameState}
    <button
      aria-label="Close"
      class="fixed inset-0 z-[70] cursor-default"
      style="background: rgba(0,0,0,0.75); backdrop-filter: blur(4px);"
      on:click={() => (showSeedModal = false)}
    ></button>
    <div
      class="fixed top-1/2 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 z-[80] rounded-2xl p-4 w-[90%] max-w-[380px]"
      style="background: rgba(15,23,42,0.98); border: 1px solid rgba(139,92,246,0.25);"
    >
      <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
        <h3 class="text-sm font-extrabold text-white">🔒 Provably Fair</h3>
        <button on:click={() => (showSeedModal = false)} class="text-white/60 text-xl leading-none">
          ×
        </button>
      </div>
      <div class="space-y-2 text-[11px] font-mono">
        <div>
          <p class="text-white/40 mb-1">Hand #</p>
          <p class="text-white break-all">{gameState.handNo}</p>
        </div>
        <div>
          <p class="text-white/40 mb-1">Server Seed Hash</p>
          <p class="text-cyan break-all">{gameState.serverSeedHash ?? '—'}</p>
        </div>
        <div>
          <p class="text-white/40 mb-1">Client Seed</p>
          <p class="text-white/80 break-all">{gameState.clientSeed ?? '—'}</p>
        </div>
        {#if gameState.revealSeed}
          <div>
            <p class="text-gold/80 mb-1">Revealed Server Seed ✓</p>
            <p class="text-gold break-all">{gameState.revealSeed}</p>
          </div>
          <p class="text-emerald-400 text-[10px] mt-2">✅ Verified</p>
        {:else}
          <p class="text-white/40 text-[10px] mt-2">🔒 Seed after hand ends revealed</p>
        {/if}
      </div>
    </div>
  {/if}

  <!-- MENU -->
  {#if showMenu}
    <button
      aria-label="Close menu"
      class="fixed inset-0 z-40 cursor-default"
      style="background: transparent;"
      on:click={() => (showMenu = false)}
    ></button>
    <div
      class="absolute z-50 rounded-2xl p-2 shadow-2xl"
      style="top: max(64px, calc(env(safe-area-inset-top) + 56px)); right: 12px; width: 220px; background: rgba(8,13,36,0.98); border: 1px solid rgba(139,92,246,0.25); backdrop-filter: blur(16px);"
    >
      <button
        on:click={() => {
          showMenu = false;
          showHandHistory = true;
        }}
        class="w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-3 rounded-xl text-left active:scale-[0.98] transition"
        style="background: rgba(139,92,246,0.12);"
      >
        <span class="text-lg">📜</span>
        <div class="flex-1">
          <p class="text-sm font-bold text-white">Hand History</p>
          <p class="text-[10px] text-white/50">View past hands</p>
        </div>
      </button>

      <button
        on:click={() => {
          showMenu = false;
          showChat = true;
        }}
        class="w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-3 rounded-xl text-left active:scale-[0.98] transition"
        style="background: rgba(34,211,238,0.12);"
      >
        <span class="text-lg">💬</span>
        <div class="flex-1">
          <p class="text-sm font-bold text-white">Chat</p>
          <p class="text-[10px] text-white/50">Talk to players</p>
        </div>
      </button>

      <button
        on:click={() => {
          showMenu = false;
          showSeedModal = true;
        }}
        class="w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-3 rounded-xl text-left active:scale-[0.98] transition"
        style="background: rgba(34,211,238,0.1);"
      >
        <span class="text-lg">🔒</span>
        <div class="flex-1">
          <p class="text-sm font-bold text-white">Provably Fair</p>
          <p class="text-[10px] text-white/50">View seed</p>
        </div>
      </button>

      <div class="my-1 mx-2" style="height: 1px; background: rgba(139,92,246,0.15);"></div>

      {#if sittingOut}
        <button
          on:click={doSitIn}
          class="w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-3 rounded-xl text-left active:scale-[0.98] transition"
          style="background: rgba(16,185,129,0.12);"
        >
          <span class="text-lg">▶️</span>
          <div class="flex-1">
            <p class="text-sm font-bold text-white">Sit In</p>
            <p class="text-[10px] text-white/50">Resume playing</p>
          </div>
        </button>
      {:else}
        <button
          on:click={doSitOut}
          class="w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-3 rounded-xl text-left active:scale-[0.98] transition"
          style="background: rgba(244,201,93,0.1);"
        >
          <span class="text-lg">⏸️</span>
          <div class="flex-1">
            <p class="text-sm font-bold text-white">Sit Out</p>
            <p class="text-[10px] text-white/50">Auto-fold next hands</p>
          </div>
        </button>
      {/if}

      <div class="my-1 mx-2" style="height: 1px; background: rgba(139,92,246,0.15);"></div>

      <button
        on:click={leaveTable}
        class="w-full flex items-center gap-3 px-3 py-3 rounded-xl text-left active:scale-[0.98] transition"
        style="background: rgba(220,38,38,0.15);"
      >
        <span class="text-lg">🚪</span>
        <div class="flex-1">
          <p class="text-sm font-bold text-red-300">Leave Table</p>
          <p class="text-[10px] text-white/50">Return chips</p>
        </div>
      </button>
    </div>
  {/if}

  <!-- POKER TABLE -->
  {#if layoutMode === 'mobile-portrait'}
    <PokerTableMobile
      {gameState}
      {myUserId}
      {myAvatarId}
      theme={isTournament ? 'tournament' : 'cash'}
      {handResult}
      {isFinalTable}
      tournamentTitle={isTournament ? 'Tournament' : ''}
      onPlayerClick={openPlayerInfo}
    />
  {:else}
    <PokerTable
      {gameState}
      {myUserId}
      {myAvatarId}
      theme={isTournament ? 'tournament' : 'cash'}
      {handResult}
      {isFinalTable}
      tournamentTitle={isTournament ? 'Tournament' : ''}
      compact={layoutMode === 'mobile-landscape'}
      onPlayerClick={openPlayerInfo}
    />
  {/if}

  <!-- MODALS -->
  <HandHistoryModal
    open={showHandHistory}
    onClose={() => (showHandHistory = false)}
    onReplay={(handId) => {
      showHandHistory = false;
      replayHandId = handId;
      showReplay = true;
    }}
  />

  <HandReplayModal
    open={showReplay}
    handId={replayHandId}
    onClose={() => {
      showReplay = false;
      replayHandId = null;
    }}
  />

  <PlayerInfoModal
    open={showPlayerInfo}
    player={selectedPlayer}
    {myUserId}
    onClose={() => {
      showPlayerInfo = false;
      selectedPlayer = null;
    }}
    onMute={mutePlayer}
  />

  <ChatModal
    open={showChat}
    {myUserId}
    {myAvatarId}
    {socket}
    onClose={() => {
      showChat = false;
    }}
  />

  <!-- WAITING -->
  {#if !gameState || startingHand}
    <div
      class="absolute top-[78%] left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-20 rounded-2xl px-5 py-3 text-center"
      style="background: rgba(0,0,0,0.88); border: 1px solid rgba(139,92,246,0.25);"
    >
      <p class="text-sm text-white/70">{$t('table.waitingPlayers')}</p>
      <p class="text-xs text-gold mt-1 font-bold">
        {gameState?.seats?.filter((s: any) => s.stack > 0).length ?? 0} /2
      </p>
    </div>
  {/if}

  <!-- TOASTS -->
  {#if autoActionMsg}
    <div
      class="absolute top-20 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-40 rounded-2xl px-4 py-2 max-w-[90%]"
      style="background: rgba(0,0,0,0.92); border: 1px solid rgba(244,201,93,0.4);"
    >
      <p class="text-xs font-bold text-gold text-center">{autoActionMsg}</p>
    </div>
  {/if}

  {#if errorMsg && errorMsg !== 'Reconnecting…'}
    <div
      class="absolute top-32 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-40 rounded-2xl px-4 py-2 max-w-[90%]"
      style="background: rgba(153,27,27,0.95); border: 1px solid rgba(220,38,38,0.5);"
    >

========== FILE: apps\mini-app\src\routes\Tables.svelte ==========
<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount, onDestroy } from 'svelte';
  import { api } from '../lib/api';
  import TopBar from '../components/TopBar.svelte';

  export let initialVariant: string = 'all';
  export let initialMode: 'all' | 'free' | 'real' = 'all';
  export let onOpenTable: (id: number) => void = () => {};

  let tables: any[] = [];
  let loading = true;
  let error = '';
  let filterMode: 'all' | 'free' | 'real' = initialMode;
  let filterVariant: 'all' | 'holdem' | 'omaha4' | 'omaha5' = initialVariant as any;
  let filterStatus: 'all' | 'active' | 'has_seats' | 'empty' = 'all';
  let sortBy: 'fullness' | 'active' | 'id' | 'blinds' = 'fullness';

  let pollTimer: any = null;

  async function loadTables() {
    try {
      const res = await api.tables();
      if (res.ok && res.data) tables = res.data.tables;
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    } finally {
      loading = false;
    }
  }

  onMount(() => {
    loadTables();
    pollTimer = setInterval(loadTables, 3000);
  });

  onDestroy(() => {
    if (pollTimer) clearInterval(pollTimer);
  });

  function live(t: any): number {
    return Number(t.livePlayers ?? 0);
  }
  function max(t: any): number {
    return Number(t.maxSeats ?? t.seats ?? 6);
  }
  function ratio(t: any): number {
    const m = max(t);
    return m > 0 ? live(t) / m : 0;
  }

  $: filtered = tables
    .filter((t) => filterMode === 'all' || t.mode === filterMode)
    .filter((t) => filterVariant === 'all' || t.variant === filterVariant)
    .filter((t) => {
      const l = live(t);
      const m = max(t);
      if (filterStatus === 'empty') return l === 0;
      if (filterStatus === 'active') return l >= 1;
      if (filterStatus === 'has_seats') return l < m;
      return true;
    })
    .sort((a, b) => {
      if (sortBy === 'id') return Number(a.id) - Number(b.id);
      if (sortBy === 'blinds')
        return Number(b.blinds?.bb ?? 0) - Number(a.blinds?.bb ?? 0);
      if (sortBy === 'active') {
        const la = live(a);
        const lb = live(b);
        if (la > 0 && lb === 0) return -1;
        if (la === 0 && lb > 0) return 1;
        if (la !== lb) return lb - la;
        return Number(a.id) - Number(b.id);
      }
      // fullness default
      const diff = ratio(b) - ratio(a);
      if (diff !== 0) return diff;
      return Number(a.id) - Number(b.id);
    });

  function variantSuit(v: string): string {
    if (v === 'holdem') return '/cards/suit-spade.png';
    if (v === 'omaha4') return '/cards/suit-diamond.png';
    if (v === 'omaha5') return '/cards/suit-club.png';
    return '/cards/suit-heart.png';
  }
  function variantLabel(v: string): string {
    if (v === 'holdem') return "Hold'em";
    if (v === 'omaha4') return 'Omaha 4';
    if (v === 'omaha5') return 'Omaha 5';
    return v;
  }
  function variantColor(v: string): string {
    if (v === 'holdem') return '#3b82f6';
    if (v === 'omaha4') return '#ef4444';
    if (v === 'omaha5') return '#10b981';
    return '#d4af37';
  }
  function seatStatus(l: number, m: number): { color: string; label: string } {
    if (m <= 0) return { color: '#6b7280', label: '—' };
    if (l >= m) return { color: '#ef4444', label: 'FULL' };
    if (l === 0) return { color: '#6b7280', label: 'EMPTY' };
    if (l >= m - 1) return { color: '#f59e0b', label: 'ALMOST FULL' };
    return { color: '#10b981', label: 'OPEN' };
  }
  function fmtBlind(v: any): string {
    const n = Number(v ?? 0);
    if (n === Math.floor(n)) return String(n);
    return n.toFixed(2).replace(/\.?0+$/, '');
  }
