<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount, onDestroy } from 'svelte';
  import { api } from '../lib/api';
  import { auth } from '../stores/auth';
  import { getRealtime, realtimeConnected, TOURNAMENT_EVENT_RE } from '../lib/realtime';
  import { pushNotif } from '../lib/notifications';
  import Avatar from '../components/Avatar.svelte';

  export let tournamentId: number;
  export let onBack: () => void = () => {};
  export let onOpenTable: (tid: number, virtualTableId: number) => void = () => {};

  let t: any = null;
  let loading = true;
  let error = '';
  let acting = false;
  let toast = '';
  let expandBlinds = false;

  let nowTick = Date.now();
  let fetchedAt = 0;
  let pollTimer: any = null;
  let tickTimer: any = null;

  $: myUserId = $auth.user?.id;
  $: isLive = t?.status === 'running' || t?.status === 'final_table';
  $: isPaused = t?.status === 'paused';
  $: isFinished = t?.status === 'finished' || t?.status === 'cancelled';
  $: canRegisterNow = t && (t.status === 'registering' || t.status === 'scheduled');

  // Timer
  $: elapsedSinceFetch = fetchedAt > 0 ? Math.max(0, (nowTick - fetchedAt) / 1000) : 0;
  $: remainingSec = t && !isPaused
    ? Math.max(0, Math.round((t.nextLevelIn ?? 0) - elapsedSinceFetch))
    : 0;
  $: totalSec = t?.currentLevelData?.durationSec ?? 0;
  $: elapsedSec = Math.max(0, totalSec - remainingSec);
  $: progressPct = totalSec > 0 ? Math.min(100, (elapsedSec / totalSec) * 100) : 0;

  // Blinds
  $: allBlinds = t?.blindStructure ?? [];
  $: currentLevel = t?.currentLevel ?? 0;
  $: visibleBlinds = (() => {
    if (expandBlinds) return allBlinds;
    if (allBlinds.length === 0) return [];
    const start = Math.max(1, currentLevel - 2);
    const end = currentLevel + 2;
    return allBlinds.filter((b: any) => b.level >= start && b.level <= end);
  })();

  // Players
  $: allPlayers = t?.players ?? [];
  $: top30 = allPlayers.slice(0, 30);
  $: selfPlayer = myUserId
    ? allPlayers.find((p: any) => Number(p.userId) === Number(myUserId))
    : null;
  $: showSelfPinned =
    !!selfPlayer && !top30.some((p: any) => p.userId === selfPlayer.userId);
  $: activePlayers = allPlayers.filter((p: any) => p.status === 'active');
  $: avgStack =
    activePlayers.length > 0
      ? activePlayers.reduce((s: number, p: any) => s + Number(p.stack || 0), 0) /
        activePlayers.length
      : 0;
  $: displayPlayerCount = isLive || isFinished
    ? (t?.totalPlayers ?? 0)
    : (t?.registeredCount ?? 0);

  function fmt(n: any, d = 2): string {
    return Number(Number(n || 0).toFixed(d)).toFixed(d);
  }
  function fmtInt(n: any): string {
    return Math.round(Number(n || 0)).toLocaleString();
  }
  function fmtTime(sec: number): string {
    if (sec <= 0) return '00:00';
    const m = Math.floor(sec / 60);
    const s = Math.floor(sec % 60);
    return `${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  }
  function fmtDate(iso: string | null): string {
    if (!iso) return '—';
    try {
      return new Date(iso).toLocaleString('en-US', {
        month: 'short', day: 'numeric',
        hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit',
      });
    } catch { return '—'; }
  }
  function statusColor(s: string): string {
    if (s === 'running') return '#10b981';
    if (s === 'final_table') return '#d4af37';
    if (s === 'registering') return '#22d3ee';
    if (s === 'scheduled') return '#8b5cf6';
    if (s === 'finished') return '#6b7280';
    if (s === 'paused') return '#f59e0b';
    if (s === 'cancelled') return '#ef4444';
    return '#6b7280';
  }
  function statusLabel(s: string): string {
    return String(s).replace('_', ' ').toUpperCase();
  }
  function rankIcon(idx: number): string {
    if (idx === 0) return '🥇';
    if (idx === 1) return '🥈';
    if (idx === 2) return '🥉';
    return '';
  }
  function flash(msg: string) {
    toast = msg;
    setTimeout(() => (toast = ''), 2500);
  }
  function copyId() {
    try {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(String(tournamentId));
      flash('📋 ID copied');
    } catch {}
  }

  async function load() {
    error = '';
    try {
      const res = await api.getTournament(tournamentId);
      if (res.ok && res.data) {
        t = res.data;
        fetchedAt = Date.now();
      } else if (!t) {
        error = res.error || 'not_found';
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      if (!t) error = e.message;
    } finally {
      loading = false;
    }
  }

  async function doRegister() {
    if (acting) return;
    acting = true;
    try {
      const res = await api.registerTournament(tournamentId);
      if (res.ok) { flash('✅ Registered!'); await load(); }
      else flash('❌ ' + (res.error || 'failed'));
    } catch (e: any) { flash('❌ ' + e.message); }
    finally { acting = false; }
  }

  async function doUnregister() {
    if (acting) return;
    acting = true;
    try {
      const res = await api.unregisterTournament(tournamentId);
      if (res.ok) { flash('↩️ Unregistered'); await load(); }
      else flash('❌ ' + (res.error || 'failed'));
    } catch (e: any) { flash('❌ ' + e.message); }
    finally { acting = false; }
  }

  function onAnyEvent(event: string, ...args: any[]): void {
    const m = event.match(TOURNAMENT_EVENT_RE);
    if (!m) return;
    const tid = Number(m[1]);
    if (tid !== tournamentId) return;
    const type = m[2];
    const data = args[0] ?? {};

    if (type === 'level') {
      pushNotif({
        icon: '⏫',
        title: `Level ${data.level ?? '?'} — blinds up`,
        message: `${data.sb ?? '?'}/${data.bb ?? '?'}${data.ante ? ` · ante ${data.ante}` : ''}`,
        color: '#f4c95d',
      });
    } else if (type === 'elimination') {
      pushNotif({
        icon: '💀',
        title: `${data.displayName ?? 'Player'} eliminated`,
        message: `Position #${data.finalPosition ?? '?'}`,
        color: '#ef4444',
      });
    } else if (type === 'final_table') {
      pushNotif({ icon: '🏆', title: 'FINAL TABLE', color: '#f4c95d' });
    } else if (type === 'finished') {
      pushNotif({ icon: '🏁', title: 'Tournament finished', color: '#10b981' });
    }
    load();
  }

  onMount(() => {
    load();
    pollTimer = setInterval(load, 3000);
    tickTimer = setInterval(() => { nowTick = Date.now(); }, 1000);
    return () => {
      if (pollTimer) clearInterval(pollTimer);
      if (tickTimer) clearInterval(tickTimer);
    };
  });

  $: if ($realtimeConnected) {
    const s = getRealtime();
    if (s) { s.offAny(onAnyEvent); s.onAny(onAnyEvent); }
  }

  onDestroy(() => {
    const s = getRealtime();
    if (s) s.offAny(onAnyEvent);
    if (pollTimer) clearInterval(pollTimer);
    if (tickTimer) clearInterval(tickTimer);
  });
</script>

    >
      <div class="absolute -top-12 -right-12 w-40 h-40 rounded-full opacity-20 pointer-events-none"

          class="text-4xl font-extrabold tabular-nums leading-none"
          style="
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f4e5a8, #d4af37 50%, #a87a15);
            -webkit-background-clip: text;
            background-clip: text;
            -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
          "
        >
          ${fmt(t.totalPrizePool)}
        </span>
      </div>

      {#if t.guaranteed > 0}
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2 text-[10px] mb-3 relative">
          <span class="text-white/60">
            Guaranteed <span class="text-white font-bold">${fmt(t.guaranteed)}</span>
          </span>
          {#if t.overlay > 0}
            <span class="text-white/30">·</span>
            <span class="text-orange-300 font-bold">Overlay ${fmt(t.overlay)}</span>
          {:else}
            <span class="text-white/30">·</span>
            <span class="text-emerald-300 font-bold">No overlay</span>
          {/if}
        </div>
      {/if}

      <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 pt-3 relative" style="border-top: 1px solid rgba(244,201,93,0.2);">
        <div class="text-center">
          <p class="text-[9px] text-white/40 uppercase font-bold mb-1">Players</p>
          <p class="text-base font-extrabold text-white tabular-nums leading-none">
            {displayPlayerCount}<span class="text-white/40 text-xs">/{t.maxPlayers}</span>
          </p>
        </div>
        <div class="text-center" style="border-left: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);">
          <p class="text-[9px] text-white/40 uppercase font-bold mb-1">Avg Stack</p>
          <p class="text-base font-extrabold text-white tabular-nums leading-none">
            {avgStack > 0 ? fmtInt(avgStack) : '—'}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div class="text-center">
          <p class="text-[9px] text-white/40 uppercase font-bold mb-1">Blinds</p>
          <p class="text-base font-extrabold tabular-nums leading-none" style="color: #67e8f9;">
            {#if t.currentLevelData}
              {fmtInt(t.currentLevelData.sb)}/{fmtInt(t.currentLevelData.bb)}
            {:else}
              —
            {/if}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- LEVEL TIMER -->
    {#if isLive || isPaused}
      <div
        class="rounded-3xl p-4 mb-3 relative overflow-hidden"
        style="
          background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(15,31,58,0.85), rgba(7,14,27,0.95));
          border: 1.5px solid {isPaused ? 'rgba(245,158,11,0.5)' : 'rgba(251,146,60,0.4)'};
          {isPaused ? 'box-shadow: 0 0 24px rgba(245,158,11,0.2);' : ''}
        "
      >
        <div class="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
          <div class="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span class="text-base">{isPaused ? '⏸️' : '⏱️'}</span>
            <p class="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest font-extrabold"
               style="color: {isPaused ? '#fbbf24' : '#fb923c'};">
              {isPaused ? 'Paused' : `Level ${currentLevel}`}
            </p>
          </div>
          {#if !isPaused}
            <p class="text-[9px] text-white/40 font-bold">Next in</p>
          {/if}
        </div>

        {#if !isPaused}
          <div class="flex items-baseline justify-center mb-3">
            <span
              class="text-4xl font-extrabold tabular-nums leading-none"
              style="
                color: {remainingSec <= 30 ? '#fca5a5' : '#fb923c'};
                text-shadow: 0 0 16px {remainingSec <= 30 ? 'rgba(239,68,68,0.6)' : 'rgba(251,146,60,0.5)'};
                font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
              "
            >
              {fmtTime(remainingSec)}
            </span>
          </div>

          <div class="w-full h-1.5 rounded-full overflow-hidden mb-3" style="background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);">
            <div
              class="h-full rounded-full transition-all"
              style="
                width: {progressPct}%;
                background: linear-gradient(90deg, #fb923c, #f97316);
                box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(251,146,60,0.6);
              "
            ></div>
          </div>
        {:else}
          <p class="text-center text-[11px] text-amber-300 font-bold mb-3">
            Level will resume when tournament is resumed
          </p>
        {/if}

        {#if t.currentLevelData}
          <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 pt-3" style="border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08);">
            <div class="text-center">
              <p class="text-[9px] text-white/40 uppercase font-bold mb-1">Small Blind</p>
              <p class="text-sm font-extrabold text-white tabular-nums">
                {fmtInt(t.currentLevelData.sb)}
              </p>
            </div>
            <div class="text-center" style="border-left: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);">
              <p class="text-[9px] text-white/40 uppercase font-bold mb-1">Big Blind</p>
              <p class="text-sm font-extrabold text-white tabular-nums">
                {fmtInt(t.currentLevelData.bb)}
              </p>
            </div>
            <div class="text-center">
              <p class="text-[9px] text-white/40 uppercase font-bold mb-1">Ante</p>
              <p class="text-sm font-extrabold text-white tabular-nums">
                {t.currentLevelData.ante > 0 ? fmtInt(t.currentLevelData.ante) : '—'}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {#if t.nextLevelData}
            <div class="mt-3 pt-2 text-center" style="border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);">
              <p class="text-[9px] text-white/40 uppercase tracking-wider font-bold">
                Next · L{t.nextLevelData.level}
              </p>
              <p class="text-[11px] font-extrabold text-white/70 tabular-nums mt-0.5">
                {fmtInt(t.nextLevelData.sb)}/{fmtInt(t.nextLevelData.bb)}
                {#if t.nextLevelData.ante > 0}
                  <span class="text-white/50">+a{fmtInt(t.nextLevelData.ante)}</span>
                {/if}
              </p>
            </div>
          {/if}
        {/if}
      </div>
    {/if}

    <!-- YOUR STATUS -->
    {#if t.yourEntry}
      {@const ye = t.yourEntry}
      <div
        class="rounded-3xl p-4 mb-3"
        style="
          background: linear-gradient(180deg,
            {ye.isRegistered ? 'rgba(16,185,129,0.1)' : 'rgba(15,31,58,0.7)'},
            rgba(7,14,27,0.95));
          border: 1.5px solid {ye.isRegistered ? 'rgba(16,185,129,0.42)' : 'rgba(212,175,55,0.22)'};
        "
      >
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
          <span class="text-base">{ye.isRegistered ? '✅' : '🎯'}</span>
          <p class="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest font-extrabold flex-1"
             style="color: {ye.isRegistered ? '#6ee7b7' : '#a78bfa'};">
            Your Status
          </p>
          <span class="text-[9px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full"
                style="background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);">
            {ye.entryStatus}
          </span>
        </div>

        {#if ye.isRegistered}
          <div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 mb-3">
            <div class="text-center">
              <p class="text-[9px] text-white/40 uppercase font-bold mb-1">Seat</p>
              <p class="text-base font-extrabold text-white tabular-nums">{ye.seat ?? '—'}</p>
            </div>
            <div class="text-center" style="border-left: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);">
              <p class="text-[9px] text-white/40 uppercase font-bold mb-1">Stack</p>
              <p class="text-base font-extrabold text-gold tabular-nums">
                {ye.stack != null ? `$${fmtInt(ye.stack)}` : '—'}
              </p>
            </div>
            <div class="text-center">
              <p class="text-[9px] text-white/40 uppercase font-bold mb-1">Table</p>
              <p class="text-base font-extrabold text-white tabular-nums">{ye.tableNumber ?? '—'}</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="flex gap-2">
            {#if ye.virtualTableId && isLive && ye.entryStatus === 'playing'}
              <button
                on:click={() => onOpenTable(tournamentId, ye.virtualTableId)}
                class="flex-1 rounded-xl py-3 text-[12px] font-extrabold active:scale-95"
                style="background: linear-gradient(180deg, #22c55e, #15803d); color: white; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #14532d;"
              >
                🎰 Go to Table
              </button>
            {/if}
            {#if ye.entryStatus === 'registered' && !isLive}
              <button
                on:click={doUnregister}
                disabled={acting}
                class="flex-1 rounded-xl py-3 text-[12px] font-extrabold active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-40"
                style="background: rgba(220,38,38,0.15); color: #fca5a5; border: 1px solid rgba(220,38,38,0.35);"
              >
                Unregister
              </button>
            {/if}
          </div>
        {:else if ye.entryStatus === 'eliminated'}
          <div class="rounded-xl p-3 text-center mb-3"
               style="background: rgba(107,114,128,0.15); border: 1px solid rgba(107,114,128,0.3);">
            <p class="text-[11px] text-white/60 font-bold">
              Eliminated {ye.finalPosition ? `· #${ye.finalPosition}` : ''}
            </p>
            {#if ye.payoutAmount > 0}
              <p class="text-[11px] text-emerald-400 font-extrabold mt-1">
                Won ${fmt(ye.payoutAmount)}
              </p>
            {/if}
          </div>

          {#if ye.canReEnter}
            <button
              on:click={doRegister}
              disabled={acting}
              class="w-full rounded-xl py-3.5 text-[13px] font-extrabold active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-40"
              style="background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f4e5a8, #d4af37 45%, #a87a15); color: #0a0800; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #7a560a;"
            >
              Re-enter · ${fmt(t.buyIn + t.fee)}
            </button>
          {/if}
        {:else if ye.canRegister}
          <button
            on:click={doRegister}
            disabled={acting}
            class="w-full rounded-xl py-3.5 text-[13px] font-extrabold active:scale-95 disabled:opacity-40"
            style="background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f4e5a8, #d4af37 45%, #a87a15); color: #0a0800; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #7a560a;"
          >
            {t.buyIn > 0 ? `Register · $${fmt(t.buyIn + t.fee)}` : 'Register — Free'}
          </button>
        {/if}
      </div>
    {:else if myUserId && canRegisterNow}
      <button
        on:click={doRegister}
        disabled={acting}
        class="w-full rounded-3xl py-4 text-[13px] font-extrabold mb-3 active:scale-[0.98] disabled:opacity-40"
        style="background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f4e5a8, #d4af37 45%, #a87a15); color: #0a0800; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #7a560a;"
      >
        {t.buyIn > 0 ? `Register · $${fmt(t.buyIn + t.fee)}` : 'Register — Free'}
      </button>
    {/if}

    <!-- PAYOUTS -->
    {#if t.payouts && t.payouts.length > 0}
      <div
        class="rounded-3xl p-4 mb-3"
        style="background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(15,31,58,0.7), rgba(7,14,27,0.95)); border: 1.5px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.2);"
      >
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
          <span class="text-base">🏆</span>
          <p class="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest font-extrabold text-gold/80 flex-1">
            Payouts
          </p>
        </div>
        <div class="space-y-1.5">
          {#each t.payouts as po}
            <div class="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] py-1">
              <span class="font-bold text-white/80">
                {po.position === 1 ? '1st' : po.position === 2 ? '2nd' : po.position === 3 ? '3rd' : `#${po.position}`}
              </span>
              <div class="flex items-center gap-3">
                <span class="text-white/50 font-mono tabular-nums">
                  {(po.percentage * 100).toFixed(1)}%
                </span>
                <span class="text-gold font-extrabold tabular-nums min-w-[68px] text-right">
                  ${fmt(po.amount)}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          {/each}
        </div>
      </div>
    {/if}

    <!-- PLAYERS -->
    {#if allPlayers.length > 0}
      <div
        class="rounded-3xl p-4 mb-3"
        style="background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(15,31,58,0.7), rgba(7,14,27,0.95)); border: 1.5px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.2);"
      >
        <div class="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
          <span class="text-base">👥</span>
          <p class="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest font-extrabold text-gold/80 flex-1">
            Players ({allPlayers.length})
          </p>
        </div>

        <div class="space-y-1.5 max-h-96 overflow-y-auto no-scrollbar">
          {#each top30 as p, idx}
            {@const isMe = Number(p.userId) === Number(myUserId)}
            {@const isWinner = p.status === 'winner' || p.finalPosition === 1}
            {@const isElim = p.status === 'eliminated'}
            <div
              class="flex items-center gap-2.5 p-2 rounded-xl"
              style="
                background: {isMe
                  ? 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(212,175,55,0.15), rgba(212,175,55,0.05))'
                  : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.25)'};
                border: 1px solid {isMe
                  ? 'rgba(212,175,55,0.42)'
                  : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.04)'};
                {isElim ? 'opacity: 0.5;' : ''}
              "
            >
              <div
                class="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 text-[11px]"
                style="
                  background: {isWinner
                    ? 'linear-gradient(180deg, #f4e5a8, #d4af37 45%, #a87a15)'
                    : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.4)'};
                  border: 1px solid {isWinner
                    ? 'rgba(255,235,170,0.5)'
                    : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.08)'};
                  font-weight: 800;
                  color: {isWinner ? '#0a0800' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)'};
                "
              >
                {rankIcon(idx) || `#${idx + 1}`}
              </div>

              <div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-full overflow-hidden shrink-0"
                   style="background: radial-gradient(circle, #1a3a5c, #05080f);">
                <Avatar avatarId={p.avatarId || 'king'} size="sm" />
              </div>

              <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <p
                    class="text-[12px] font-extrabold truncate"
                    style="
                      color: {isMe ? '#f4e5a8' : isElim ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.4)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)'};
                      {isElim ? 'text-decoration: line-through;' : ''}
                    "
                  >
                    {isMe ? 'You' : p.displayName}
                  </p>
                  {#if isMe}
                    <span
                      class="text-[8px] font-extrabold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full tracking-wider"
                      style="background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f4e5a8, #d4af37 45%, #a87a15); color: #0a0800;"
                    >
                      YOU
                    </span>
                  {/if}
                </div>
                <p class="text-[9px] text-white/40 font-mono">
                  {p.seat != null ? `Seat ${p.seat}` : ''}
                  {#if p.finalPosition}
                    · Finished #{p.finalPosition}
                  {/if}
                </p>
              </div>

              <div class="text-right shrink-0">
                <p
                  class="text-[12px] font-extrabold tabular-nums"
                  style="color: {isElim ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.3)' : '#d4af37'};"
                >
                  {isElim ? '—' : `$${fmtInt(p.stack)}`}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          {/each}

          {#if showSelfPinned && selfPlayer}
            <div class="pt-2 mt-1" style="border-top: 1px dashed rgba(212,175,55,0.3);">
              <div
                class="flex items-center gap-2.5 p-2 rounded-xl"
                style="
                  background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(212,175,55,0.18), rgba(212,175,55,0.05));
                  border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.55);
                  box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(212,175,55,0.2);
                "
              >
                <div
                  class="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 text-[11px] font-extrabold"
                  style="background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);"
                >
                  #{allPlayers.indexOf(selfPlayer) + 1}
                </div>
                <div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-full overflow-hidden shrink-0"
                     style="background: radial-gradient(circle, #1a3a5c, #05080f);">
                  <Avatar avatarId={selfPlayer.avatarId || 'king'} size="sm" />
                </div>
                <div class="flex-1 min-w-0">
                  <div class="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <p class="text-[12px] font-extrabold truncate" style="color: #f4e5a8;">You</p>
                    <span
                      class="text-[8px] font-extrabold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full tracking-wider"
                      style="background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f4e5a8, #d4af37 45%, #a87a15); color: #0a0800;"
                    >
                      YOU
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <p class="text-[9px] text-white/40 font-mono">
                    {selfPlayer.seat != null ? `Seat ${selfPlayer.seat}` : ''}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div class="text-right shrink-0">
                  <p class="text-[12px] font-extrabold text-gold tabular-nums">
                    ${fmtInt(selfPlayer.stack)}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          {/if}
        </div>
      </div>
    {/if}

    <!-- BLIND STRUCTURE -->
    {#if allBlinds.length > 0}
      <div
        class="rounded-3xl p-4 mb-3"
        style="background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(15,31,58,0.7), rgba(7,14,27,0.95)); border: 1.5px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.2);"
      >
        <button
          on:click={() => (expandBlinds = !expandBlinds)}
          class="w-full flex items-center gap-2 mb-3 active:opacity-80"
        >
          <span class="text-base">📊</span>
          <p class="text-[10px] uppercase tracking-widest font-extrabold text-gold/80 flex-1 text-left">
            Blind Structure
          </p>
          <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-white/50">
            {expandBlinds ? 'Collapse' : 'Expand'}
          </span>
          <svg
            width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor"
            stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"
            class="text-white/50 transition-transform"
            style="transform: rotate({expandBlinds ? 180 : 0}deg);"
          >
            <path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6" />
          </svg>
        </button>

        <div class="space-y-1">
          {#each visibleBlinds as b}
            {@const isCurrent = b.level === currentLevel && isLive}
            {@const isPast = b.level < currentLevel}
            <div
              class="flex items-center gap-2 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg"
              style="
                background: {isCurrent ? 'linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(251,146,60,0.18), rgba(251,146,60,0.04))' : 'rgba(0,0,0,0.22)'};
                border: 1px solid {isCurrent ? 'rgba(251,146,60,0.55)' : 'transparent'};
                {isPast ? 'opacity: 0.5;' : ''}
              "
            >
              <span
                class="text-[10px] font-extrabold font-mono w-8 shrink-0"
                style="color: {isCurrent ? '#fb923c' : isPast ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.35)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.7)'};"
              >
                L{b.level}
              </span>

              {#if b.isBreak}
                <span class="text-[10px] font-bold text-cyan-300 flex-1">
                  ☕ Break · {Math.round(b.durationSec / 60)}min
                </span>
              {:else}
                <span
                  class="text-[11px] font-extrabold tabular-nums shrink-0"
                  style="color: {isCurrent ? '#fb923c' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)'}; min-width: 78px;"
                >
                  {fmtInt(b.sb)}/{fmtInt(b.bb)}
                </span>
                <span class="text-[9px] text-white/40 font-mono shrink-0 tabular-nums" style="min-width: 42px;">
                  {b.ante > 0 ? `a${fmtInt(b.ante)}` : '—'}
                </span>
                <span class="text-[9px] text-white/40 shrink-0 flex-1">
                  {Math.round(b.durationSec / 60)}min
                </span>
              {/if}

              {#if isCurrent}
                <span class="text-[8px] font-extrabold text-orange-300 uppercase tracking-wider shrink-0">
                  🔵 Current
                </span>
              {:else if isPast}
                <span class="text-[9px] text-emerald-400/70 shrink-0">✓</span>
              {/if}
            </div>
          {/each}

          {#if !expandBlinds && allBlinds.length > 5 && currentLevel > 3}
            <p class="text-center text-[9px] text-white/30 pt-1">
              Showing L{Math.max(1, currentLevel - 2)}–L{currentLevel + 2} of {allBlinds.length}
            </p>
          {/if}
        </div>
      </div>
    {/if}

    <!-- INFO -->
    <div
      class="rounded-2xl p-3.5 mb-3 space-y-2 text-[11px] font-mono"
      style="background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(15,31,58,0.6), rgba(7,14,27,0.9)); border: 1px solid rgba(212,175,55,0.12);"
    >
      <div class="flex justify-between">
        <span class="text-white/40">Variant</span>
        <span class="text-white/85 uppercase">{t.variant}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="flex justify-between">
        <span class="text-white/40">Format</span>
        <span class="text-white/85 uppercase">{t.format} · {t.speed}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="flex justify-between">
        <span class="text-white/40">Buy-in</span>
        <span class="text-white/85">
          {t.buyIn > 0 ? `$${fmt(t.buyIn)} + $${fmt(t.fee)}` : 'Free'}
        </span>
      </div>
      <div class="flex justify-between">
        <span class="text-white/40">Stack</span>
        <span class="text-white/85 tabular-nums">{fmtInt(t.startingStack)}</span>
      </div>
      {#if t.lateRegLevel > 0}
        <div class="flex justify-between">
          <span class="text-white/40">Late reg</span>
          <span class="text-white/85">until L{t.lateRegLevel}</span>
        </div>
      {/if}
      {#if t.allowReEntry}
        <div class="flex justify-between">
          <span class="text-white/40">Re-entry</span>
          <span class="text-white/85">{t.maxReEntries}x</span>

<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount, onDestroy } from 'svelte';
  import { api } from '../lib/api';
  import { getRealtime, realtimeConnected, TOURNAMENT_EVENT_RE } from '../lib/realtime';
  import TopBar from '../components/TopBar.svelte';

  export let onOpenTournament: (id: number) => void = () => {};

  type Filter = 'all' | 'running' | 'registering' | 'scheduled' | 'finished';

  let filter: Filter = 'all';
  let tournaments: any[] = [];
  let loading = true;
  let error = '';
  let pollTimer: any = null;

  function fmt(n: any): string {
    return Number(Number(n || 0).toFixed(2)).toFixed(2);
  }

  function fmtTime(iso: string | null): string {
    if (!iso) return '—';
    try {
      const d = new Date(iso);
      const diff = d.getTime() - Date.now();
      if (diff < 0) return 'Started';
      const min = Math.floor(diff / 60000);
      if (min < 60) return `in ${min}m`;
      const h = Math.floor(min / 60);
      return `in ${h}h`;
    } catch { return '—'; }
  }

  const FILTERS: { key: Filter; label: string; color: string }[] = [
    { key: 'all', label: 'All', color: '#d4af37' },
    { key: 'running', label: 'Live', color: '#10b981' },
    { key: 'registering', label: 'Open', color: '#22d3ee' },
    { key: 'scheduled', label: 'Upcoming', color: '#8b5cf6' },
    { key: 'finished', label: 'Finished', color: '#6b7280' },
  ];

  async function load() {
    error = '';
    try {
      const statusParam = filter === 'all' ? undefined : filter;
      const res = await api.listTournaments({ status: statusParam });
      if (res.ok && res.data) tournaments = res.data.tournaments || [];
      else error = res.error || 'failed';
    } catch (e: any) { error = e.message; }
    finally { loading = false; }
  }

  function onAnyEvent(event: string): void {
    if (TOURNAMENT_EVENT_RE.test(event)) load();
  }

  onMount(() => {
    load();
    pollTimer = setInterval(load, 20000);
    return () => { if (pollTimer) clearInterval(pollTimer); };
  });

  $: if ($realtimeConnected) {
    const s = getRealtime();
    if (s) { s.offAny(onAnyEvent); s.onAny(onAnyEvent); }
  }

  onDestroy(() => {
    const s = getRealtime();
    if (s) s.offAny(onAnyEvent);
  });

  function statusColor(status: string): string {
    if (status === 'running') return '#10b981';
    if (status === 'final_table') return '#d4af37';
    if (status === 'registering') return '#22d3ee';
    if (status === 'scheduled') return '#8b5cf6';
    if (status === 'finished') return '#6b7280';
    return '#ef4444';
  }

  function statusLabel(status: string): string {
    if (status === 'final_table') return 'FINAL';
    return status.replace('_', ' ').toUpperCase();
  }

  function formatLabel(t: any): string {
    const map: Record<string, string> = { sng: 'SNG', mtt: 'MTT', freeroll: 'FREE', satellite: 'SAT' };
    return map[t.format] || t.format.toUpperCase();
  }

  // Featured = running tournament with biggest prize pool
  $: featured = tournaments
    .filter((t) => t.status === 'running' || t.status === 'final_table')
    .sort((a, b) => Number(b.totalPrizePool) - Number(a.totalPrizePool))[0] || null;

  $: others = featured ? tournaments.filter((t) => t.id !== featured.id) : tournaments;
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount } from 'svelte';
  import { api } from '../lib/api';
  import { auth } from '../stores/auth';
  import TopBar from '../components/TopBar.svelte';

  let activeTab: 'deposit' | 'withdraw' | 'history' = 'deposit';
  let balance = 0;
  let freeChips = 0;
  let tonStats = { deposited: 0, withdrawn: 0 };
  let hotWalletReady = false;
  let depositInfo: any = null;
  let withdrawStatus: any = null;
  let history: any = { tonTransactions: [], ledgerTransactions: [] };
  let loading = true;
  let error = '';
  let successMsg = '';
  let withdrawAmount = '';
  let withdrawAddress = '';
  let withdrawing = false;
  let walletConnected = false;
  let walletAddress: string | null = null;

  function fmt(n: any, decimals = 2): string {
    return Number(Number(n || 0).toFixed(decimals)).toFixed(decimals);
  }

  async function loadAll() {
    loading = true;
    error = '';
    try {
      const [bal, dep, stat, hist] = await Promise.all([
        api.walletBalance(),
        api.walletDepositInfo(),
        api.request<any>('/api/wallet/withdraw-status'),
        api.walletHistory(),
      ]);
      if (bal.ok && bal.data) {
        const d = bal.data as any;
        balance = d.balance || 0;
        freeChips = d.freeChips || 0;
        tonStats = d.ton || { deposited: 0, withdrawn: 0 };
        hotWalletReady = !!d.hotWalletReady;
      }
      if (dep.ok && dep.data) depositInfo = dep.data;
      if (stat.ok && stat.data) withdrawStatus = stat.data;
      if (hist.ok && hist.data) history = hist.data;
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
    } finally {
      loading = false;
    }
  }

  async function connectWallet() {
    try {
      const tc = (window as any).tonConnectUI;
      if (!tc) {
        error = 'TON Connect not loaded';
        setTimeout(() => (error = ''), 3000);
        return;
      }
      if (tc.connected) await tc.disconnect();
      else await tc.openModal();
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
      setTimeout(() => (error = ''), 3000);
    }
  }

  async function doWithdraw() {
    if (!withdrawAddress || !withdrawAmount) return;
    const amt = parseFloat(withdrawAmount);
    if (isNaN(amt) || amt <= 0) {
      error = 'Invalid amount';
      setTimeout(() => (error = ''), 3000);
      return;
    }
    withdrawing = true;
    error = '';
    try {
      const res = await api.walletWithdraw(amt, withdrawAddress);
      if (res.ok) {
        successMsg = `✅ Withdraw submitted: ${amt} TON`;
        withdrawAmount = '';
        withdrawAddress = '';
        setTimeout(() => (successMsg = ''), 4000);
        await loadAll();
      } else {
        error = res.error || 'withdraw_failed';
        setTimeout(() => (error = ''), 4000);
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      error = e.message;
      setTimeout(() => (error = ''), 4000);
    } finally {
      withdrawing = false;
    }
  }

  function copyDepositAddress() {
    if (depositInfo?.depositAddress) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(depositInfo.depositAddress);
      successMsg = '📋 Address copied';
      setTimeout(() => (successMsg = ''), 2000);
    }
  }

  function copyMemo() {
    if (depositInfo?.memo) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(depositInfo.memo);
      successMsg = '📋 Memo copied';
      setTimeout(() => (successMsg = ''), 2000);
    }
  }

  function useConnectedAddress() {
    if (walletAddress) withdrawAddress = walletAddress;
  }

  function setMaxWithdraw() {
    if (!withdrawStatus) return;
    const max = withdrawStatus.availableBalance;
    const maxTon = Math.floor((max / withdrawStatus.tonPriceUsd) * 1000) / 1000;
    withdrawAmount = String(maxTon);
  }

  onMount(async () => {
    await loadAll();
    const tc = (window as any).tonConnectUI;
    if (tc) {
      tc.onStatusChange((wallet: any) => {
        if (wallet) {
          walletConnected = true;
          walletAddress = wallet.account?.address || null;
        } else {
          walletConnected = false;
          walletAddress = null;
        }
      });
      if (tc.connected) {
        walletConnected = true;
        walletAddress = tc.account?.address || null;
      }
    }
  });

  $: tonNet = tonStats.deposited - tonStats.withdrawn;

  $: estReceive = (() => {
    const amt = parseFloat(withdrawAmount);
    if (isNaN(amt) || !withdrawStatus) return 0;
    return Math.max(0, amt - withdrawStatus.feeTon);
  })();
</script>

              <p class="text-[9px] text-white/40 uppercase tracking-wider font-bold">Free Chips</p>

          <div class="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            <div class="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center overflow-hidden" style="background: rgba(34,211,238,0.15); border: 1px solid rgba(34,211,238,0.4);">

            </div>
            <div>
              <p class="text-[9px] text-white/40 uppercase tracking-wider font-bold">TON Net</p>
              <p class="text-[14px] font-extrabold text-cyan tabular-nums">{fmt(tonNet, 4)}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  {/if}

  <!-- TON CONNECT -->
  <button
    on:click={connectWallet}
    class="mx-4 w-[calc(100%-2rem)] rounded-2xl p-3.5 mb-4 active:scale-[0.98] transition-all flex items-center justify-between relative overflow-hidden"
    style="
      background: {walletConnected ? 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(16,185,129,0.2), rgba(5,150,105,0.1))' : 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(34,211,238,0.15), rgba(14,116,144,0.08))'};
      border: 1.5px solid {walletConnected ? 'rgba(16,185,129,0.45)' : 'rgba(34,211,238,0.4)'};
    "
  >

========== FILE: apps\mini-app\src\stores\admin.ts ==========
import { writable } from 'svelte/store';

export const adminRequested = writable(false);
export const adminPromptOpen = writable(false);

export function requestAdmin() {
  adminPromptOpen.set(true);
}

export function confirmAdmin() {
  adminPromptOpen.set(false);
  adminRequested.set(true);
}

export function cancelAdmin() {
  adminPromptOpen.set(false);
}

  progressPct: number;
}

export interface LoyaltySeed {
  type: 'bronze' | 'silver' | 'gold' | 'platinum';
  label: string;
  icon: string;
  amount: number;
  claimed: boolean;
  claimedAt: string | null;
  eligible: boolean;
  progress: {
    freeHands: number;
    freeWins: number;
    minFreeHands: number;
    minFreeWins: number;
  };
}

export interface Loyalty {
  lifetimeXp: number;
  claimedXp: number;
  availableXp: number;
  level: number;
  xpIntoLevel: number;
  xpForNextLevel: number;
  tier: 'welcome' | 'bronze' | 'silver' | 'gold' | 'platinum' | 'diamond';
  tierLabel: string;
  tierIcon: string;
  tierColor: string;
  lifetimeRake: number;
  rakebackPct: number;
  nextTier: { name: string; label: string; minRake: number } | null;
  progressToNextTier: number;
  rakePaidLifetime: number;
  rakebackEarned: number;
  vouchers: LoyaltyVoucher[];
  seeds: LoyaltySeed[];
}

export interface AuthState {
  user: User | null;
  wallet: { balance_usd: string; locked_usd: string } | null;
  freeChips: FreeChips | null;
  stats: UserStats | null;
  loyalty: Loyalty | null;
  token: string | null;
  loading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
}

function createAuthStore() {
  const { subscribe, set, update } = writable<AuthState>({
    user: null,
    wallet: null,
    freeChips: null,
    stats: null,
    loyalty: null,
    token: null,
    loading: true,
    error: null,
  });

  return {
    subscribe,

    async init() {
      update((s) => ({ ...s, error: null }));

      const tg = (window as any).Telegram?.WebApp;
      if (tg) {
        tg.ready();
        tg.expand();
        if (tg.setHeaderColor) tg.setHeaderColor('#0a0e1a');
        if (tg.setBackgroundColor) tg.setBackgroundColor('#0a0e1a');
      }

      const tgInitData = tg?.initData;
      let authPayload: string;

      if (tgInitData && tgInitData.length > 0) {
        authPayload = tgInitData;
      } else {
        const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
        const urlUid = params.get('uid');
        const urlName = params.get('name');

        let devUid: number;
        let devName: string;

        if (urlUid) {
          devUid = Number(urlUid);
          devName = urlName || `User${devUid}`;
          localStorage.setItem('dev_uid', String(devUid));
          localStorage.setItem('dev_name', devName);
        } else {
          const storedUid = localStorage.getItem('dev_uid');
          if (storedUid) {
            devUid = Number(storedUid);
            devName = localStorage.getItem('dev_name') || `User${devUid}`;
          } else {
            devUid = Math.floor(100000 + Math.random() * 900000);
            devName = `User${devUid}`;
            localStorage.setItem('dev_uid', String(devUid));
            localStorage.setItem('dev_name', devName);
          }
        }

        const userJson = JSON.stringify({
          id: devUid,
          first_name: devName,
          username: devName.toLowerCase().replace(/\s/g, ''),
          language_code: 'en',
        });

        authPayload = `user=${encodeURIComponent(userJson)}&auth_date=9999999999&hash=dev`;
      }

      try {
        const res = await api.authTelegram(authPayload);
        if (!res.ok || !res.data) {
          update((s) => ({ ...s, loading: false, error: res.error || 'auth_failed' }));
          return false;
        }

        localStorage.setItem('token', res.data.token);
        update((s) => ({ ...s, token: res.data!.token, user: res.data!.user }));

        await this.refresh();
        return true;
      } catch (e: any) {
        update((s) => ({ ...s, loading: false, error: e.message || 'network_error' }));
        return false;
      }
    },

    async refresh() {
      const res = await api.me();
      if (res.ok && res.data) {
        const data = res.data as any;
        update((s) => ({
          ...s,
          user: data.user,
          wallet: data.wallet,
          freeChips: data.free_chips,
          stats: data.stats ?? null,
          loyalty: data.loyalty ?? null,
          loading: false,
          error: null,
        }));
      } else {
        update((s) => ({ ...s, loading: false, error: res.error || 'refresh_failed' }));
      }
    },

    logout() {
      localStorage.removeItem('token');
      localStorage.removeItem('dev_uid');
      localStorage.removeItem('dev_name');
      set({
        user: null,
        wallet: null,
        freeChips: null,
        stats: null,
        loyalty: null,
        token: null,
        loading: false,
        error: null,
      });
    },
  };
}

export const auth = createAuthStore();

import { CARD_THEMES, type CardTheme } from '../lib/card-themes';

const STORAGE_KEY = 'card_theme';

const stored: CardTheme =
  (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined'
    ? (localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) as CardTheme | null)
    : null) || 'classic';

export const cardTheme = writable<CardTheme>(stored);

// Persist whenever it changes
if (typeof localStorage !== 'undefined') {
  cardTheme.subscribe((v) => {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, v);
  });
}

<script lang="ts">
  import { onMount, onDestroy } from 'svelte';
  import { auth } from './stores/auth';
  import { initRealtime } from './lib/realtime';
  import { adminRequested } from './stores/admin';
  import { startBroadcastPolling, stopBroadcastPolling } from './lib/broadcasts';
  import Login from './routes/Login.svelte';
  import Home from './routes/Home.svelte';
  import Tables from './routes/Tables.svelte';
  import Wallet from './routes/Wallet.svelte';
  import Profile from './routes/Profile.svelte';
  import Table from './routes/Table.svelte';
  import Leaderboard from './routes/Leaderboard.svelte';
  import Events from './routes/Events.svelte';
  import Tournaments from './routes/Tournaments.svelte';
  import TournamentDetail from './routes/TournamentDetail.svelte';
  import Achievements from './routes/Achievements.svelte';
  import Shop from './routes/Shop.svelte';
  import Notifications from './routes/Notifications.svelte';
  import Settings from './routes/Settings.svelte';
  import HelpCenter from './routes/HelpCenter.svelte';
  import Admin from './routes/Admin.svelte';
  import MyTournaments from './routes/MyTournaments.svelte';
  import Loyalty from './routes/Loyalty.svelte';
  import RewardsHistory from './routes/RewardsHistory.svelte';
  import SideNav from './components/SideNav.svelte';
  import BottomNav from './components/BottomNav.svelte';
  import ToastStack from './components/ToastStack.svelte';
  import AdminPrompt from './components/AdminPrompt.svelte';
  import Splash from './routes/Splash.svelte';
  import TableSwitcher from './components/TableSwitcher.svelte';
  import TurnAlert from './components/TurnAlert.svelte';
import { startServerTimeSync } from './lib/serverTime';

  type Page =
    | 'home'
    | 'tables'
    | 'wallet'
    | 'profile'
    | 'table'
    | 'leaderboard'
    | 'events'
    | 'tournaments'
    | 'tournament-detail'
    | 'achievements'
    | 'my-tournaments'
    | 'shop'
    | 'notifications'
    | 'settings'
    | 'help'
    | 'admin'
    | 'loyalty'
    | 'rewards-history';

  let currentPage: Page = 'home';
  let activeTableId = 1;
  let activeTournamentId: number | null = null;
  let tableSource: 'cash' | 'tournament' = 'cash';
  let tablesVariant: string = 'all';
  let tablesMode: 'all' | 'free' | 'real' = 'all';
  let tablesKey = 0;

  $: hideNav =
    currentPage === 'table' ||
    currentPage === 'achievements' ||
    currentPage === 'my-tournaments' ||
    currentPage === 'shop' ||
    currentPage === 'notifications' ||
    currentPage === 'settings' ||
    currentPage === 'help' ||
    currentPage === 'admin' ||
    currentPage === 'loyalty' ||
    currentPage === 'rewards-history';

  let splashElapsed = false;
  $: forceSplash = $auth.loading || !splashElapsed;

  onMount(async () => {
    onDestroy(() => {
      stopBroadcastPolling();
    });
    setTimeout(() => {
      splashElapsed = true;
    }, 3000);
    await auth.init();
    startServerTimeSync();
    const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
    if (token) initRealtime(token);
    if (token) startBroadcastPolling();
    adminRequested.subscribe((v) => {
      if (v) {
        currentPage = 'admin';
        adminRequested.set(false);
        window.scrollTo({ top: 0 });
      }
    });
  });

  function navigate(page: Page) {
    currentPage = page;
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0 });
  }

  function openTable(id: number) {
    activeTableId = id;
    tableSource = 'cash';
    currentPage = 'table';
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0 });
  }

  function openTournamentTable(tournamentId: number, virtualTableId: number) {
    activeTournamentId = tournamentId;
    activeTableId = virtualTableId;
    tableSource = 'tournament';
    currentPage = 'table';
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0 });
  }

  function openTournament(id: number) {
    activeTournamentId = id;
    currentPage = 'tournament-detail';
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0 });
  }

  function backFromTable() {
    if (tableSource === 'tournament' && activeTournamentId) {
      currentPage = 'tournament-detail';
    } else {
      navigate('tables');
    }
  }

  function quickSeat(variant: string, mode: 'free' | 'real') {
    tablesVariant = variant;
    tablesMode = mode;
    tablesKey++;
    currentPage = 'tables';
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0 });
  }

  function switchTable(id: number) {
    activeTableId = id;
    currentPage = 'table';
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0 });
  }

  function goToTablesToAdd() {
    navigate('tables');
  }
</script>

-- Add late_reg_level to tournaments
-- Standard MTT uses "levels" not "minutes" for late registration.
-- 0 = no late reg (registration closes at start)

ALTER TABLE tournaments
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS late_reg_level INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;

COMMENT ON COLUMN tournaments.late_reg_level IS 'Last level at which new players can register. 0 = no late reg.';

-- Index for the auto-close check
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_tournaments_late_reg
  ON tournaments (status, current_level)
  WHERE status IN ('running', 'final_table');

    WHERE table_name = 'tournament_players' AND column_name = 'eliminated_by'

========== FILE: apps\server\migrations\017_free_stats.sql ==========
-- 017: Track free-play win stats
-- Adds free_won (sum of positive chip deltas) and free_hands_won (count of winning hands).
-- free_hands itself is already `free_chips.total_hands` — we just rename in API.
-- Idempotent.

ALTER TABLE free_chips
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS free_won BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS free_hands_won INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;

COMMENT ON COLUMN free_chips.free_won IS 'Sum of positive chip deltas from free hands (play_money_log.delta > 0, reason=hand_result).';
COMMENT ON COLUMN free_chips.free_hands_won IS 'Count of free hands where the player came out ahead.';

-- Backfill free_won from play_money_log
UPDATE free_chips fc SET free_won = COALESCE((
  SELECT SUM(pml.delta) FROM play_money_log pml
  WHERE pml.user_id = fc.user_id
    AND pml.reason = 'hand_result'
    AND pml.delta > 0
), 0)
WHERE free_won = 0;

-- Backfill free_hands_won
UPDATE free_chips fc SET free_hands_won = COALESCE((
  SELECT COUNT(*)::int FROM play_money_log pml
  WHERE pml.user_id = fc.user_id
    AND pml.reason = 'hand_result'
    AND pml.delta > 0
), 0)
WHERE free_hands_won = 0;

========== FILE: apps\server\migrations\018_loyalty.sql ==========
-- ============================================================
-- 018: Loyalty System — XP, Tier, Rakeback, XP tx, Shop, Vouchers, Seeds
-- All tables idempotent. 7 tables total.
-- ============================================================

-- ============================================================
-- 1. user_xp — lifetime XP + claimed XP
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_xp (
  user_id       BIGINT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  lifetime_xp   BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (lifetime_xp >= 0),
  claimed_xp    BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (claimed_xp >= 0),
  updated_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

COMMENT ON TABLE  user_xp IS 'Lifetime XP never decreases. claimed_xp is the amount already cashed out (always ≤ lifetime_xp).';
COMMENT ON COLUMN user_xp.lifetime_xp IS 'Total XP earned. Never decreases, even after cash out.';
COMMENT ON COLUMN user_xp.claimed_xp IS 'XP cashed out to wallet. Effective balance = lifetime_xp - claimed_xp.';

-- ============================================================
-- 2. user_tier — progressive rakeback tier
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_tier (
  user_id        BIGINT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  tier           TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'welcome'
                 CHECK (tier IN ('welcome','bronze','silver','gold','platinum','diamond')),
  lifetime_rake  NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (lifetime_rake >= 0),
  updated_at     TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

COMMENT ON TABLE  user_tier IS 'Rakeback tier. Separate from XP level. tier is derived from lifetime_rake.';

-- ============================================================
-- 3. rakeback_log — one row per (hand, user)
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rakeback_log (
  id          BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  hand_id     BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES hands(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  user_id     BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  amount      NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount >= 0),
  created_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE (hand_id, user_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rakeback_log_user_created
  ON rakeback_log (user_id, created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_rakeback_log_hand
  ON rakeback_log (hand_id);

COMMENT ON TABLE rakeback_log IS 'Rakeback paid per hand per user. UNIQUE(hand_id,user_id) for idempotency.';

-- ============================================================
-- 4. xp_transactions — ledger of all XP moves
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS xp_transactions (
  id          BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id     BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  amount      BIGINT NOT NULL,               -- +earn, -claim
  source      TEXT NOT NULL
              CHECK (source IN ('hand_rakeback','seed','claim','freeroll','bonus')),
  ref_id      BIGINT,
  meta        JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  created_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_xp_tx_user_created
  ON xp_transactions (user_id, created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_xp_tx_source
  ON xp_transactions (source, created_at DESC);

COMMENT ON TABLE xp_transactions IS 'Immutable ledger of XP credits/debits. amount > 0 = earn, amount < 0 = claim.';

-- ============================================================
-- 5. shop_purchases
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS shop_purchases (
  id              BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id         BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  pack_id         TEXT NOT NULL,
  ton_amount      NUMERIC(18,9) NOT NULL CHECK (ton_amount >= 0),
  usd_amount      NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL CHECK (usd_amount >= 0),
  chips_awarded   BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  xp_awarded      BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  voucher_amount  NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (voucher_amount >= 0),
  status          TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
                  CHECK (status IN ('pending','completed','failed','refunded')),
  ton_tx_hash     TEXT,
  meta            JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
  created_at      TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  completed_at    TIMESTAMPTZ
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_shop_purchases_user
  ON shop_purchases (user_id, created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_shop_purchases_status
  ON shop_purchases (status, created_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_shop_purchases_ton_tx
  ON shop_purchases (ton_tx_hash) WHERE ton_tx_hash IS NOT NULL;

COMMENT ON TABLE shop_purchases IS 'Purchase records. status=pending until TON tx confirms.';

-- ============================================================
-- 6. vouchers
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vouchers (
  id                  BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id             BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  amount              NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  min_rake            NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL CHECK (min_rake > 0),
  current_rake        NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (current_rake >= 0),
  used                BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  used_at             TIMESTAMPTZ,
  expires_at          TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  source_purchase_id  BIGINT REFERENCES shop_purchases(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  created_at          TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_vouchers_user_active
  ON vouchers (user_id, used, expires_at)
  WHERE used = FALSE;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_vouchers_expires
  ON vouchers (expires_at) WHERE used = FALSE;

COMMENT ON TABLE vouchers IS 'Conditional cash rewards. Unlock when current_rake >= min_rake before expires_at.';

-- ============================================================
-- 7. seeds — log of claimed free seeds
-- ============================================================
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS seeds (
  id          BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id     BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  seed_type   TEXT NOT NULL
              CHECK (seed_type IN ('bronze','silver','gold','platinum')),
  amount      NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  claimed     BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  claimed_at  TIMESTAMPTZ,
  created_at  TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE (user_id, seed_type)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_seeds_user
  ON seeds (user_id, claimed, created_at DESC);

COMMENT ON TABLE seeds IS 'Free seed claims. Definitions are hardcoded in backend; this table is the claim log.';

  min_players INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 10,

-- ============================================================
-- 023: Anti-abuse + Freeroll grace + Rebuy/Addon schema
-- ============================================================

-- 1. Freeroll launch grace (first 30 days → min prize $5)
ALTER TABLE freeroll_config
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS launch_grace_until TIMESTAMPTZ
    DEFAULT (NOW() + INTERVAL '30 days'),
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS grace_min_prize_usd NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 5.00;

COMMENT ON COLUMN freeroll_config.launch_grace_until IS
  'Until this timestamp, freeroll min prize uses grace_min_prize_usd';
COMMENT ON COLUMN freeroll_config.grace_min_prize_usd IS
  'Minimum prize during launch grace period';

-- 2. First-withdrawal anti-abuse flag
ALTER TABLE users
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS first_withdrawal_unlocked BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS first_withdrawal_at TIMESTAMPTZ;

COMMENT ON COLUMN users.first_withdrawal_unlocked IS
  'TRUE once user completes all anti-abuse conditions and can withdraw freely';

-- 3. Rebuy / Addon schema on tournaments
ALTER TABLE tournaments
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS allow_rebuy BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS max_rebuys INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS rebuy_amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS rebuy_stack BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS rebuy_until_level INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS allow_addon BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS addon_amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS addon_stack BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS addon_at_level INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;

ALTER TABLE tournament_entries
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS rebuy_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS has_addon BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE;

ALTER TABLE tournament_players
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS rebuy_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS has_addon BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE;

========== FILE: apps\server\migrations\run-018.ts ==========
import { Pool } from 'pg';
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';
import dotenv from 'dotenv';

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);
dotenv.config({ path: path.resolve(__dirname, '../../../.env') });

const db = new Pool({
  connectionString:
    process.env.DATABASE_URL ||
    'postgres://poker:pokerpass@localhost:5432/poker',
});

const TABLES = [
  'user_xp',
  'user_tier',
  'rakeback_log',
  'xp_transactions',
  'shop_purchases',
  'vouchers',
  'seeds',
];

async function main() {
  const sqlPath = path.join(__dirname, '018_loyalty.sql');
  const sql = fs.readFileSync(sqlPath, 'utf-8');
  console.log('▶ Running:', sqlPath);

  await db.query(sql);
  console.log('✅ Migration 018 applied\n');

  console.log('═══ Verification ═══\n');

  for (const t of TABLES) {
    const cols = await db.query(
      `SELECT column_name, data_type, is_nullable, column_default
       FROM information_schema.columns
       WHERE table_name = $1 ORDER BY ordinal_position`,
      [t],
    );
    const idx = await db.query(
      `SELECT indexname FROM pg_indexes WHERE tablename = $1 ORDER BY indexname`,
      [t],
    );
    const fks = await db.query(
      `SELECT
         tc.constraint_name,
         kcu.column_name,
         ccu.table_name AS foreign_table,
         ccu.column_name AS foreign_column
       FROM information_schema.table_constraints tc
       JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage kcu
         ON tc.constraint_name = kcu.constraint_name
       JOIN information_schema.constraint_column_usage ccu
         ON ccu.constraint_name = tc.constraint_name
       WHERE tc.table_name = $1 AND tc.constraint_type = 'FOREIGN KEY'`,
      [t],
    );

    console.log(`📋 ${t}`);
    console.log(`   Columns: ${cols.rows.map((r) => r.column_name).join(', ')}`);
    console.log(
      `   Indexes: ${idx.rows.map((r) => r.indexname).join(', ') || '(none)'}`,
    );
    if (fks.rows.length > 0) {
      console.log(
        `   FKs:     ${fks.rows.map((r) => `${r.column_name}→${r.foreign_table}.${r.foreign_column}`).join(', ')}`,
      );
    }
    console.log('');
  }

  await db.end();
}

main().catch((e) => {
  console.error('FATAL:', e);
  process.exit(1);
});

========== FILE: apps\server\src\__tests__\auth.test.ts ==========
import { describe, it, expect } from 'vitest';
import { signToken, verifyToken } from '../auth.js';

const SECRET = 'test-secret';

describe('Auth — JWT', () => {
  describe('signToken', () => {
    it('creates a valid JWT string', () => {
      const token = signToken({ uid: 1, tg: 123 }, SECRET);
      expect(token).toBeTypeOf('string');
      expect(token.split('.')).toHaveLength(3);
    });

    it('embeds payload', () => {
      const token = signToken({ uid: 42, tg: 999 }, SECRET);
      const payload = verifyToken(token, SECRET);
      expect(payload.uid).toBe(42);
      expect(payload.tg).toBe(999);
    });

    it('sets exp in future', () => {
      const token = signToken({ uid: 1 }, SECRET, 3600);
      const payload = verifyToken(token, SECRET);
      const now = Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000);
      expect(payload.exp).toBeGreaterThan(now);
    });
  });

  describe('verifyToken', () => {
    it('verifies valid token', () => {
      const token = signToken({ uid: 1 }, SECRET);
      const payload = verifyToken(token, SECRET);
      expect(payload).toBeTruthy();
      expect(payload.uid).toBe(1);
    });

    it('rejects token with wrong secret', () => {
      const token = signToken({ uid: 1 }, SECRET);
      const payload = verifyToken(token, 'wrong-secret');
      expect(payload).toBeNull();
    });

    it('rejects malformed token', () => {
      expect(verifyToken('not.a.token', SECRET)).toBeNull();
      expect(verifyToken('', SECRET)).toBeNull();
    });

    it('rejects expired token', () => {
      const token = signToken({ uid: 1 }, SECRET, -1);
      const payload = verifyToken(token, SECRET);
      expect(payload).toBeNull();
    });
  });
});

// ============================================================
// Loyalty definitions: tiers, rakeback rates, XP curve, seeds, packs
// Pure data + pure functions. No DB.
// ============================================================

export type TierName =
  | 'welcome'
  | 'bronze'
  | 'silver'
  | 'gold'
  | 'platinum'
  | 'diamond';

export interface TierDef {
  name: TierName;
  label: string;
  minRake: number;
  maxRake: number;
  rakebackPct: number;
  color: string;
  icon: string;
}

export const TIERS: TierDef[] = [
  { name: 'welcome',  label: 'Welcome',  minRake: 0,     maxRake: 25,       rakebackPct: 0.60, color: '#6ee7b7', icon: '🌱' },
  { name: 'bronze',   label: 'Bronze',   minRake: 25,    maxRake: 100,      rakebackPct: 0.50, color: '#c98a3e', icon: '🥉' },
  { name: 'silver',   label: 'Silver',   minRake: 100,   maxRake: 500,      rakebackPct: 0.45, color: '#cbd5e1', icon: '🥈' },
  { name: 'gold',     label: 'Gold',     minRake: 500,   maxRake: 2500,     rakebackPct: 0.40, color: '#f4c95d', icon: '🥇' },
  { name: 'platinum', label: 'Platinum', minRake: 2500,  maxRake: 10000,    rakebackPct: 0.35, color: '#a5b4fc', icon: '💎' },
  { name: 'diamond',  label: 'Diamond',  minRake: 10000, maxRake: Infinity, rakebackPct: 0.30, color: '#67e8f9', icon: '💠' },
];

export function tierForRake(lifetimeRake: number): TierDef {
  const r = Math.max(0, Number(lifetimeRake) || 0);
  for (const t of TIERS) {
    if (r >= t.minRake && r < t.maxRake) return t;
  }
  return TIERS[TIERS.length - 1];
}

export function nextTier(current: TierName): TierDef | null {
  const idx = TIERS.findIndex((t) => t.name === current);
  if (idx < 0 || idx >= TIERS.length - 1) return null;
  return TIERS[idx + 1];
}

export function tierDef(name: TierName): TierDef {
  return TIERS.find((t) => t.name === name) ?? TIERS[0];
}

// ============================================================
// XP constants
// ============================================================
export const XP_PER_USD_RAKE_SHARE = 250;
export const XP_POOL_PCT = 0.25;
export const XP_PER_DOLLAR = 1000;

// XP cashout rules
export const XP_CASHOUT_MIN = 5000;
export const XP_CASHOUT_STEP = 1000;
export const XP_CASHOUT_MIN_LEVEL = 5;
export const XP_CASHOUT_MONTHLY_CAP = 50000;
export const XP_CASHOUT_COOLDOWN_HOURS = 24;

// ============================================================
// XP CURVE — stepped, exact table
// ============================================================
// XP_TABLE[L] = XP needed to go from level L to L+1
// Covers L1..L49. For L50+ computed separately.
const XP_TABLE: number[] = [
  0,          // index 0 unused
  // Tier I — Starter (L1-L5 entry points: 4 transitions)
  100, 250, 500, 1000,
  // Tier II — Bronze (L5→L15, 10 transitions)
  1500, 2200, 3000, 4000, 5500, 7000, 9000, 12000, 16000, 20000,
  // Tier III — Silver (L15→L30, 15 transitions)
  30000, 40000, 50000, 60000, 75000, 100000, 130000, 165000, 210000, 260000,
  320000, 400000, 500000, 620000, 770000,
  // Tier IV — Gold (L30→L50, 20 transitions)
  1000000, 1200000, 1450000, 1750000, 2100000, 2500000, 3000000, 3600000, 4300000, 5200000,
  6200000, 7500000, 9000000, 10800000, 13000000, 15600000, 18700000, 22500000, 27000000, 32500000,
];

export function xpForNextLevel(level: number): number {
  if (level < 1) return 100;

  // Tier I-III + IV (L1-L49): exact table
  if (level <= 49) {
    return XP_TABLE[level] ?? 32_500_000;
  }

  // Tier V — Platinum (L50-L79): anchor-based linear interpolation
  //   L50→L51 = 40M, L60→L61 = 150M, L70→L71 = 350M, L79→L80 = 500M
  if (level <= 59) return Math.round(40_000_000 + (level - 50) * 11_000_000);
  if (level <= 69) return Math.round(150_000_000 + (level - 60) * 20_000_000);
  if (level <= 79) return Math.round(350_000_000 + (level - 70) * (150_000_000 / 9));

  // Tier VI — Diamond (L80+): 500M + 50M per level, cap at 1B
  const xp = 500_000_000 + (level - 80) * 50_000_000;
  return Math.min(1_000_000_000, xp);
}

export interface LevelInfo {
  level: number;
  xpIntoLevel: number;
  xpForNextLevel: number;
  xpAtLevelStart: number;
}

export function levelFromLifetimeXP(lifetimeXp: number): LevelInfo {
  let remaining = Math.max(0, Number(lifetimeXp) || 0);
  let level = 1;
  let consumed = 0;

  for (let safety = 0; safety < 5000; safety++) {
    const need = xpForNextLevel(level);
    if (remaining < need) {
      return { level, xpIntoLevel: remaining, xpForNextLevel: need, xpAtLevelStart: consumed };
    }
    remaining -= need;
    consumed += need;
    level++;
  }
  return { level, xpIntoLevel: 0, xpForNextLevel: xpForNextLevel(level), xpAtLevelStart: consumed };
}

// ============================================================
// Level-based discounts (shop)
// ============================================================
export function levelDiscount(level: number): number {
  if (level >= 80) return 0.30;
  if (level >= 50) return 0.20;
  if (level >= 25) return 0.10;
  if (level >= 10) return 0.05;
  return 0;
}

export * from './definitions.js';
